jobs.title: Consulting Clinician - MADRS Clinical Rater (Finnish Fluency)
jobs.excerpt: About CogstateAt Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.
jobs.description:
About Cogstate

At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

About the Clinician Network

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.

Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

All applicants to the Clinician Network are kept in our active pipeline, and you’ll also receive our monthly Clinician Network newsletter, which shares updates and upcoming openings.

About the Role

Cogstate Clinicians are clinical psychologists or neuropsychologists responsible for delivering remote clinical interviews and cognitive assessment batteries to subjects with preclinical dementia, enrolled in a pharmaceutical clinical trial.

Cogstate provides all consultants with comprehensive, fully compensated training on general Cogstate operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing skills and virtual cognitive assessment prior to performing remote scale administrations. Regular supervision and ongoing recalibration of clinical skill set will be provided.

*These are contract position.

*They are fully remote.

*Hired employee will work on an as needed basis based on their schedule.

- MADRS Administration Experience Required
- Finnish Fluency Required

Key Responsibilities

Central Rating

  • Remotely administering semi-structured clinical interview assessments and cognitive battery of tests to study subjects and caregivers.
  • Remotely delivering computerized and traditional cognitive assessments via a tele-health platform.
  • Scoring completed scale administrations.
  • Participating in regular clinical skill recalibration activities.

Central Monitoring

  • Providing reviews of completed neuropsychological test batteries for central monitoring of data to ensure accuracy in administration and scoring and contribute to the overall success of a clinical trial.
  • Reviewing response forms and recordings of remote scale administrations and offering feedback to raters via email and telephone communications.

Qualifications & Expertise

  • MD, DO, MBBS or PhD, PsyD in Psychology or RN, APRN, PA, MA/MS/MSW in Psychiatry (or equivalent)
  • Formal training in clinical interviewing and cognitive assessment
  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience with direct clinical interviewing and psychological assessment in clinical research industry, academic or clinical settings
  • Direct experience with cognitive/behavioral/functional assessment of neurological/psychiatric populations
  • Ability to meet deadlines, being highly organized and methodical, with attention to detail to ensure delivery
  • Proficiency with MS Office, including Word and Excel, email, teleconference platforms such as Skype, Zoom or other similar applications, and cloud-based storage service.
  • Finnish Fluency
  • MADRS Administration Experience Required

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. Instacart is a Flex First team

Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Overview

The Instacart Brand Partnerships team is at the center of one of the most exciting transformations happening in retail media today. We work with brands across the CPG landscape to help them win at the digital shelf — connecting them to millions of shoppers actively purchasing groceries and everyday essentials online. The Emerging team moves fast, uses data to storytell, and genuinely believes that the brands we work with are building the future of how people discover and buy products.

The challenger brands we work with are scrappy, ambitious, and already excited about what Instacart can do for them. We're growing this segment rapidly, and this role sits right at the heart of that growth. In this role, you'll build and nurture relationships with a portfolio of emerging brands — both those actively investing in the platform and those with untapped potential waiting to be unlocked.   • Educate brands on the e-commerce landscape and how to think about Instacart as a core retail media channel
  • Maintain a high-velocity sales cadence — calls, emails, QBRs — in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment
  • Partner cross-functionally with Account Management, Product, and Marketing to deliver an exceptional partner experience

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience in digital media sales, media buying or CPG advertising. Preferably in a previous quota carrying sales role.

  • Familiarity with the broader e-commerce landscape and retail media ecosystem (experience at a retailer, DSP, or CPG brand is a plus)
  • Comfort with a high-activity sales environment — you're organized, responsive, and know how to prioritize
  • Experience with tools like Salesforce, Google Suite, and Excel/Sheets; familiarity with ad platforms and AI tools is a bonus
  • Genuine curiosity about where retail media is headed and how brands can win in it

With over 450 employees and 25 offices worldwide, our mission is to revolutionize our clients' business transformation challenges and set new industry standards through innovative solutions.

jobs.title: English-Chinese Bilingual Speaker - Voice Recording
jobs.excerpt: This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform - not a job.
jobs.description:
This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform - not a job. No fixed hours, no commitment beyond what fits your schedule. You talk, you get paid.

About the Role

We're looking for bilingual speakers to record short, casual voice clips where they naturally mix English with Chinese - the way they'd actually talk in real life. No script, no scenarios, just you talking about your day, your opinions, whatever comes naturally.

Do you switch between English and Chinese mid-sentence without even thinking about it? Rant about your day, discuss your favorite show, think out loud with different languages - say it exactly how you'd say it to a friend. What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities:

  • Record 1-2 minute voice clips responding to a prompt or reacting to a short video
  • Speak naturally, switching between English and Chinese the way you normally would in everyday conversation
  • Complete a few clips per recording session

Requirements

  • Language: Fully bilingual - fluent or native in both English and Chinese, and someone who naturally mixes the two when speaking
  • Equipment: Any device works, including your phone - no studio or special equipment needed
  • Recording environment: A quiet room with no background music, TV, traffic, or other people talking
  • Audio quality: Clear voice, close to the mic, one speaker only, no echo. A headset or earbuds with a mic helps but isn't required
  • Note: Quiet, clean audio matters most - background noise or unclear speech can affect approval

Why is this freelance opportunity a great fit for you?

  • Get paid to talk - no perfect grammar, no formality: up to $5 per hour equivalent depending on the project
  • Do it from your couch, your phone, wherever's comfortable
  • Flexible, from home, paid per approved recording
  • If you naturally mix Chinese and English when you speak, you're exactly who we're looking for

jobs.title: Specialist, Quality Assurance
jobs.excerpt: About Care AccessCare Access is working to make the future of health better for all.
jobs.description:
About Care Access

Care Access is working to make the future of health better for all. With hundreds of research locations, mobile clinics, and clinicians across the globe, we bring world-class research and health services directly to communities that often face barriers to care. We are dedicated to ensuring that every person has the opportunity to understand their health, access the care they need, and contribute to the medical breakthroughs of tomorrow.

With programs like Future of Medicine, which makes advanced health screenings and research opportunities accessible to communities worldwide, and Difference Makers, which supports local leaders to expand their community health and wellbeing efforts, we put people at the heart of medical progress. Through partnerships, technology, and perseverance, we are reimagining how clinical research and health services reach the world. Together, we are building a future of health that is better and more accessible for all.

To learn more about Care Access, visit .

How This Role Makes a Difference

Care Access is seeking a dedicated, experienced, and innovation-driven Quality Assurance Specialist (GxP) to support the success of the Quality Assurance Department and organizational compliance activities. The Quality Assurance Specialist will be responsible for closely monitoring the quality and compliance of clinical work at both traditional trial sites and decentralized trials. The QA specialist will directly support quality initiatives, audit functions, CAPA systems and promote inspections readiness. Working in support of the Associate Director of Quality Assurance, the Quality Assurance Specialist will ensure that Care Access maintains a high level of quality while executing clinical trials according to Care Access SOPs, GCP, and FDA/ICH Guidelines.

How You'll Make An Impact

  • Site-Level Quality & Data Integrity: Ensure the highest standards of patient safety and data integrity at clinical research sites through regular quality assurance reviews, interpreting and implementing standard QA procedures.
  • GCP Regulatory Document Review: Conduct comprehensive reviews of study-specific regulatory binders and clinical documents to verify they are accurately completed, submitted, and maintained per GCP standards.
  • Audit Execution & Tracking: Execute the yearly corporate audit plan, systematically tracking quality assurance audits, monitoring related activities, and preparing detailed outcome reports for management.
  • Issue Resolution & CAPA Management: Partner directly with research staff and Principal Investigators (PIs) to resolve identified compliance issues, developing, tracking, and monitoring Corrective and Preventative Action (CAPA) plans.
  • External Audit & Inspection Support: Coordinate and provide hands-on operational support for on-site audits and inspections conducted by external providers, sponsors, and regulatory agencies.
  • Quality Systems Administration: Provide ongoing administrative support to the Quality Department by maintaining internal quality systems, compliance trackers, and operational programs.

jobs.description:
About Welocalize

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.

About the Role

  • Welocalize is expanding its network of accessibility testers to validate the language-specific accessibility of localized digital content: web pages, applications, and documents.
  • You will serve as a native-language expert reviewer, confirming that accessibility elements not only survive translation but are accurate, understandable, and functional in the Chinese Simplified.
  • This role requires fluency in the target language, hands-on experience with assistive technology in that language, and familiarity with Digital Accessibility standards and guidelines such as PDF/UA, WCAG 2.1 & 2.2, and EN 301 549 to complement accessibility testing done internally.
  • Work is assigned on a project basis. You will receive a defined scope, a testing checklist, and access credentials. Findings are reported in a structured defect log and specific bug tracking system.

What You Will Do

The actual scope will vary by assignment, but the general extent of this role is outlined below.

  • Language Validation: Confirm correct language codes in HTML and PDF metadata, and identify mixed-language content missing proper declarations.
  • In-Language Screen Reader Testing: Using native-language screen readers (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver, TalkBack, or Narrator), review translated accessible text — including hidden elements, tooltips, error messages, alt text, and UI labels — for accuracy, natural phrasing, and clarity when read aloud.
  • Multimedia Accessibility Review: Evaluate captions, transcripts, and audio descriptions for accuracy, synchronization, and natural language, and confirm multimedia controls are properly labeled in the target language.
  • Defect Reporting: Log findings with WCAG/PDF-UA references, supporting screenshots or recordings, and severity classifications; participate in review calls with the QA Lead as needed.

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • Native or near-native fluency in Chinese Simplified; you are the authoritative voice on whether translated content reads naturally and is understandable.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience testing digital content with assistive technology/AT.
  • Working knowledge of WCAG 2.1 & 2.2 AA and EN 301 549.
  • Ability to evaluate content from a native-speaker accessibility perspective — not just technical compliance, but real-world usability for screen reader users who speak the language.
  • Reliable access to relevant devices and operating systems to replicate real-world usage in the target locale.

Nice to have

  • Strong written communication skills in English for defect reporting and general communications.
  • Experience with PDF accessibility testing using PAC 3 or Adobe Acrobat Pro Accessibility Checker.
  • Familiarity with internationalization, localization, and translation workflows; understanding of how accessibility elements can be affected during format conversion.
  • Personal use of assistive technology.

Tools and Environment

  • Welocalize provides access credentials and a structured test plan per engagement. Testers are expected to supply their own device and assistive technology setup appropriate to the target locale.
  • Commonly used tools in this role include:
    • Screen readers: JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver (macOS/iOS), TalkBack (Android), Narrator (Windows)
    • Browser/screen reader pairings aligned to the target locale's most common usage patterns
    • Caption and transcript review: native video players, .srt/.vtt file review
    • PDF accessibility: PAC 3, Adobe Acrobat Pro (provided where required)
    • Defect logging: Jira bug tracking system is most frequently used

What to Expect

  • Assignments are project-based with clear scope documents, test checklists, and agreed turnaround timelines provided before work begins.
  • Scope for each engagement will specify the exact language, content type, pages or documents in scope, and priority areas.
  • You will not be expected to remediate or fix issues; your role is testing and reporting.
  • Welocalize values feedback: if checklist items are unclear or a finding falls outside the defined scope, flag it and we will address it.

How to Apply

  • Click on Apply Now button and share with us the following:
    • A brief introduction covering your language, screen reader experience, and accessibility background.
    • Any relevant certifications (CPACC, WAS, DHS Trusted Tester, or equivalent).

About the Role:

We're looking for a Vice President of Marketing to build and develop the Genea brand and lead our marketing function - a brand-forward leader whose superpower is channel marketing.

Reporting to the CEO and partnering closely with our executive leadership team, you'll own how Genea shows up in the world: our brand, positioning, channel and partner marketing, field events, and product marketing. Channel marketing is the most important part of this role. Genea runs two distinct go-to-market motions, a sell-through (channel/partner) motion and a sell-to (direct, end-user) motion, that call for different marketing styles, so you'll need to be agile across both and know when to apply which. Additionally, Genea services Enterprise, Mid-market, and commercial customer segments and our marketing motion will need to be tailored to targeting and activating these different segments effectively – ABX at the top, more traditional automated motions in commercial.

You'll lead an established, talented team that carries day-to-day demand generation and revenue-marketing execution, which frees you to focus on brand-building, the channel, and shaping strategy. Marketing here partners with a sales-led revenue motion, influencing and supporting pipeline rather than owning the number - so you'll thrive if you love building brand and channel in a partner-driven business.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own and develop Genea's brand strategy, positioning, and identity, and lead the in-progress brand refresh through to a modernized website and content system.
  • Lead channel and partner marketing (the heart of this role) driving demand through and with integrators, resellers, and technology partners via co-marketing, partner enablement, MDF/co-op programs, and a partner advisory board.
  • Orchestrate marketing across both go-to-market motions: sell-through (through partners) and sell-to (direct to end users), applying the right approach to each.

  • Partner with Sales to influence and report on marketing-sourced and -influenced pipeline, and help build account-level (ABM) reporting suited to a channel model.
  • Bridge marketing's stake in reporting and the martech stack until a dedicated RevOps function matures.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow the marketing team, building a collaborative, high-accountability culture, and own the marketing budget and ROI reporting.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This role leads the marketing team and carries full supervisory responsibility of the department including brand, demand generation, product marketing, partner marketing, and event marketing. The VP is accountable for hiring, development, performance management, and organizational design as the team scales.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Deep, hands-on channel marketing expertise — this is what matters most to us. You know how to market through a sell-through / channel (two-tier distribution) model, and you're equally comfortable marketing direct to end users.
  • 10-12+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience, with brand-building at the center and a track record of supporting revenue growth.
  • Proven brand-building leadership, including leading brand refreshes and modernizing positioning and identity.
  • Strong partner marketing background — co-marketing, partner enablement, and MDF/co-op programs.
  • A deep understanding of field and industry events as brand and pipeline drivers.
  • Product marketing and launch experience, including sales enablement and messaging.
  • Fluency in ABX marketing operations and attribution (Salesforce), with the ability to partner on and bridge reporting until a dedicated RevOps function matures.
  • Proven people leadership: building, mentoring, and scaling marketing teams.
  • Executive presence and the credibility to influence a leadership team.
  • You thrive building brand and channel in a business where marketing influences and supports revenue in partnership with sales, rather than owning the pipeline number.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 25% for events, partner engagements, and conferences.

Additional Skills & Attributes:

  • Brand-first mindset paired with commercial awareness of how marketing supports revenue.
  • Strategic thinker, who can also roll up their sleeves in a scaling environment.
  • Skilled at influencing without authority and aligning cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong communicator and storyteller in internal, partner-facing, and executive settings.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and building structure where none yet exists.
  • Passion for, and proven track record of, AI-enabled marketing & execution. Genea is an early, holistic adopter of AI and we are looking for a leader who is aligned with this approach.

How Success Is Measured

Performance in this role is evaluated on the strength of the brand and marketing function and on marketing's contribution to the business, including:

  • Brand health, awareness, and consistency, and successful execution of the brand refresh and website modernization.
  • Channel- and partner-sourced and -influenced pipeline, and partner program engagement.
  • Field and industry event outcomes — brand lift, meetings, and influenced pipeline.
  • Marketing's influence on net-new logo pipeline, in partnership with sales.
  • Team growth, retention, and development.
  • Cross-functional alignment and organizational trust in marketing's reporting.
  • On-budget delivery and improving cost-per-outcome across the portfolio.

Estimated Salary Range: $200,000-$240,000

The salary range listed is our best estimate based on the role's requirements and market conditions. The final offer may be higher or lower depending on the candidate's experience and qualifications.

jobs.description:
Location: Remote
Job Type: Full-Time
Salary: [Competitive – Based on Experience]

About the Founder Institute:

TheFounder Institute (FI) is a global network of startup incubators, accelerators, and investors on a mission to activate and empower communities of entrepreneurs worldwide.

Since 2009, we’ve helped launch over 8,000 companies in 200+ cities globally, which have raised nearly $2BN in funding. We are based in Silicon Valley and have remote team members across the United States, Europe, India, and Brazil. Our success has been documented in the New York Times, BusinessWeek, Forbes, TechCrunch, and more.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Support & Marketing Associate with a passion for startups and entrepreneurship to join our team.

You will have the opportunity to see entrepreneurship and venture capital from many angles, and work for a company with a small and mission-driven team.

This role is 100% remote, and will require a Sunday-Thursday workweek.

Our Culture:

At the Founder Institute, we work a lot like the early-stage startups we support. That means things move fast, and we thrive on creativity, ownership, and a “let’s figure it out” mindset. Here’s what we look for in our team:

  • You’re naturally entrepreneurial, self-motivated, and enjoy tackling challenges head-on.
  • You prefer autonomy over hand-holding and don’t need a lot of oversight to get things done.
  • You love learning new things, and when you hit a roadblock, your first instinct is to dig in, research, and find a solution—Google is your best friend.
  • You’re open to feedback (even when it’s tough), and always looking to grow and improve—both personally and as part of the team.

If that sounds exciting to you, we’d love to hear from you. If not, no hard feelings—this kind of environment isn’t for everyone.

Still with us? Great—read on for more details!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Customer Support & Engagement: Respond promptly and professionally to customer inquiries, offering personalized assistance and proactive support.
  • Assist with Program Admissions: Review applications to FI incubation and acceleration programs, and follow best practices for acceptance.
  • Improve the Customer Experience: As our “feet on the ground”, your ideas will play a critical role in our ability to improve our customer experience.
  • Host Live Q&A Calls: Host scheduled Q&A sessions with customers, addressing their concerns and providing expert guidance on our products/services.
  • Host Info-Session Webinars: Conduct and facilitate informative webinars to educate customers on key topics, program qualities, and best practices.
  • Improve Conversion & Retention: Coordinate with the design and product teams to improve the usability and conversion of the website and overall conversion rate optimization (CRO). Coordinate with the marketing team on initiatives to increase conversion and retention.
  • Improve Site and Email Copy: Update and improve copy across our marketing materials to properly address the changing needs of our customers.
  • Maintain Organized Documentation & Processes: Track customer interactions, document frequently asked questions, and provide feedback to improve processes.

Qualifications and Skills:

Required:

  • Willing to work a Sunday-Thursday schedule
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Business-level fluency in English
  • Comfort in hosting live calls and webinars
  • Internet and computer-savvy

Preferred:

  • Knowledge of startup accelerators and the startup/ venture capital industry
  • 2+ years of professional customer service and/or marketing experience
  • Experience using Google Suite, Powerpoint, Excel, Canva, Mailchimp, and various online CRM and marketing tool

What We Offer:

  • Great upward mobility into a larger, conversion-focused marketing role (all senior team members at FI have grown into their roles from inside the company)
  • Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience.
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere with the autonomy to drive results in your own style.

  • Ability to learn from top entrepreneurs, investors, and executives throughout FI’s global network and suite of acceleration programs.

IMPORTANT: In your Cover Letter please write two paragraphs, the first on why you would like to work in the startup accelerator industry, and the second on how your personality fits well with the FI culture described above. Applications without this Cover Letter will be ignored.

über uns

deine aufgaben

  • Du erkennst Potenziale, wo andere nur Daten sehen. Deine Mission ist es, mit Smartness und Mut neue Kunden zu entdecken – und ihnen zu zeigen, wie unsere Lösung ihren Alltag revolutioniert. Outbound? Ja! Aber nicht von der Stange – du nutzt clevere Tools, moderne Playbooks und unsere Lernkultur, um echte Leads zu gewinnen.

dein profil

Ziel: Die richtigen Menschen aktivieren – und andere bewusst filtern.

  • Macher:innen, die gern auf Menschen zugehen
  • Smarte Kommunikator:innen mit Bock auf Vertrieb
  • Menschen mit Drive, nicht nur mit „Sales-Erfahrung“
  • Leute, die lernen wollen – und keine Angst vor Kaltakquise haben

  • …Menschen begeistern kannst – mit Klarheit, Neugier und ehrlichem Interesse.

jobs.description:
Pro další rozvoj našich aktivit a vylepšení naší pozice na trhu v oblasti průmyslové robotiky hledáme nyní nového kolegu do českého obchodního týmu pro jihozápadní část České republiky.

Co od vás očekáváme, hlavní odpovědnosti:

  • Odpovědnost za udržování, rozvoj a samozřejmě i růst obchodních aktivit ve svěřeném regionu.
  • Plnění prodejních cílů v definované oblasti, která bude zahrnovat přibližně tyto kraje: ZČ, JČ, KV, UL, VY.
  • Identifikace obchodních příležitostí v oblasti robotiky – zákazníci z řad výrobců zařízení (OEM), koncových uživatelů (End Users) a systémových integrátorů (SI)
  • Prodej a propagace celého portfolia produktů divize Stäubli Robotics.
  • Zvyšování tržního podílu společnosti Stäubli v segmentu všeobecného průmyslu.
  • Průzkum trhu včetně analýzy zákazníků a konkurence.
  • Důslednost ve vkládání a udržování dat v CRM sytému.
  • Účast na průmyslových veletrzích a konferencích.
  • Kooperace v týmu divize Robotics.
  • Cestování a osobní schůzky se zákazníky 3 až 4 dny v týdnu.

Jaké znalosti a dovednosti byste měli mít:

  • Minimálně 3 roky úspěšné zkušenosti v B2B prodeji v oblasti robotiky, průmyslové automatizace nebo obdobném technicky zaměřeném obchodním prostředí. Rádi si poslechneme, jak a kde.
  • Dobré technické povědomí v oblasti robotiky nebo průmyslové automatizace. Spoustu vás toho naučíme, ale potřebujeme na něco navázat.
  • Schopnost týmové spolupráce i samostatné práce (včetně organizace služebních cest, plánování schůzek se zákazníky, rozvoje obchodních příležitostí a správy svěřeného regionu).
  • Výborné komunikační a prezentační dovednosti. Schopnost se domluvit a vysvětlit přidanou hodnotu našich řešení.
  • Pozitivní přístup, samostatnost, odolnost vůči stresu a schopnost vlastní motivace. I k velkým plánům a projektům se dojde postupnými kroky a mravenčí prací.
  • Řidičský průkaz skupiny B a ochota cestovat (primárně ČR ale i mimo ni). Bez výjezdů za zákazníky to nepůjde.
  • Uživatelská znalost CRM systému a MS Office. Zkušenost s jakýmkoliv CRM se počítá, důležitá je pečlivost a důslednost.
  • Komunikativní znalost anglického jazyka. Využijete v pravidelné komunikaci s německým vedoucím i s kolegy v rámci divize.
  • Znalost aplikací AGV/AMR (autonomních mobilních robotů), trhu a požadavků zákazníků v této oblasti. Není nutné, ale bude vaší výhodou;-)

Co vám můžeme nabídnout

  • Lokální pozici s mezinárodním přesahem.
  • Plně remote způsob práce.
  • Služební automobil i pro soukromé účely.
  • Moderní zázemí v nových kancelářích v Pardubicích na centrále.
  • Intenzivní adaptační a školicí program v České republice, Francii a Německu.
  • Firemní notebook, iPad, iPhone.
  • 25 dní dovolené.
  • Roční bonusový systém založený na transparentních KPI.
  • 2 dny volna navíc na podporu osobní pohody (wellbeing days).
  • Stravenky.
  • Benefity pro volný čas (Pluxee nebo Multisport karta).
  • Firemní akce, teambuildingy a dobrovolnické aktivity.

Stäubli je švýcarská rodinná společnost s více než 6 000 zaměstnanci po celém světě. Působíme ve 28 zemích, zastoupení máme v 50 zemích na čtyřech kontinentech a od roku 2005 sídlí naše centrála pro střední a jihovýchodní Evropu v Pardubicích. Vyrábíme a dodáváme spolehlivá mechatronická řešení v oblastech rychlospojek pro kapaliny (Fluid Connectors), elektrických konektorů (Electrical Connectors) a robotiky (Robotics). Spolupracujeme se zákazníky z různých odvětví od automotive, potravinářství až po farmaciii a poskytujeme jim komplexní řešení s dlouhodobou podporou. The leader will oversee transformation across manufacturing, quality, supply chain, finance, human capital, commercial operations, and other enterprise functions. The role will provide strategic direction for enterprise architecture, ERP and business application modernization, data and integration capabilities, technology operating models, and the lifecycle management of major enterprise software platforms and licenses.

As a senior member of the IT leadership team, this leader will partner with executive stakeholders to establish priorities, govern complex programs, manage CapEx and OpEx investments, and ensure that technology initiatives deliver sustainable business value. The role will also lead technology due diligence and integration activities associated with mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and other significant corporate transactions.

The ideal candidate combines the strategic perspective of a transformation consultant with the operating discipline of an enterprise IT executive. The role requires demonstrated success leading large-scale ERP transformations, commercial transformation, international invoicing and reporting programs, and technology modernization within medical device, healthcare, life sciences, or similarly regulated environments.

Key Accountabilities

IT and Digital Transformation Strategy

  • Define and lead the multi-year IT and digital transformation roadmap, aligned with corporate growth objectives, operating priorities, and global business requirements.

Enterprise Architecture and Platform Modernization

  • Own the enterprise architecture direction for business applications, data, integration, middleware, and related technology platforms.

Commercial and Customer-Facing Transformation

  • Lead the technology strategy for commercial transformation, including the optimization of CRM, sales operations, customer service, marketing, analytics, and revenue-enablement capabilities.

We are currently seeking a Oracle EBS Technical Consultant - Remote to join our team in Jacksonville, Florida (US-FL), United States (US).

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) Technical Consultant to design, develop, enhance, and support Oracle EBS solutions, with a strong focus on Procurement, Purchasing, Accounts Payable, and Employee Expense Management.

The ideal candidate will have deep hands-on experience with Oracle EBS R12/R12.2, SQL/PLSQL, interfaces, reports, workflows, concurrent programs, and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes. This role will work closely with functional consultants, finance and procurement teams, business users, and integration teams to deliver scalable technical solutions and provide production support.

  • Design, develop, enhance, and support Oracle EBS R12/R12.2 technical solutions, primarily across Procurement and Expense Management.
  • Develop and maintain technical solutions for Oracle Purchasing (PO), iProcurement, Accounts Payable (AP), and Internet Expenses (iExpenses).

  • Develop and maintain PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, triggers, SQL queries, and database objects.
  • Develop and support BI Publisher/XML Publisher, Oracle Reports, and data extracts for procurement, purchasing, invoices, and employee expenses.

  • Strong understanding of end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) business processes.

  • Strong knowledge of Oracle EBS tables and data relationships across PO, AP, iProcurement, iExpenses, suppliers, and General Ledger.

  • Experience supporting testing, release management, code migrations, and production deployments.
  • Ability to translate functional requirements into detailed technical designs and development solutions.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Experience with Oracle Application Framework (OAF) development, personalization, and extensions.

Remote

Oracle EBS R12/R12.2 | Oracle Procurement | Purchasing/PO | iProcurement | Accounts Payable | iExpenses | SQL | PL/SQL | BI Publisher | XML Publisher | Oracle Workflow | Concurrent Programs | Interfaces | Conversions | Oracle APIs | P2P | OAF | Oracle Forms/Reports | AME | Oracle GL | OIC | REST/SOAP | Production Support

A concise summary of why the job exists and what the job is to accomplish.

Solution Managers support the Center of Excellence in their assigned domain/solution area. As owners of overarching system design and functionality, they are responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing the integrated systems and tools that support core business processes across the organization. They serve as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams; translating requirements into scalable, secure, and efficient solutions that enable revenue, operations, and customer-facing teams. This role leads discovery, solution design, and project delivery for enhancements and new systems, ensuring data integrity, adoption, and alignment with enterprise architecture and strategy. In addition, they continuously evaluate system performance to encourage process improvements, automation opportunities, and ROI on technology investments.

About the Role:

  • Owns the overarching system functionality and capabilities of their area, using stakeholder partnerships to facilitate system improvements and drive adoption.
  • Partners with Systems Specialists to evaluate technical feasibility, system constraints, and upstream/downstream impacts, designing scalable, best-practice workflows and rules.
  • Leads relevant system capabilities development roadmaps, driving key business outcomes through capabilities prioritization and backlog management. Communicates roadmap strategy to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Works with stakeholders to identify & document business needs, develop acceptance criteria for new functionality, and communicate project progress

  • Adept in driving adoption and change management (training, documentation, communication plans)
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills
  • Inclination toward proactive action and has a take-charge mindset.
  • Expert relationship-building and facilitation skills to collaborate cross-functionally and drive team alignment.

Bluebeam is committed to building an inclusive environment in which everyone, regardless of background, has an opportunity to experience a deep sense of belonging. And when we bring the best version of ourselves to work, we can make our best contributions to the global community of people who build our world.​ ​​​​​​​

At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

About the Clinician Network

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.

Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

All applicants to the Clinician Network are kept in our active pipeline, and you’ll also receive our monthly Clinician Network newsletter, which shares updates and upcoming openings.

About the Role

Cogstate Clinicians are clinical psychologists or neuropsychologists responsible for delivering remote clinical interviews and cognitive assessment batteries to subjects with preclinical dementia, enrolled in a pharmaceutical clinical trial.

Cogstate provides all consultants with comprehensive, fully compensated training on general Cogstate operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing skills and virtual cognitive assessment prior to performing remote scale administrations. Regular supervision and ongoing recalibration of clinical skill set will be provided.

*Hired employee will work on an as needed basis based on their schedule.

Central Rating

  • Scoring completed scale administrations.
  • Participating in regular clinical skill recalibration activities.

Central Monitoring

  • Providing reviews of completed neuropsychological test batteries for central monitoring of data to ensure accuracy in administration and scoring and contribute to the overall success of a clinical trial.
  • Reviewing response forms and recordings of remote scale administrations and offering feedback to raters via email and telephone communications.

Qualifications & Expertise

  • MD, DO, MBBS or PhD, PsyD in Psychology or RN, APRN, PA, MA/MS/MSW in Psychiatry (or equivalent)

  • Direct experience with cognitive/behavioral/functional assessment of neurological/psychiatric populations

  • Proficiency with MS Office, including Word and Excel, email, teleconference platforms such as Skype, Zoom or other similar applications, and cloud-based storage service.
  • Swedish Fluency
  • MADRS Administration Experience Required

We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

The Opportunity:
CACI is seeking a Mid-Level Scrum Master to support one or more Agile teams delivering software enhancements and modernization capabilities for the Grant Solutions program. This role facilitates effective Scrum events, coaches team members in Agile practices, removes impediments, promotes transparency, and helps the team continuously improve its delivery of high-quality outcomes. The individual will collaborate with Product Owners, technical leads, Federal stakeholders, vendors, and cross-functional delivery teams while operating with guidance from program and Agile leadership.


Responsibilities:

The Mid-Level Scrum Master will help Agile teams plan, execute, and improve delivery across a complex federal technology environment. The Scrum Master will create productive team routines, reinforce Agile values and Scrum practices, maintain visibility into progress and risks, and help resolve blockers that affect sprint goals.

This is a hands-on role suited for a candidate who can independently support a delivery team while escalating broader organizational issues when needed. The individual will work closely with the Product Owner to promote backlog readiness, coordinate dependencies, use delivery metrics appropriately, and foster a respectful, self-managing, and continuously improving team environment.

The Scrum Master will:

  • Facilitate Scrum events, including sprint planning, daily Scrum, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and backlog refinement sessions.

  • Coach team members on Agile values, Scrum practices, self-management, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

  • Partner with the Product Owner to support clear sprint goals, a transparent and prioritized backlog, and well-understood backlog items.

  • Identify, track, and help remove impediments; escalate issues that require program, stakeholder, or organizational action.

  • Protect the team from unnecessary disruption while promoting productive engagement with stakeholders and dependent teams.

  • Monitor sprint progress, delivery trends, risks, dependencies, and team health using practical Agile metrics and visual management tools.

  • Facilitate conversations that resolve conflict, clarify expectations, and strengthen collaboration across business and technical participants.

  • Coordinate cross-team dependencies and support release planning, demonstrations, testing readiness, and incremental delivery activities.

  • Help the team maintain agreed working practices, quality expectations, and a clear Definition of Done.

  • Promote data-informed retrospectives and follow through on measurable improvement actions.

  • Maintain concise delivery artifacts, including team boards, impediment and risk logs, dependency tracking, action items, and stakeholder updates.

  • Ensure Agile delivery activities and team artifacts align with applicable federal IT governance requirements, including the HHS Enterprise Performance Life Cycle (EPLC), required reviews, deliverables, approvals, and stage-gate expectations.

  • Support Agile adoption and consistent delivery practices across a multi-team, multi-vendor federal program.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Federal Public Trust; candidates must receive approved adjudication before onboarding. An active Public Trust or suitability determination is preferred.

  • Bachelor’s degree required.

  • Minimum of four (4) years of experience supporting Agile software development, technology delivery, or IT modernization teams, including at least two (2) years serving as a Scrum Master or Agile team facilitator.

  • Working knowledge of Scrum events, accountabilities, artifacts, commitments, and empirical delivery practices.

  • Demonstrated experience facilitating Agile ceremonies and helping teams address impediments, dependencies, delivery risks, and improvement opportunities.

  • Ability to coach team members constructively without directing or assigning work.

  • Experience partnering with Product Owners on sprint goals, backlog refinement, readiness, and stakeholder collaboration.

  • Understanding of the software development life cycle, iterative delivery, testing, release coordination, and DevSecOps concepts.

  • Working knowledge of federal IT governance and project life-cycle controls, including the ability to support compliance with HHS EPLC documentation, review, approval, and stage-gate requirements.

  • Ability to track and communicate delivery metrics, risks, dependencies, decisions, and action items clearly.

  • Strong facilitation, communication, conflict-resolution, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with business, technical, operational, vendor, and government stakeholders.

  • Adaptable, team-oriented, and able to work effectively in a fast-paced, regulated environment with moderate supervision.

  • Proficiency with Agile delivery and collaboration tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, SharePoint, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft PowerPoint

Desired:

  • Experience with AWS cloud, Java, and .NET

  • Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master I (PSM I), SAFe Scrum Master, or comparable Agile certification.

As we scale, we are strengthening our clinical annotation and validation efforts to ensure our models remain accurate, relevant, and tightly aligned with real-world oncology care. To support this expansion, we are seeking an experienced Physician Annotator to play a critical role in the development and continuous improvement of our clinical AI solutions.

This role combines hands-on nuclear medicine imaging study review, structured clinical annotation, and thoughtful product feedback to ensure AI models are clinically accurate, reliable, and aligned with real-world care delivery. The Physician Annotator will serve as a key bridge between clinical practice, data science, and product teams - bringing practical expertise to annotation standards, model validation, workflow evaluation, and performance refinement.

As part of a fast-moving, clinically grounded AI team, you will directly contribute to how advanced imaging technologies are translated into trusted tools that support physician decision-making and improve cancer care delivery at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Expertise

  • As a subject matter expert contribute to the development and refinement of annotation protocols and clinical guidelines for different use cases.

  • Identify edge cases, ambiguities, and potential sources of bias in clinical data and model behavior

  • Participate in applied clinical AI research, including hypothesis development and evaluation of model performance.

  • Assist in generating research insights that may inform internal studies, publications, or regulatory documentation

Clinical Annotation & Validation

  • Perform reviews of nuclear medicine imaging exams and provide clinical insight and annotations to support AI model training and refinement. Clinical review tasks include review of studies with and without AI assistance for identification and delineation of areas of interest on a variety of nuclear medicine images (e.g., FDG, PSMA-PET/CT, SPECT) with precision and accuracy.

  • Validate AI outputs for clinical accuracy, safety, and relevance across defined use cases.

  • Review model errors and edge cases; provide structured clinical insights to improve performance.

  • Advise on clinically meaningful metrics, thresholds, and evaluation criteria.

Strategic product feedback

  • Provide concise, actionable clinical feedback on product features and workflows.

  • Advise product teams on feature prioritization based on clinical impact, risk, and feasibility.

  • Support retrospective and prospective analyses to assess clinical validity and real-world utility of AI models.

  • Evaluate usability and workflow integration from a clinician’s perspective.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate asynchronously with clinical, product, and data science teams.

  • Serve as a part-time clinical advisor supporting rapid iteration and informed decision-making.

Why Join Nucs AI

  • Work at the frontier of clinical AI: Help advance next-generation oncology tools in nuclear molecular imaging.

  • Have real clinical influence: Your work and feedback directly shape model performance, product behavior, and clinical reliability.

  • High scientific rigor: Contribute to clinically grounded development with a strong focus on safety, accuracy, and real-world validity.

  • Collaborate with a high-caliber team: Work closely with clinicians, engineers, and data scientists who move fast and value clarity.

  • Flexible by design: Part-time, contract, and fully remote with flexible hours (location restrictions may apply).

Required Qualifications

Philo: a streaming service for TV and movie lovers

Philo is building a modern TV company that combines high-quality streaming technology with a clear point of view on value, simplicity, and the viewing experience. Our product now spans paid subscription plans, premium bundles, add-ons, and a growing free-channel experience - creating a business that sits at the intersection of product, content, subscriptions, billing, and a rapidly changing media landscape.

That mix creates unusually rich analytical problems. At Philo, strong business judgment matters just as much as technical depth: the best work helps leaders understand what is happening in the business, why it is happening, and what to do next.

Data and Business Insights at PhiloData underpins nearly every important decision at Philo. The company operates in an event-rich environment with large-scale behavioral, subscription, billing, and content data that inform work across acquisition, retention, product experience, streaming quality, pricing, content discovery, and long-term customer value.

Philo's data organization spans data science, data engineering, analytics engineering, and business-facing analytical partners who work closely with Finance, Product, Growth, Lifecycle Marketing, Content, Customer Experience, Operations, and other teams. As Philo continues to evolve its plan structure across paid plans, free channels, and add-ons - and as customers interact through both direct and partner billing experiences - trusted business insights become even more important.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Business Insights Analyst to help Philo make better, faster decisions through rigorous analysis, trusted metrics, and strong cross-functional partnership. This is a high-impact individual contributor role for someone who is equally comfortable owning recurring KPI reporting, diving into ambiguous ad-hoc questions, and presenting clear, decision-ready recommendations to senior stakeholders.

You will serve as a strategic analytical partner across multiple parts of the business, with especially deep ownership in billing and subscription analytics. That includes trial conversion, activation, renewals, churn, reactivation, plan migration, add-on behavior, pricing and packaging performance, refunds and credits, failed payments, involuntary churn, and the differences between direct and partner billing experiences. You will help Philo understand the health of its subscriber base and revenue streams in a way that connects clearly to action.

This role will also touch many other parts of the company. One week you may be helping Finance understand a revenue variance or size a packaging scenario; the next you may be partnering with Product on funnel friction, Growth on acquisition quality and retention, Content on engagement patterns, or Customer Experience on account and billing pain points. The ideal candidate combines analytical depth, business fluency, crisp communication, and a high bar for data quality. They do not wait to be told exactly what analysis to run - they refine the question, frame the decision, and deliver work people trust and use.

Responsibilities

  • Own and evolve the core business scorecards, dashboards, and ad-hoc analyses leaders use to monitor subscriber growth, revenue, billing health, retention, engagement, content performance, and monetization trends.

  • Build executive-ready materials that connect numbers to narrative, synthesize tradeoffs, and help technical and non-technical stakeholders make decisions with confidence.
  • Improve the quality and trustworthiness of business data by partnering with analytics engineering and data engineering on instrumentation, metric governance, source-of-truth logic, and data quality issues.
  • Help raise the analytical bar across the organization through clear documentation, thoughtful prioritization, and a pragmatic balance of speed and rigor.

Key Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in business insights, analytics, strategy analytics, finance analytics, business intelligence, or a closely related function.
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large-scale behavioral, subscription, billing, financial, or operational data sets.
  • Strong experience building data visualizations, dashboards, and self-serve reporting environments in BI tools such as Mode, Omni, Tableau, Looker, etc.
  • A proven track record of translating vague business questions into clear analyses, sharp recommendations, and polished decision-ready narratives and presentations.
  • Excellent spreadsheet skills in Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Strong analytical fundamentals across cohort analysis, funnel analysis, segmentation, retention and churn analysis, trend analysis, KPI design, forecasting support, anomaly detection, and practical experimentation or quasi-experimental measurement.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior stakeholders with different levels of technical fluency.
  • Strong stakeholder partnership skills and the ability to influence across Product, Finance, Marketing, Content, Operations, and technical teams.
  • A strong sense of ownership and prioritization: you can manage competing requests, separate urgent from important, and independently drive work forward.

Ideal Qualifications

  • Experience in subscription, streaming, media, entertainment, ad-supported products, or another event-rich consumer business.

  • Deep familiarity with subscription business metrics such as trials, conversion, churn, retention, winback, LTV, plan mix, and add-on attach.
  • Experience with billing, payments, dunning or retry flows, refunds and credits, and direct or partner-billing analytics.

  • Familiarity with modern data platforms and event-tracking environments such as Snowflake, dbt, Segment, Avo, GrowthBook, or similar tools.

More about Philo

At Philo, we’re a company that puts people first—both our subscribers and our team. We empower our colleagues to do their best work while supporting one another in pursuing shared goals. We value pragmatism, pride in our work, and passion, with transparency and openness as fundamental parts of our culture.

Philo offers 70+ top-rated networks, including AMC, BET, CMT, Comedy Central, Discovery Channel, Food Network, Hallmark Channel, HGTV, HISTORY, Investigation Discovery, Lifetime, MTV, Nickelodeon, OWN, VH1, We TV, and more. It also includes all the groundbreaking originals and blockbuster movies available with AMC+ and access to HBO Max Basic With Ads and discovery+. Our service also includes 100+ free channels and premium add-ons like STARZ and MGM+.

Our extensive library boasts over 85,000 titles, and our unlimited DVR allows users to save their favorite shows and movies for up to a year, skipping ads for a seamless viewing experience. Stream on up to three devices simultaneously, whether on your phone, tablet, laptop, or TV using Roku, Apple TV, Fire TV, Samsung TV, Android TV, Vizio TV, or Chromecast.

Philo is headquartered in San Francisco, with offices in New York City and Cambridge, MA. Our leadership team includes alums from HBO, Tubi, and Meraki, and is backed by NEA and industry partners like Warner Brothers Discovery, Paramount, AMC, and A&E.

Who We Are

Healthier Generation  is a leading children’s health non-profit that promotes equitable whole child health so that every mind, every body, and every young person can be healthy.  and ready to succeed.  We believe a dedicated, intensified movement that centers equity in health practices and policies wherever kids live, learn and play is required to achieve dramatic improvements in the health and the life outcomes of Black, Indigenous, People of Color, as well as communities experiencing deep poverty.

Healthier Generation works nationally and locally with schools and school districts, youth-serving organizations, businesses, and communities – building their capacity to create healthier environments where young people can thrive. Our work, in total, has reached more than 31 million children and meaningfully improved environments to support the physical, social, and emotional health of the next generation, especially those from underserved communities. Our programs are evidence-based and evidence-informed, supported by a robust digital/virtual/live training platform and action center, as well as direct-to-community services. Through Healthier Generation programs, products and services, more children nationwide are gaining the opportunity to build a healthy future.

Relationship Building and Partnership Engagement

Project Management and Implementation

  • Write and/or promote success stories, best practices, exemplars, and lessons learned to highlight program and organizational impact.

  • Advance HG’s Culture of Philanthropy by serving as an ambassador for the organization by fostering relationships with mission-aligned partners and increasing brand awareness through verbal and digital communications.

  • In partnership with Programs leadership, support regional/national strategy and assist in the development of concepts and proposals as needed.

You demonstrate passion for school and youth-serving organizations, health and wellness, quality standards and processes. 

  • We collaborate and support: You plan collaboratively; inviting others to brainstorm and contribute ideas. You share information and resources to ensure clarity and understanding. You offer differing perspectives, counterpoints, and ideas to improve outcomes. You support others to achieve goals by sharing expertise, skills, or resources.

  • We are aware of ourselves and others: You demonstrate self-awareness, self-management, social-awareness, and relationship management. You demonstrate understanding of and work to mitigate sources of bias. You recognize the ideas, contributions, and achievements of others. You elicit feedback and consider perspectives to understand the potential impacts of those affected by plans or decisions.

  • We think critically and act strategically: You ask questions to understand (ex: to gain clarity on roles and responsibilities, decision-making, project plans, etc.). You incorporate feedback in relevant areas (ex: processes, work products, or interpersonal relationships). You plan thoughtfully by seeking and incorporating applicable information (ex: research, feedback, evidence, experience, etc.). You assess risks and rewards, potential impacts, and alternative options when making strategic decisions.

  • We adapt and embrace change: You approach challenges with equanimity. You adapt to shifting priorities. You work to find solutions to identify problems or opportunities. You champion new ways to improve processes.

  • We build and cultivate relationships: You Acknowledges others’ experiences, identities, and strengths. You facilitate interactions that result in new or enhanced collaborations. You practice active listening to understand, takes time to process information, and check your own bias. You take responsibility to build and repair trust.

  • We grow and improve: You foster a “safe to fail” environment where mistakes are acknowledged and learned from. You seek and implement feedback to grow. You actively pursue professional development around diversity, inclusion, equity, belonging, and skills relevant to job responsibility area(s). You incorporate learnings (e.g., professional development, feedback, research, etc.) into work processes and outputs.

  • Strong understanding of customer events, user attributes, audience segmentation, and lifecycle marketing use cases
  • Experience with reverse ETL tools such as Hightouch or Census

Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.

Brown & Brown is seeking aProgram Manager – Infrastructure & Operations Portfolio to join our growing team in Daytona Beach, FL; Plano, TX or Remote for the right candidate.

 

The Program Manager for Infrastructure & Operations (I&O) is responsible for the planning, governance, and execution of a portfolio of enterprise technology initiatives that modernize, stabilize, and enhance the organization's infrastructure and operational capabilities. This role oversees programs spanning cloud services, networking, end-user computing, IT service management, and operational excellence, ensuring initiatives are aligned with business priorities, technology strategy, and operational objectives.

This role leads and develops a team of Project Managers, providing strategic direction, governance, coaching, and escalation support to ensure consistent execution and delivery across the I&O portfolio. In addition to portfolio and people leadership responsibilities, this role directly manages complex, high-impact infrastructure and operations initiatives that are critical to the organization's technology strategy and operational objectives.

How You Will Contribute: 

Portfolio & Program Leadership

  • Own and manage the Infrastructure & Operations project portfolio, ensuring alignment with enterprise strategy, technology roadmaps, operational priorities, and resource capacity.

  • Lead large-scale programs and transformations, including cloud adoption, data center modernization, network transformation, endpoint management, disaster recovery, operational resilience, and ITSM initiatives.

  • Partner with leadership to assess portfolio capacity, resource allocation, and delivery priorities across Infrastructure & Operations initiatives

  • Establish portfolio governance, executive reporting, and decision-making frameworks to monitor progress, risks, budgets, and delivery outcomes.

  • Monitor portfolio financial performance, including budgets, forecasts, capital expenditures, and operational spending

  • Drive cross-functional alignment and facilitate escalation resolution to maintain program momentum and achieve strategic objectives.

Leadership of Project Managers

  • Lead, coach, mentor, and develop a team of Project Managers supporting Infrastructure & Operations initiatives.

  • Provide direction, guidance, and escalation support to ensure successful project execution and delivery.

  • Promote consistent application of PMO methodologies, governance practices, reporting standards, and project management disciplines.

  • Conduct regular portfolio and project reviews to assess performance, resource needs, risks, and dependencies.

  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and delivery of excellence.

Project & Program Delivery

  • Directly lead complex Infrastructure & Operations projects and programs, including cloud migrations, infrastructure modernization, network transformation, disaster recovery, endpoint management, and ITSM initiatives, through the full project lifecycle.

  • Define project scope, objectives, success criteria, milestones, budgets, resource requirements, and delivery plans in partnership with business and technology stakeholders.

  • Develop and maintain project plans, RAID logs, communication plans, executive status reports, and other project governance artifacts for assigned initiatives.

  • Provide delivery of leadership and oversight for projects managed by other Project Managers, ensuring alignment with portfolio priorities, governance standards, and organizational objectives.

  • Coordinate cross-functional teams, vendors, and stakeholders to manage dependencies, mitigate risks, resolve issues, and drive successful outcomes.

  • Evaluate trade-offs between cost, complexity, operational impact, risk, and business value to support effective decision-making.

  • Ensure initiatives are delivered in accordance with enterprise architecture, security requirements, operational standards, and service-level objectives.

Cross-Functional & Executive Collaboration

  • Partner with technology, business, finance, security, compliance, and operations leaders to align initiatives with organizational objectives.

  • Build strong stakeholder relationships and provide clear executive communication regarding portfolio health, risks, decisions, and outcomes.

  • Support portfolio planning, budgeting, forecasting, and governance activities across Infrastructure & Operations.

Risk, Compliance & Change Management

  • Identify and mitigate risks related to operational stability, security, compliance, and technology delivery.

  • Ensure programs adhere to governance standards, change management processes, and operational policies.

  • Serve as the escalation point for portfolio-level risks, issues, and cross-functional conflicts.

  • Partner with Security, Compliance, and Audit teams to support regulatory and governance requirements.

Operational Readiness & Transition

  • Ensure infrastructure solutions are successfully transitioned into operational support through documentation, training, and knowledge transfer.

  • Validate operational readiness, including support models, monitoring, service management processes, and recovery procedures.

  • Coordinate transition activities with Engineering, Operations, and Service Desk teams to ensure service continuity and adoption.

  • Conduct post-implementation reviews and incorporate lessons learned into future initiatives.

Skills & Experience to be Successful:
Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, business, or related field.

  • 8+ years of experience in IT program or portfolio management, including experience leading Infrastructure & Operations initiatives.

  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects, programs, or portfolios with cross-functional dependencies.

  • Experience leading, mentoring, or developing Project Managers and delivery teams.

  • Working knowledge of infrastructure and operations disciplines, including cloud services, networking, compute, storage, endpoint management, IT service management, and operational support models.

  • Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.

  • Experience with portfolio governance, executive reporting, budgeting, and resource planning.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities in complex, fast-paced environments.

Preferred

  • Experience leading enterprise infrastructure transformation or modernization programs.

  • PMP, PgMP, PfMP, PMI-ACP, or similar project, program, or portfolio management certification.

  • ITIL certification or experience working within ITIL-aligned environments.

  • Experience with Azure, AWS, or hybrid cloud environments.

  • Experience with portfolio management (PPM) tools and enterprise governance frameworks.

  • Experience supporting organizations undergoing significant technology or operational transformation.

Pay Range

140,000.00 - 140,000.00 Annual

The pay range provided above is made in good faith and based on our lowest and highest annual salary or hourly rate paid for the role and takes into account years of experience required, geography, and/or budget for the role.

Teammate Benefits & Total Well-Being

We go beyond standard benefits, focusing on the total well-being of our teammates, including:

  • Health Benefits: Medical/Rx, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Disability Insurance
  • Financial Benefits: ESPP; 401k; Student Loan Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement

As Lead Legal Counsel, Employment, you’ll serve as a senior legal advisor to GitLab on matters spanning the full employment relationship, from recruiting and onboarding through compensation, performance, leave management, separation, and, when necessary, litigation. You’ll provide practical, business-focused guidance that helps GitLab manage legal risk and meet business needs across a globally distributed, all-remote organization.

in addition, we value

  • Feed market and competitive intelligence back into commercial and product teams (deal losses, objections, competitor positioning).

  • Mid-market to enterprise organizations in Europe undertaking digital/AI transformation, with active engineering or AI governance budget.
  • Priority sectors: financial services, insurance, logistics, and other DORA/regulated environments where SmartDev's AI solutions and engineering services are differentiated.
  • Buying signals: active AI adoption initiatives, regulatory pressure (EU AI Act, DORA), engineering capacity gaps, or existing offshore/ODC relationships ready to be displaced.

What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)

  • Territory and account list defined and validated within the first 4–6 weeks.
  • Outbound cadence live and generating qualified meetings on a weekly rhythm by month 2.
  • Pipeline coverage consistently at or above target ratio against quota by month 3–4.

First new-logo signed within 2–3 months; quota-carrying run-rate established by month 9.

Required Experience

  • 7+ years in B2B new-business sales (BDM/hunter, not primarily account management), ideally in IT services, software development, SaaS, or AI/data solutions.
  • Demonstrable track record of building pipeline from scratch and closing net-new logos against a quota — not just working inbound or inherited accounts.

  • A genuine hunting mandate with clear motivation under an approved 2026 commission plan.
  • A differentiated story to sell — SmartDev as an AI solutions partner built on genuine engineering-services roots.
  • Direct access to leadership, fast decision-making, and a partner ecosystem actively feeding opportunities into Europe.
  • A structured, data-driven sales organization: proper KPI dashboards, forecasting cadence, and support from Pre-sales, AM, and Marketing rather than a bare-bones setup.

SmartDev is an AI-powered software development company headquartered in Vietnam, part of the Verysell Group. We help global businesses deliver faster and build smarter — combining AI-driven development practices with deep expertise across fintech, healthcare, retail, and enterprise technology. Our team of engineers, architects, and AI specialists works across the full stack: from custom software and cloud solutions to generative AI, MLOps, and intelligent automation. At SmartDev, we believe that great architecture and AI-first thinking are a competitive advantage — and we build our teams accordingly.

The company is at a pivotal point in our journey: transitioning from a pure IT outsourcing provider to an AI-enabled solutions partner.

What we are looking for

This is what you will do

Chiesi Global Rare disease is recruiting for a Senior Analytical Scientist with deep expertise in development of complex analytical methods including bioassays and cell-based potency assays for the characterization of ATMP including oligonucleotides, lipid nanoparticle (LNP) based products and other modalities.

In this role, you will be a key member of the CMC Extended Technical Team (ETT) , operating in a matrix organisation and responsible for driving analytical development and control strategy for gene editing products within the GRD function from candidate selection though clinical development and toward commercial launch, while also supporting lifecycle management activities.

  • Actively contributing to the advancement of the project being a key player within the CMC team and ensuring compliance with overall program, budget and regulatory strategy
  • Write, review, and approve technical documentation within the area of responsibility, including development protocols and reports, stability studies, deviation assessments, and relevant regulatory sections (IND, IMPD, IB)
  • Actively contributing to the development of the department in line with GRD and GRD R&D strategic goals, sharing knowledge, and best practices.

You will need to have

  • Minimum MSc in relevant field (biotechnology, biology, biochemistry or a related field)
  • 5-10 years of of experience in the biotech/pharmaceutical industry, with exposure to gene editing, CGT/ATMPs, nucleic acid-based products and lipid nano particles development,
  • Strong expertise in:
    • Cell-based assays and potency method development for gene editing platforms and/ or mRNA–LNP products and delivery-driven potency assays (critical requirement)
    • Advanced Bioanalytical Techniques, i.e. Cell-based assays (flow cytometry, reporter assays), Gene editing readouts, ligand binding assays, protein expression/quantification assays.
    • Statistical tools for assay performance
    • Bridging assays and reference standard qualification
    • Analytical method development, validation, and product characterization
    • Control strategy development for complex biologics
  • Proven experience managing outsourced analytical development activities (CROs/CDMOs), including:
    • Technical oversight, ensuring scientifically rigorous assay execution, data integrity and reproducibility
    • Troubleshooting and escalation management
    • Critical, data-driven performance follow-up
  • Solid understanding of GMP, regulatory requirements, and CMC development lifecycle.

The Company You’ll Join

We are a first-of-its-kind, category-defining software that is revolutionizing the commercial construction industry. The construction industry is being transformed fast by technology, but the way companies communicate costs hasn’t evolved in decades and still heavily relies on carbon copy paper, spreadsheets, and email to track billions of dollars. As an early member of the team, you will have an exceptional level of impact on the development and iteration of our Company and the workplace culture itself.
