About the job
Goods & Services is looking for a Tech Lead (Event-Driven Architecture) to define and guide the platform’s event-driven architecture, establishing scalable patterns, standards, and technical direction across multiple engineering teams. This role will drive key architectural decisions, ensure consistency across services and integrations, and enable teams to build reliable solutions against a stable, scalable foundation.

What you’ll do:

  • Own and guide architecture decisions across multiple engineering workstreams, ensuring consistency with the overall event-driven platform strategy.
  • Establish and govern event-driven architecture standards, including event infrastructure, schema management, messaging patterns, error handling, and standardized event structures.
  • Define and maintain domain event contracts and schemas to ensure consistency, compatibility, and scalability across current and future platform capabilities.
  • Partner with DevOps and engineering teams to define production rollout strategies, including traffic-ramp criteria, validation requirements, and stabilization periods.
  • Guide feature-flag and incremental deployment strategies, ensuring services can be introduced, validated, and rolled back safely without disruptive releases.
  • Review and govern schema and architectural changes, ensuring compatibility, quality, and appropriate testing before changes are introduced across dependent services.

What you’ll need:

  • Deep hands-on experience designing and implementing event-driven architectures on AWS, with experience using services such as EventBridge, SQS, Step Functions, and Schema Registry.
  • Proven experience leading incremental, feature-flagged migrations and modernization of legacy systems, using strategies such as the strangler-fig pattern while maintaining system availability.
  • Strong understanding of domain-driven event modeling, event contracts, and schema governance/versioning across multiple teams and services.
  • Experience providing technical leadership across multiple engineering teams or workstreams, including mentoring engineers, resolving cross-team dependencies, and unblocking complex technical challenges.
  • Strong experience with architectural governance and technical standards, including reviewing design changes, establishing engineering patterns, and ensuring consistency across distributed services.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems and cloud-native architectures, including asynchronous communication, service dependencies, fault tolerance, and reliable message processing.
  • Experience designing and integrating APIs and backend services within event-driven and service-oriented architectures.
  • Strong technical communication and decision-making skills, with the ability to communicate architectural trade-offs and align engineers and stakeholders around technical direction.
  • Experience designing safe deployment and rollout strategies, including feature flags, traffic ramping, validation criteria, and rollback approaches.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in lending, financial services, fintech, or risk management.

  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to communicate highly technical content verbally

  • Eager to work on a dynamic team, receive constructive feedback, and grow with us
  • Flexible and open to new ideas; ability to work with a highly collaborative team

  • An excellent writer who can write in a modern, active voice—make your cover letter compelling and write it well!

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

About the Role

You’ll design coding tasks that challenge frontier AI coding agents. Each task is a self-contained Docker environment with a broken piece of software; an AI agent attempts the fix; automated tests verify the outcome. Your deliverable is the full task package: broken code, tests, instructions, and a reference solution proving the task is solvable.

Responsibilities:

  • Invent a realistic developer scenario — a real bug, a broken ETL, a missing feature — not a toy problem.
  • Build a reproducible Docker environment with pinned dependencies.
  • Write a pytest that verifies outcomes, not specific commands — deterministic, non-flaky, and does not leak the fix.
  • Write an instruction.md that reads like a Jira ticket a developer would receive.
  • Write a reference solve.sh proving the task is solvable.
  • Calibrate difficulty so current state-of-the-art agents solve the task 20–60% of the time.
  • Iterate based on feedback from expert QA reviewers.
  • Later: review other authors’ tasks as a QA reviewer.

Not in scope

  • Data labeling, prompt engineering.
  • Production code to ship — you design problems and verification for AI agents.
  • Leetcode puzzles — scenarios must look like real developer work.
  • Not every candidate task ships — quality over quantity.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of production software development in one backend stack — Python, Go, Node.js, Java, or Rust. Depth in one stack beats breadth.
  • Python + pytest fluency — required regardless of primary stack. The task harness is pytest-based even when the broken app is in another language. Fixtures, parametrize, monkeypatch, timeouts, conftest.py.
  • Docker authoring — reproducible Dockerfiles, pinned dependencies, multi-stage builds when needed, non-root user.
  • Linux & Bash — comfort debugging inside containers (strace, lsof, journalctl); shell beyond set -euo pipefail.
  • AI coding agent experience — Claude Code, Cursor, Roo Code, or similar, on non-trivial work. You can cite a specific time the AI was confidently wrong and how you caught it.
  • English — B2+ written.

Not a fit

  • Data Science, ML, or Computer Vision engineers without backend-engineering output.
  • Manual QA testers without automation or test authoring.
  • Frontend-only, low-code / no-code, IT Support, or Business Analysts.
  • Engineers who have never written pytest from scratch.
  • Junior, intern, or assistant as the most recent role.

Preferred qualifications

  • Domain depth in Security, System Administration (nginx / systemd / cron), Scientific Computing (NumPy / PyTorch / SciPy), DevOps, or Git internals.
  • Modern Python tooling (uv, poetry, pyproject.toml).
  • Coverage tooling (pytest-cov, coverage.py, gcov, llvm-cov, kcov).
  • Fuzzing or property-based testing (Hypothesis).
  • Prior contribution to agent-evaluation benchmarks or related frameworks.

Process

Apply → Pass qualification (90-minute sample-task screen + short behavioral interview) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid.

Time commitment

  • Onboarding: ~10 hours per first task.
  • Steady state: ~5 hours per task, 2–4 parallel tasks per author.
  • Realistic weekly load: 8–20 hours. Higher volume available for top performers.
  • You choose when and how to contribute; tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet acceptance criteria.

Compensation:

  • Paid contributions, rates up to $35/hour*.
  • Task-based compensation equivalent to hourly rate, depending on performance and volume.
  • Some projects include incentive payments.

*Rates vary based on expertise, skills assessment, location, project needs, and other factors. Higher rates may be provided to highly specialized experts. Lower rates may apply during onboarding or non-core project phases. Payment details are shared per project.

Apply

Submit your CV via the Mindrift platform. Indicate your English level, note this role (Software Engineering Evaluation Specialist — Terminal Bench), and include a GitHub profile link if available.

jobs.excerpt: At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies.
jobs.description:
At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.

We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our $22m Series B round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.

We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.

About the Role

As a hands-on Engineering Manager of one of our feature teams at Ledgy, you'll lead the engineers who build the features that help companies offer, manage, and communicate compensation and savings vehicles: from equity plans to pensions, carry, and beyond. Your team works on the products employees and companies use to make sense of complex compensation structures, while you stay close enough to the work to help the team make strong technical and product decisions.

You’ll combine hands-on engineering leadership with thoughtful team development. The role is about staying close enough to the work to guide decisions, while creating the conditions for engineers to lead within their areas. AI-assisted engineering is a critical part of that leadership: you’ll help the team use AI tools deliberately, with strong judgment about when they accelerate delivery, improve quality, or require human oversight.

We hire remotely across the UK, Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania. For candidates based in London, we use a hybrid model with 2 days in the office per week.

Teams we’re hiring for:

  • Share & Fund Plans — Expands the product beyond classic equity compensation into broader ownership and executive compensation. The team focuses on flexible share and fund plan support, including deferred compensation, carry, pensions, savings plans, SAYE, SIP, ESPP, and related vesting flows — helping Ledgy become the single source of truth for every customer’s compensation schemes.

  • AI Systems — Develops Ledgy’s AI foundations and product experiences, from AI agents and AI-assisted workflows to the platform capabilities that help other teams embed AI safely in their domains. The team works in a new and evolving product area, balancing rapid iteration with reliable execution, evaluation tooling, and responsible automation.

  • Tax — Ensures taxes are correctly reflected throughout equity operations, especially moments such as exercising, selling, mobility, and other taxable events. As a future team, Tax will build end-to-end product capabilities across the stack, helping customers manage complex tax and compliance requirements accurately across jurisdictions.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and coach a team of engineers, including regular 1:1s, feedback, and performance conversations
  • Set technical and product direction with your team, rather than defining every answer yourself
  • Stay involved in execution through code reviews, architecture discussions, and selective hands-on contributions
  • Partner with Product and Design to turn complex domain needs into clear, usable product experiences
  • Model responsible AI-assisted engineering practices and help the team apply them in day-to-day work

You'll Thrive in This Role If You

  • Have 2+ years in Engineering Management and 6+ years as a Software Engineer, with meaningful time in product-focused or domain-heavy roles
  • Enjoy developing people and creating an environment where engineers can do their best work
  • Prefer leadership roles where you can stay technically engaged rather than manage from a distance
  • Use AI tools in your own engineering work and think critically about their strengths, limitations, and responsible use
  • Are energised by features that have a direct, visible impact on end users
  • Care deeply about correctness in domains where getting things wrong has real financial consequences
  • Are comfortable with evolving scope as Ledgy expands into new forms of compensation

Our Tech Stack*

  • Language: TypeScript
  • Frontend: React, Tailwind CSS, tRPC
  • Backend: tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, Temporal
  • Infrastructure: Docker, GitHub Actions, GCP, Terraform Cloud, Kubernetes

*We don’t expect proficiency in this specific stack

What Your Journey Could Look Like

First 30 Days

  • Build relationships with your direct reports and develop a solid understanding of the compensation domain — what we support today and where we're headed
  • Get hands-on with the codebase — review PRs and understand how the product models compensation and plan logic
  • Meet PD leadership: CTO, Head of Engineering, Head of Product, and the other EMs
  • Understand how your team's domain intersects with the rest of the platform

First 3 Months

  • Own the team's delivery rhythm: roadmap reviews, sprint health, and unblocking engineers
  • Identify and begin addressing the most complex or fragile areas of the domain
  • Establish regular 1:1s and begin meaningful coaching conversations with your reports
  • Partner with PM and Design on the roadmap for expanding compensation coverage

6–12 Months

  • Be recognised as the technical leader for compensation and savings features at Ledgy
  • Deliver measurable improvements to product quality, coverage, or the employee experience
  • Lead performance reviews and meaningful career development conversations
  • Be a trusted partner to product and engineering leadership on compensation strategy

The Interview Process

  1. Getting to know you (30 min): Meet with someone from our people team to talk about your experience and to answer questions about the role
  2. Live Coding (60 min): An equity domain problem to solve collaboratively using your preferred language and IDE. We want to see how you think, so this step does not allow AI. But you can freely look up syntax questions if you need to.
  3. System Design (60 min): A system design session where you will design an architecture for a problem from the Ledgy domain using a visual tool of your choice
  4. Mock 1:1 (45 min): A mock coaching conversation with one of our engineers to see how you approach people management and development
  5. Culture & Vision (30 min): A chance to meet one of our founders and your hiring manager for a 30-minute chat about Ledgy’s mission and values
  6. Offer 🎉

Being part of Ledgy means:

  • Recharge and re-energize with flexible working hours, 25 days of vacation, and up to 40 days of remote work from outside your home country.
  • We make space for your own professional development, with a generous yearly learning & development budget.
  • This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. All salaries are aligned with competitively benchmarked ranges based on work location and levelling.
  • For candidates based in London or Zurich we use a hybrid work model of 2 days in the office per week.

About the role

International growth is next for Grüns, and this role is how we make it real. You'll own our paid media engine across the UK, EU, Canada, and ANZ, launching and scaling Meta and Google from the ground up in each market. This isn't a strategy seat. You'll build the campaigns, the tracking, and the playbooks yourself, then build the team around what works.

Location:

While this role is part of our global remote HQ, we feel a candidate based in or around Europe will be most successful in this role.

The team members you’ll be working with most are in multiple countries and time zones, so we ask that you are comfortable working a way that allows for some overlap in working hours to collaborate.

More generally, we operate in a fully remote, high trust environment with teammates across multiple countries and time zones. While we work async by default, we come together in person twice a year for offsites that help us connect, align, and build real relationships IRL.

In this role, you will:

  • Launch and scale Meta and Google campaigns across our priority international markets, including the UK, Canada, ANZ, and key EU markets like Germany
  • Own measurement end to end: CAPI, GA4, GDPR-compliant tracking, and a regular cadence of incrementality and lift testing
  • Scale spend into the millions annually while protecting CAC, LTV/CAC, and contribution margin
  • Build a repeatable testing engine across creative, audience, offer, and localized landing pages
  • Partner closely with creative, product, and lifecycle teams to keep execution sharp across markets
  • Build the foundation for a specialist team: hiring plan, workflows, vendor model, once performance is proven
  • Own the quarterly international growth roadmap, including recommendations on new markets and channels

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has 5+ years in performance or growth marketing with hands-on paid media ownership, not just oversight
  • Has personally launched and scaled Meta and Google campaigns in at least two international markets (Canada, Australia, UK, or a non-English-speaking EU market like Germany, the Netherlands, or France)
  • Has scaled paid media spend into the millions annually while holding the line on CAC and contribution margin
  • Has real command of GDPR-compliant tracking and measurement, including CAPI, GA4, and incrementality testing
  • Comes from a high-growth DTC, subscription, or eCommerce business with real paid media dependence
  • Has built campaigns in-house rather than at an agency. You've lived with the downstream impact of your own calls, not just made recommendations from the outside

Approach to the role:

  • Operates like an owner of the business, not a specialist waiting to be told what to test next
  • Builds systems and playbooks that repeat, not one-off wins that don't scale
  • Makes sharp decisions with imperfect data and gets more precise as the picture fills in
  • Sees every market as its own puzzle, but never starts from scratch when a proven pattern already exists

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we are committed to offering a competitive total compensation package grounded in market data and aligned to our size, stage, industry, and geographic location. Compensation for this role will be benchmarked to the local market and may vary based on experience and country of hire. In addition to base compensation roles include a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

The Workday Analyst - Payroll is a technical individual contributor responsible for supporting, maintaining, and improving the Workday Payroll module in a high-volume U.S. and Canada payroll environment. This role is primarily focused on Workday Payroll systems analysis, technical support, configuration support, reporting, testing, integrations, controls, data integrity, and process improvement.

This is not an entry-level payroll role and is not intended to be a transactional payroll analyst position. The position requires hands-on Workday Payroll module experience and the ability to analyze, diagnose, and resolve payroll system issues quickly, including issues that arise in real time during payroll processing cycles.

While the role is primarily Workday-focused, the individual will also act as a payroll analyst when needed. This includes supporting payroll audits, reconciliations, variance review, gross-to-net validation, exception reporting, payroll issue research, and correction of payroll-impacting issues across exempt and non-exempt employee populations.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Workday Payroll Systems Analysis and Technical Support

  • Serve as a payroll-side functional and technical subject matter expert for the Workday Payroll module.
  • Support Workday Payroll configuration related to earnings, deductions, pay components, pay groups, payroll inputs, payroll calculations, retro pay, tax setup, garnishments, direct deposit, and payroll business processes.
  • Analyze complex Workday Payroll issues and identify root causes related to configuration, data, integrations, business processes, upstream HR data, time inputs, absence data, benefit deductions, tax elections, or payroll calculations.

  • Translate payroll requirements into system requirements, test scripts, reporting needs, control points, and process documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve automation, reduce manual payroll intervention, strengthen controls, improve reporting, and increase payroll accuracy.
  • Maintain documentation for payroll configuration, system processes, testing results, issue resolution, controls, and standard operating procedures.
  • Support payroll-related projects, including acquisitions, new entity setup, new state/province setup, pay group changes, policy updates, payroll process redesign, and Workday enhancements.

Payroll Analyst Support

As needed, this role may also provide payroll analyst support. This is intended to support issue resolution, payroll accuracy, and control review; it is not intended to be the primary function of the role or a routine payroll processing specialist responsibility.

  • Support payroll cycles through analysis, validation, audit review, variance research, exception reporting, and issue resolution.
  • Review payroll results and identify discrepancies related to earnings, deductions, taxes, retro pay, garnishments, benefits, time entries, absence entries, employee master data, and payroll configuration.

  • Support payroll reconciliations, GL-related payroll reporting, labor costing validation, payroll funding review, benefit deduction audits, garnishment audits, and year-end payroll validation.
  • Help ensure payroll data and payroll results are accurate, timely, compliant, and audit-ready.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

  • 3-5 years of combined payroll, HRIS, payroll systems, or Workday Payroll experience.
  • Hands-on Workday Payroll module experience is required.
  • Experience supporting Workday Payroll in a functional, analytical, or technical capacity.
  • Experience with U.S. and Canada payroll environments, or direct U.S. payroll experience with strong ability to support Canada payroll requirements.
  • Experience supporting payroll for exempt and non-exempt employee populations.
  • Experience working in a high-volume payroll environment.
  • Experience with multi-state payroll and multi-entity or complex organizational structures.
  • Strong understanding of payroll concepts, including earnings, deductions, taxes, garnishments, retro pay, benefit deductions, direct deposits, off-cycle payrolls, and termination pay.

  • Experience analyzing payroll results, researching payroll discrepancies, validating gross-to-net calculations, and supporting payroll audits.

  • Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently as a technical individual contributor while partnering cross-functionally with Payroll, HRIS, HR, Benefits, Finance, Accounting, IT, and vendors.
  • High attention to detail and ability to maintain confidentiality with sensitive employee and payroll data.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Workday EIBs, calculated fields, custom reports, advanced reports, dashboards, or payroll audit reports.

AI native product is fundamentally different engineering problem than building deterministic software: the same input won't always produce the same output, and "working" means the agent behaves well across the full distribution of real world scenarios, not that it passes a fixed test suite.

We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer with 2-5 years of experience building and shipping AI systems used by professionals at enterprise. You're comfortable working with modern LLM-based systems and agentic workflows, and you know how to turn powerful models into reliable product features. You have strong product judgment and think deeply about tradeoffs between LLM approaches and traditional ML when designing solutions. You care about evaluation, iteration speed, and making sure AI systems actually drive measurable business impact reliably.

What you'll do

  • Own the production improvement loop across agent behavior, customer and operator feedback, evaluation, experimentation, and verified business outcomes
  • Instrument agent workflows so model interactions, tool use, decisions, failures, human edits, and downstream outcomes can be understood in context
  • Define meaningful quality standards, representative evaluation datasets, regression coverage, and production monitoring.
  • Investigate why agents underperform across context, knowledge, instructions, tools, routing, guardrails, or workflow design
  • Design and ship targeted behavior improvements, including changes to prompting, context construction, decision logic, tool use, and human-review paths
  • Build backend services, APIs, data models, and feedback pipelines that make agent behavior observable, steerable, and reproducible
  • Run controlled experiments, production replays, or staged rollouts to measure whether changes improve quality and downstream business results
  • Partner with Product, Data Science, and Sales to prioritize high-value problems and define customer and business success
  • Ship with appropriate safeguards for privacy, security, reliability, human oversight, and safe operational rollout

What you bring

  • 2-5 years of software engineering experience, with hands-on experience building or operating LLM-powered features or agents in production - not just prototypes or demos
  • Fluency with prompting and context engineering as an engineering discipline: you iterate on prompts, context construction, and tool definitions the way you'd iterate on code
  • Experience building or maintaining evaluation harnesses for AI systems: offline eval sets, LLM-as-judge or human-in-the-loop scoring, regression detection
  • Genuine comfort with non-determinism: you reason about agent behavior across a distribution of production traffic, not a fixed set of test cases, and you don't treat variance as a bug to be argued away
  • Experience running experiments (A/B, staged rollouts, production replay) to validate whether a change actually improved outcomes, not just whether it shipped
  • A track record of shipping features real users depended on, and owning what happened after launch
  • A high-agency mindset: comfortable investigating an ambiguous "why is this underperforming" problem across context, tools, routing, and workflow design without a fully-scoped ticket
  • Comfort using AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) as a real part of your workflow

Nice to have

  • Experience with voice or real-time conversational AI systems
  • Familiarity with LLM observability/tracing tools (e.g., Braintrust, LangSmith, Datadog LLM Observability)
  • Experience with agentic orchestration frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph or similar)

ShareGate also helps organizations stay in control once their data is migrated. It lays the groundwork for safe Microsoft Copilot deployment within organizations.

ShareGate is developed by Workleap Technologies, a Montréal‑based software company.

ShareGate is a close to $100M ARR business that grows through two very different engines: inbound and channel. We've just finished our CRM migration and locked down our revenue architecture, which means for the first time the data is clean enough to answer the question we've never been able to answer properly — what marketing actually drives revenue, and where the next dollar should go. This role exists to own that answer. You'll be the analytical counterpart to our marketing ops lead, working side by side with ShareGate's Director of Marketing to turn campaign and attribution data into decisions the marketing team and the exec team can act on.

  • Own ShareGate's marketing attribution architecture across HubSpot and HockeyStack, and translate funnel data into exec-ready narratives, so attribution questions get one clear answer;
  • Drive marketing performance by diagnosing what's working and what isn't across inbound and channel, so budget shifts to the highest-return programs every quarter instead of every fiscal year;

  • Integrate AI into the analysis workflow — we run on Claude — to compress the time from question to answer from days to hours, and to make deep-dive analysis a weekly habit rather than a quarterly project.

Your team

The next 6 to 12 months are a build. This role has never existed at Workleap, and you're inheriting a business that just finished cleaning its foundations: the CRM migration is done, the revenue architecture is set, and attribution visibility is still scattered across two systems. Your first mandate is to make that architecture coherent and legible — then use it to tell ShareGate's marketing team where to invest and where to pull back.

RevOps at Workleap is split into two halves. One is Systems & Operations, which owns automation, CRM architecture and AI GTM tooling. The other — yours — is a group of GTM business partners embedded with the business units they serve, accountable for their stakeholder's performance: forecasting, funnel conversion, quota attainment, velocity. You'll report to the Director of RevOps and pair tightly with our Marketing Ops Manager, who owns the systems and campaign execution, while you own the data and its interpretation.

What you'll bring

The Pseudo-Labeling team's goal is to create high-quality annotations on sensor data (images, point clouds). The annotations include 2D, 3D bounding boxes, classes, trajectories, lane lines, segmentations, depths, and high-definition map elements. The annotations are then used by different downstream users — for example, perception teams use them to train various models, mapping teams use them to build and maintain HD maps, and simulation teams use them for generating new data. Description

About the Project

We're looking for native-level Portuguese (BR) speakers with professional voice recording experience to join the Hydrus Project.

The project consists of two scheduled recording sessions from their own home studio.

Because the recordings go straight into production, the audition validates two things equally: your voice and your recording environment.

What You'll Do

  • Audition with two 30 second samples using your home studio set up
  • Once approved, you will complete two scheduled recording sessions of approximately 4 hours each
  • Participate in natural conversation, prompted discussion, and scripted customer-service scenarios
  • Record from your own home studio setup across both sessions

Your Recording Environment

Three things are required, and each is judged separately:

  1. An external microphone: A separate, dedicated microphone is absolutely required — see below.
  2. A dry room: Your voice should sound close and clear, with no echo or hollow, distant quality. Untreated rooms with bare walls, hard floors, and high ceilings usually fail.
  3. A quiet room: No HVAC hum, fans, traffic, appliances, or household noise during recording.

Minimum Required Gear

  • Dynamic Mics (best for untreated rooms): Shure SM58, Shure MV7 / MV7+, RODE PodMic / PodMic USB, or similar.
  • Condenser mic (great in a treated room): RODE NT-USB Mini, Blue Yeti / Yeti Orb, Blue Bluebird, Blue Baby Bottle, or similar.
  • Room Treatment: Your recording space should produce studio-quality sound samples – isolation shields, sounds absorbing pads, etc…

Immediately rejected: built-in laptop microphones, phone mics, AirPods, Samsung Buds, headphone-attached mics, headsets, and gaming headsets.

Technical Specification

You must be able to produce audio samples in the meeting the following specifications:

WAV format, 24-bit, 48 kHz, no compression. Free software such as Audacity can produce this. If you cannot export in this format, please do not apply — this level of technicality is required for this role.

Who We're Looking For

  • Native-level Portuguese (BR) speaker
  • A natural, authentic, friendly, conversational customer-service speaking style
  • A dry, quiet home recording space and a professional microphone, as described above
  • Good background, but not required: Podcasters, youtubers, streamers, recording artists, voice-over actors, etc – anyone who has experience recording audio in a high-quality home studio

Commitment & Compensation

  • Estimated time: approximately 8 hours total across two scheduled sessions
  • Compensation: $35.00 USD per hour

Staff Product Manager, SmugMug

IC4 (Product Manager 4)

Location: Remote, within approved U.S. states (see below)

Compensation: Awesome is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range for this role is $163,800- $218,400. This position is also remote-friendly, and as such, compensation will ultimately be in line with the location in which the position is filled. Various factors, such as defined competency leveling and geographic location, will determine the final compensation for this role.

***Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis up until 9/4/26***

About The Role

For over 20 years, SmugMug has served visual storytellers and photographers with software that allows them to present their work online, store all of their photos and videos, seamlessly deliver to clients, and earn money by offering print and photo gift products to their clients. We are a private, profitable, mission-driven company serving serious photographers — from passionate hobbyists to working professionals.

We are modernizing our core product and platform for a new generation of visual storytellers. As a Lead Product Manager, you'll own one of several major areas of our user journey across multi-quarter initiatives e.g. growth, client delivery, or core experience, matched to your depth. You’ll frame hard problems, make high-stakes tradeoffs, build the business case, ship, and measure what matters. You'll connect business and platform strategy to quarterly and sprint-level execution across engineering, design, insights, marketing, and operations.

This is not a caretaker role. We need someone who thrives in ambiguity, builds with imperfect information, and has a bias toward more hits at bat over high precision. This is a roll-up-your-sleeves environment where you'll wear many hats and ship real features to help our customers preserve the precious memories of their clients.

Your Opportunity

  • Own product strategy and execution for a major area of SmugMug's product, operating across multi-quarter initiatives that span multiple teams.
  • Stay close to our customers. Collaborate with insights, marketing, CX, and UX to center our customers and their needs.
  • Frame large, ambiguous problem spaces — define the problem, scope the value, build the business case, align the organization, ship solutions, and assess how it landed.
  • Connect product and platform strategy to quarterly and sprint-level execution through storytelling, roadmap planning, and clear written and verbal communication.
  • Drive innovation within your area — applying Lean, design thinking, and first-principles reasoning to find new approaches for a next generation of visual storytellers.
  • Build the ROI case for your area, modeling value creation alongside operational costs. Define outcomes and measurement approaches upfront. Test decisions against real-world results and treat being wrong as learning, not failure.
  • Help raise the bar on PM craft at SmugMug — value creation, communication quality, roadmap rigor, release coordination, communication cadence, sprint/scrum planning.
  • Report directly to the Head of Product Management.

What You Bring

  • Customer obsession. Your first questions are about the user: who they are, what they need, how many are affected, what we do and don't know. You center holistic customer value in all decisions while balancing business and technical constraints.
  • Innovation instinct. You've driven new product initiatives — not just optimized existing features — and have a track record of uncovering new value through new approaches. You understand principles of market strategy and growth.
  • Analytical rigor. You define measurement approaches upfront. You're comfortable with business strategy modeling, ROI estimation, A/B test interpretation, and light quantitative analysis. You know when to bring in data science and when directional data is sufficient. MBA or management consulting experience is a plus.
  • First-principles Lean thinking. You start from the problem, not the convention. You're comfortable making bets with imperfect information and operating in ambiguous problem spaces.
  • Design fluency. You value high UX quality, can direct the work of designers in your area, and use prototyping and visualization to align teams before committing to code.
  • Clear, precise communication. Written, verbal, and visual — you communicate at multiple levels of detail and actively seek feedback on how well your communication lands.
  • Builder mentality. You've shipped in resource-constrained environments. You don't hide behind process. You're hands-on, resourceful, and pragmatic.
  • Strong product craft. You've worked in organizations with strong PM practice and you carry it with you — planning cadences, well-structured specs, clear roadmap communication, release coordination.
  • 8+ years in product management at companies known for product quality, ideally in prosumer, creative tools, or small business SaaS. Scaling or turnaround experience a plus.

What We Offer You

Comprehensive Benefits

  • 4 day work week
  • Health, dental, vision insurance — 100% premium coverage for employee and dependents
  • HSA contributions covering 90%+ of annual deductible
  • 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting
  • Flexible Time Off (FTO)
  • Learning & development opportunities for personal and professional growth
  • Remote work stipends (internet, fitness, coworking space)
  • Company-sponsored therapy and coaching sessions
  • Flexible spending accounts available
  • Company-sponsored phone plan
  • A fully remote work environment (+ a coworking space reimbursement if you prefer)

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

A Little About Us

Our purpose is simple: building a better world through the power of photography. For over two decades, we have led the photography industry and thrived as a private, mission-focused, values-led company. We are a Certified Evergreen brand. We are also a Certified Great Place to Work, Climate Neutral Certified, and members of the Conservation Alliance.

We're building iconic brands that connect people through photography and unleash the value of the stories they tell. We make products that thrill photographers of all types, crafting experiences that empower them to preserve their precious memories, share their art, and run their businesses.

A career at Awesome is much more than a job. Our people come first, and we invest in their growth and prioritize their well-being. Your work will contribute to our mission while leaving a positive, lasting impact on our community and our world.

Our expanding family of brands includes SmugMug, Flickr, and MODE events.

About Cogstate

At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

About the Clinician Network

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.

Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

All applicants to the Clinician Network are kept in our active pipeline, and you’ll also receive our monthly Clinician Network newsletter, which shares updates and upcoming openings.

About the Role

Cogstate Clinicians are clinical psychologists or neuropsychologists responsible for delivering remote clinical interviews and cognitive assessment batteries to subjects with preclinical dementia, enrolled in a pharmaceutical clinical trial.

Cogstate provides all consultants with comprehensive, fully compensated training on general Cogstate operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing skills and virtual cognitive assessment prior to performing remote scale administrations. Regular supervision and ongoing recalibration of clinical skill set will be provided.

*These are contract position.

*They are fully remote.

*Hired employee will work on an as needed basis based on their schedule.

- VINELAND/VABS Administration Experience Required
- English Fluency Required

Central Rating

  • Participating in regular clinical skill recalibration activities.

Central Monitoring

  • Providing reviews of completed neuropsychological test batteries for central monitoring of data to ensure accuracy in administration and scoring and contribute to the overall success of a clinical trial.
  • Reviewing response forms and recordings of remote scale administrations and offering feedback to raters via email and telephone communications.

Qualifications & Expertise

  • MA/MS in Psychology or equivalent

  • Proficiency with MS Office, including Word and Excel, email, teleconference platforms such as Skype, Zoom or other similar applications, and cloud-based storage service.

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

Real Estate Transaction Coordinator – MLS, DocuSign & Compliance | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Real Estate Transaction Coordinator / Real Estate Specialist to manage real estate transactions, listings, documentation, and compliance from accepted offer through closing.

This is a hands-on, detail-intensive role for someone who understands real estate workflows and can keep multiple transactions moving simultaneously without missing critical deadlines.

You’ll work closely with agents, brokers, buyers, sellers, lenders, title companies, inspectors, and other stakeholders to ensure every transaction remains organized, compliant, and on schedule.

If you have hands-on experience with MLS platforms, DocuSign, transaction management systems, and real estate documentation, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Transaction Coordination

  • Manage 5–15 active real estate transactions simultaneously
  • Coordinate transactions from accepted offer through closing
  • Build and maintain transaction checklists and timelines
  • Track critical dates, contingencies, and contractual milestones
  • Coordinate with:
    • Escrow and title companies
    • Lenders
    • Inspectors
    • Appraisers
    • Agents and brokers
  • Schedule inspections, appraisals, and other transaction-related activities
  • Proactively follow up on outstanding items to keep deals moving
  • Ensure no contingency or closing deadlines are missed

MLS & Listing Management

  • Create, input, and maintain property listings across MLS platforms
  • Ensure listing information is accurate and complete
  • Update listing status, pricing, property details, and supporting documentation
  • Coordinate listing syndication across platforms such as:
    • Zillow
    • Realtor.com
    • Apartments.com
  • Monitor listing activity and provide updates to agents
  • Ensure MLS requirements and deadlines are followed

Compliance & Transaction Documentation

  • Review contracts and transaction files for completeness and accuracy
  • Track and organize:
    • Purchase agreements
    • Disclosures
    • Addenda
    • Amendments
    • Inspection documents
    • Closing documentation
  • Coordinate electronic signatures through DocuSign
  • Ensure required documents are properly completed and signed
  • Maintain compliance with applicable state regulations, brokerage policies, and MLS requirements
  • Keep transaction files organized and audit-ready
  • Identify missing documentation and follow up promptly

Client & Agent Communication

  • Serve as a reliable coordination point throughout the transaction
  • Provide timely updates to buyers, sellers, agents, and other stakeholders
  • Respond professionally to transaction-related questions
  • Coordinate appointments, inspections, appraisals, and closing activities
  • Keep agents informed of upcoming deadlines and outstanding requirements
  • Escalate potential transaction issues before they become closing delays

Listing Marketing Support

  • Create and coordinate property marketing materials
  • Support development of:
    • Property flyers
    • Brochures
    • Social media assets
    • Open house materials
  • Assist with listing distribution across digital platforms
  • Track listing activity and marketing performance
  • Maintain accurate and consistent property information across channels

Reporting & Brokerage Administration

  • Prepare pipeline and transaction status reports
  • Track:
    • Contingency deadlines
    • Closing dates
    • Transaction stages
    • Commissions
  • Maintain organized records for active and completed transactions
  • Support brokers with compliance reviews and audits
  • Assist with back-office real estate operations as needed

Must-Have Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in:
    • Real estate transaction coordination
    • Brokerage operations
    • Real estate administrative support
    • Similar transaction-focused roles
  • Hands-on experience managing real estate transactions from contract through closing
  • Proficiency with MLS platforms
  • Strong experience with DocuSign
  • Experience with transaction management platforms such as:
    • Dotloop
    • SkySlope
    • Brokermint
    • Similar systems
  • Familiarity with real estate contracts, disclosures, addenda, and transaction documentation
  • Understanding of real estate compliance requirements
  • Strong Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office skills
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple transactions and competing deadlines simultaneously
  • Comfortable working remotely during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Licensed real estate agent
  • Certified Transaction Coordinator
  • Experience managing 10+ concurrent transactions
  • Experience supporting both residential and commercial real estate transactions
  • Experience with brokerage compliance audits
  • Commission tracking experience
  • Basic marketing and design skills using Canva, InDesign, or similar tools

Tools & Tech

MLS Platforms | DocuSign | Dotloop | SkySlope | Brokermint | Zillow | Realtor.com | Apartments.com | Google Workspace | Microsoft Office | Canva

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You’re highly organized and naturally deadline-driven
  • You understand the real estate transaction lifecycle
  • You notice missing signatures, documents, dates, and details before they become problems
  • You can manage multiple active deals without losing track of priorities
  • You communicate confidently with agents, clients, lenders, and vendors
  • You’re proactive with follow-ups and don’t wait until deadlines become urgent
  • You understand that accuracy and compliance are critical in real estate
  • You stay calm when closings become fast-moving or time-sensitive

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start by reviewing your active transaction pipeline and checking upcoming contingency and closing deadlines.

From there, you might update an MLS listing, request a missing disclosure, coordinate an inspection, send documents through DocuSign, follow up with a lender or title company, update an agent on closing progress, or prepare a new listing for syndication.

Throughout the day, you’ll keep transaction files organized, communicate with stakeholders, and make sure every deal continues moving toward closing.

In short: you keep real estate transactions organized, compliant, and on track from contract to close.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Zero missed contingency or closing deadlines
  • Accurate and complete transaction files
  • Strong compliance across active transactions
  • Timely completion of signatures and documentation
  • Smooth coordination between agents, clients, lenders, and title/escrow
  • Accurate MLS and listing information
  • Consistent client and agent communication
  • Efficient, on-time closings

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Practical Transaction / Compliance Exercise
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Real Estate Transaction Coordinator with strong knowledge of MLS platforms, DocuSign, transaction documentation, compliance, and contract-to-close workflows, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and help ensure every transaction moves smoothly, accurately, and efficiently from accepted offer through closing.

Digify is a cloud-based virtual data room and digital rights management software provider. Our platform helps companies control, protect and track important documents after they have been shared.

Companies use Digify to protect confidential information for fundraising, M&A transactions, due diligence, intellectual property sharing and sensitive business communications. Today, Digify is used in 138 countries by more than 700,000 users worldwide.

THE ROLE

We are expanding our sales team and are looking for an Account Executive to support and grow our EMEA business.

This is an inbound-led SaaS sales role focused on SMB and mid-market customers. The first priority of the role is to manage and convert inbound demand from EMEA, including trial signups, general enquiries, quote requests and RFPs. As lead volume across EMEA can be high, the Account Executive must be strong at qualification, prioritisation and identifying the opportunities with the highest potential.

The ideal candidate is a commercially minded SaaS salesperson with 2–3+ years of experience and notable success in a sales or closing role. You should enjoy speaking with prospects, understanding their pain points, recommending suitable solutions, conducting product demos and following up closely to move deals towards close.

We are also open to exceptional candidates from an SDR/BDR background if they have demonstrated closing experience and are ready to take ownership of customer conversations through to close.

This is a remote role. Candidates should be based in a time zone that allows meaningful overlap with EMEA prospects and the Digify team.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

    • Manage inbound leads from EMEA, including trial signups, general enquiries, quote requests and RFPs.
    • Qualify leads effectively to understand fit, urgency, use case, buying intent and commercial potential.
    • Prioritise high-potential opportunities while managing a steady volume of inbound demand.
    • Speak with prospects over calls, emails and video meetings to understand their business needs and pain points.
    • Recommend suitable Digify solutions based on each prospect’s use case, requirements and buying context.
    • Conduct clear and effective product demos, with enough product understanding to address common technical and workflow-related questions.
    • Communicate Digify’s value proposition clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Follow up consistently and professionally to maintain deal momentum and move opportunities towards close.
    • Manage opportunities in HubSpot, keeping records accurate and up to date.
    • Share customer feedback, objections, market trends and competitive insights with the sales, product and marketing teams.
    • Work closely with the existing sales team to support territory transition, shared learning and EMEA sales growth.

Requirements

    • 2–3+ years of SaaS sales experience with notable success, preferably in a closing role.
    • Experience selling SaaS or cloud-based software products to SMB and/or mid-market customers.
    • Excellent lead qualification skills, with the ability to quickly assess fit, urgency and deal potential.
    • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritise effectively in a high-volume inbound environment.
    • Excellent communication skills, especially the ability to understand customer pain points and explain product value clearly.
    • Ability to build rapport and trust with prospects through calls, emails and online meetings.
    • Confidence conducting product demos and explaining technical concepts in a simple, practical way.
    • Ability to make sound and reasonable product recommendations based on customer needs.
    • Strong follow-up discipline and the ability to create urgency and maintain deal momentum in a professional, consultative way.
    • Strong written and spoken English. Additional European languages, such as German or French, are a plus.
    • Comfortable selling across different EMEA markets, with sensitivity to different business cultures, languages and buying contexts.
    • Familiarity with CRM tools, preferably HubSpot.
    • Comfortable using AI tools to improve sales productivity, including call preparation, prospect research, follow-up drafting and CRM updates.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience selling document security, data room, cybersecurity, legal tech, fintech, investment, M&A, or other B2B software solutions.
  • Experience handling inbound trial-led or product-led growth sales motions.
  • Familiarity with data protection, document security, due diligence or compliance-related buyer concerns.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

A successful Account Executive in this role will be able to:

  • Quickly identify which inbound leads are worth prioritising.
  • Understand the prospect’s real business problem, not just respond to surface-level requests.
  • Recommend the right Digify solution in a consultative and credible way.
  • Deliver effective product demos independently.
  • Maintain strong follow-up discipline and keep deals moving.
  • Convert qualified EMEA inbound demand into paying customers.
  • Build trust with SMB and mid-market prospects across different EMEA markets.

  • Strong understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modeling, data transformation, and data quality principles.

jobs.excerpt: About Lokal:In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet.
jobs.description:
About Lokal:In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online. This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

    • Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
    • Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
    • Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
    • Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
    • Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
    • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
    • Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
    • Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.

We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.

We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital.

Role Overview:

We are hiring for our sister app - Dostt , an audio and video platform. Currently, we operate in Hindi. As we expand rapidly, we are seeing significant growth.

We are looking for a motivated and results-driven Telecaller to join our team. The Telecaller will be responsible for making outbound calls to potential leads, understanding their needs, and offering suitable services & onboarding them to the platform. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, a customer-centric approach, and the ability to handle rejections professionally.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Make outbound calls to potential and existing hosts to inform them about products and services.
  • Follow up on leads generated through various marketing campaigns.
  • Maintain detailed records of host interactions and transactions.
  • Achieve daily/weekly/monthly call and conversion targets.
  • Provide accurate and timely information to hosts.
  • Stay updated with the latest products, services, and promotional offers.
  • Train & Onboarding new hosts as per Guidelines of App.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Proven experience as a Telecaller or in a similar role.
  • Excellent communication skills in Gujaratiand English (read, write and speak).
  • Ability to handle Host rejection and remain patient.
  • Basic knowledge of computer operations, CRM & Excel.
  • Strong listening and negotiation skills with a positive attitude and ability to work in a team

Why Join Us?

We’re scaling fast with strong fundamentals, on a mission to empower millions through AI and access. At Lokal, you’ll take ownership from day one, build for real impact, and help redefine the roadmap of how Bharat connects to opportunities, knowledge, and experts.

Job Description:

SCRUM MASTER PRINCIPAL

Turn complexity into clarity and deliver innovative applications as a SCRUM Master Principal at GDIT. Here, you’ll support our customers’ most important missions with smart, scalable solutions while we support you in growing and developing your technology career.

GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career. The Scrum Master will lead the CMM Data Modernization and Governance agile practice and team in delivering an integrated data governance, engineering, data platform, reporting, analytics, and Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML) capabilities that support operational decision-making and advance AO's data and analytics objectives in support of the CMM program.

The successful candidate will be an experienced scrum master with a long track record of successfully enabling agile teams and facilitating delivery in complex environments. The Scrum Master is responsible for coaching the team, removing impediments, fostering strong customer and stakeholder collaboration, and ensuring consistent delivery through agile processes and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will be a proactive change agent who challenges the status quo, excels in communication, and thrives in a fast‑paced environment with multiple concurrent work streams. This individual will help the teams reach higher levels of agility, performance, and operational maturity.

THE SCRUM MASTER WILL EXECUTE THE FOLLOWING RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Establish clear team goals and iteration plans that align with Program Increment (PI) objectives for the CMM Data Modernization and Governance program.
  • Coach technical teams and Product Owners on Agile concepts, frameworks, and practices; including Epic and User Story creation, SAFe, Scrum, and Kanban; to strengthen agile execution.
  • Manage expectations and support collaboration across multiple Product Owners (POs).
  • Engage with clients and senior leadership to ensure transparency, alignment, and effective communication.
  • Provide leadership across major workstreams and guide teams through complex data modernization tasks.
  • Facilitate cross-team communication to identify dependencies, risks, and impediments that may impact delivery; develop and support mitigation strategies.
  • Organize and lead all Scrum ceremonies, including daily standups, Sprint Planning and Backlog Grooming, Sprint Reviews/Demos, and Retrospectives.
  • Maintain JIRA boards and other information radiators to ensure accurate and timely visibility into team progress.
  • Mentor and coach teams on core Agile values, principles, and practices to foster continuous learning and improvement.
  • Enable teams to become self‑organizing, self‑managing, and accountable for achieving sprint and release goals.
  • Partner with Product Management to prepare release plans and support backlog grooming, prioritization, and stakeholder visibility.
  • Motivate and support teams in delivering high‑quality work across analysis, development, testing, documentation, and other critical activities.
  • Identify, communicate, and help resolve project risks, dependencies, and team impediments.
  • Ensure the team’s Definition of Done is clearly established and consistently applied across stories, sprints, and releases.
  • Promote collaborative decision‑making and facilitate conflict resolution to maintain team productivity.
  • Protect the team from external disruptions and unplanned work that threaten sprint commitments.
  • Support internal and external communication to enhance transparency across the CMM program.
  • Foster a trusting, safe team environment where issues can be raised early and addressed constructively.
  • Assess Scrum maturity and coach teams toward higher levels of agile proficiency at a sustainable pace.
  • Champion a continuous improvement mindset and recommend adjustments to enhance delivery practices.
  • Participate in Scrum‑of‑Scrums to coordinate cross‑team dependencies, integration activities, and release plans.
  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders, including customers, technical teams, and leadership, to support successful delivery.
  • Provide biweekly Agile reports such as sprint reports, backlog reporting, sprint burndown charts, sprint retrospective reports, risk registry, etc.
  • Develop and update the Risks, Assumptions, Issues and Dependencies (RAID) log, and other project management related artifacts.
  • Perform risk identification and mitigation. Identify and communicate technical, operational, and business risks; develop mitigation strategies.
  • Provide transparent reporting, with regular updates to stakeholders on progress, risks, financials, and outcomes.
  • Provide the COR and government leads with analysis and research, of alternatives, and solution and design options related to the Case Management Modernization effort upon request.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Education: Technical Training, Certification(s) or Degree required; BA or BS degree strongly preferred.
  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in an Agile development environment required.
  • Project Management Professional Certification (PMP) required.
  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM) -or- Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP) required.
  • SAFe Agilist Certification (SA) required.
  • Experience with using and implementing the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), Scrum, and KanBan.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and work rapidly in a high tempo environment that often requires multitasking.
  • Experience with software development, data governance, or working in an analytics organization.
  • Ability to create, sustain, and enhance fostering team dynamics and collaboration.
  • Expertise in overseeing teams dedicated to big data cloud solution architecture, cybersecurity, data management, business intelligence, and analytics.
  • Excellent customer-facing skills with experience briefing senior executive leadership.

Must be a US Person (Green Card Holder, US Permanent Resident Alien, Refugee, Asylee, or US Citizen).

PawaPay is a pan-African fintech enabling local payment channels used by the mass market to both local and international merchants. We operate in a highly regulated, partner-driven environment and are in scale-up mode, with ambitious growth plans across multiple African markets.

Our vision is to simplify business for companies and consumers in Africa and we do that by ensuring that payments simply work, at scale, despite fragmentation and complexity that exists on the Continent.

Through our payments API we already facilitate over 4 million transactions a day across 20 countries in Sub-Saharan Africa. We are the largest PSP on the Continent for the processing of mobile money payments, and have positioned ourselves well to lead the payment space as it grows over the next decade.

At PawaPay, there is an entrepreneurial spirit coupled with a modern and professional working culture. The fast-paced, ever-changing environment will suit someone who can adapt and think on their feet. In return, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a group of dedicated and smart individuals working towards the same mission. We work as a remote team and have team members in Europe, Africa and Asia.

The Role

As Cybersecurity Officer for West Africa, you will be responsible for executing PawaPay's cybersecurity programme across the region.

Reporting to the Head of Cybersecurity, you will serve as PawaPay's primary cybersecurity representative across Francophone and Anglophone West Africa. You will implement the company's global cybersecurity strategy while ensuring security controls, regulatory requirements and operational practices are effectively applied within the regional context.

This is a hands-on operational role requiring someone who is equally comfortable discussing technical security issues with Engineering teams as they are supporting regulators, auditors and business stakeholders.

You will own day-to-day regional cybersecurity activities, coordinate security operations, drive remediation of security risks and audit findings, and ensure cybersecurity remains embedded within the way pawaPay operates across West Africa.

Salary:USD 30,000–45,000 per annum, depending on experience, skills and location.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute PawaPay's cybersecurity programme across West African operations in line with the company's global cybersecurity strategy and standards.
  • Conduct security risk assessments, vulnerability reviews and security control assessments, ensuring risks are prioritised and practical remediation plans are implemented.
  • Coordinate regional security incident response activities, working closely with Engineering and Operations teams to investigate, contain and remediate security issues.
  • Drive timely remediation of vulnerabilities, penetration test findings, audit actions and security risks by working cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Operations and Compliance teams.
  • Support regulatory engagements, security audits and compliance reviews with central banks, regulators, cybersecurity authorities and data protection authorities across Francophone and Anglophone West Africa.
  • Ensure regional adoption of pawaPay's security policies, standards and control frameworks while adapting implementation to local regulatory requirements where appropriate.
  • Act as the primary cybersecurity point of contact across West Africa, providing practical guidance to internal stakeholders and building trusted relationships across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Coordinate third-party security assessments, penetration tests and security reviews, ensuring findings are tracked through to completion.
  • Deliver regional security awareness initiatives and promote a strong security culture across the business.
  • Monitor the evolving cybersecurity and regulatory landscape across West Africa, identifying emerging risks and recommending appropriate improvements.

You Are a Great Fit If You Have

  • 4+ years' experience in cybersecurity, information security or IT security within fintech, telecommunications, banking or another regulated industry.
  • Professional fluency in both English and French (written and spoken). This is essential for supporting our Francophone West Africa operations.
  • Practical experience implementing and applying recognised security frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST, PCI-DSS or similar within regulated environments.
  • Hands-on experience with vulnerability management, security incident response, security monitoring and risk management.
  • Experience supporting security audits, regulatory reviews or compliance assessments.
  • Familiarity with mobile money ecosystems, payment infrastructure, API-driven platforms or financial services technology.
  • Experience working with security technologies such as SIEM, EDR, vulnerability management platforms or similar security tooling.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence Engineering, Product and Operations teams and drive security improvements without direct authority.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical risks into clear, business-focused recommendations.
  • A Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline.
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CEH, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer or equivalent are advantageous.

Success in this Role

Within your first year you will:

  • Become the trusted cybersecurity point of contact across West Africa.
  • Successfully support regulatory, audit and compliance engagements with minimal escalation.
  • Drive timely closure of security vulnerabilities, penetration test findings and audit actions across the region.
  • Build strong working relationships with Engineering, Operations, Product, Compliance and Regulatory teams.
  • Strengthen pawaPay's cybersecurity posture by ensuring regional risks are proactively identified, prioritised and remediated.

Why PawaPay?

  • Help improve financial access in Africa
  • Being part of an amazing team that shapes company’s culture as a great place to be
  • An ambitious, talented, and diverse team who always has your back
  • We grow fast, and you will grow fast with us
  • Competitive remuneration
  • 35 days of paid leave per year (inclusive of public holidays) and more.

Working closely with the National Sales Manager and broader commercial team, the role is responsible for maintaining a healthy sales pipeline, delivering compelling value propositions, and ensuring opportunities progress efficiently from initial engagement through to activation.

Beyond new business acquisition, the role carries a strong account management focus - owning the ongoing relationship with existing uMeds clinics, driving engagement and script volume growth within the current portfolio, and ensuring accounts are retained and continually supported after activation.

This is a field-based role requiring interstate travel to engage clinics, attend industry events and conferences, and support business development activities across multiple states.

Business Development & Commercial Execution (Interstate Travel Required):

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities within the medicinal cannabis clinic market.
  • Present the uMeds value proposition and tailor solutions to meet individual clinic needs.
  • Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting through to signed agreement and activation.
  • Negotiate partnership terms and commercial agreements with prospective clinics.
  • Drive new revenue through partner-led initiatives and strategic alliances within the clinic network.

Account Management & Retention (Interstate Travel Required):

  • Own the ongoing relationship with existing uMeds clinics post-onboarding, acting as their primary point of contact.
  • Conduct regular account reviews with existing clinics to monitor engagement, platform usage and satisfaction.
  • Identify and execute opportunities to grow script volume and platform usage within the existing clinic portfolio.
  • Proactively manage account health, resolving issues and escalations promptly to minimise churn risk.
  • Support the retention and renewal of existing clinic partnerships, ensuring long-term account value.

Relationship Management & Cross-Functional Leadership:

  • Build and maintain relationships with clinic owners, prescribing doctors and practice managers.
  • Work collaboratively with internal stakeholders to ensure a smooth onboarding experience.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to support partner success and co-marketing opportunities.
  • Represent uMeds professionally at customer meetings, conferences and industry events as required.

Performance, Compliance & Reporting

  • Maintain an accurate and up-to-date sales pipeline within HubSpot CRM.
  • Conduct regular follow-up with prospective clinics to progress opportunities and overcome barriers.
  • Provide market intelligence and competitor insights to support business growth.
  • Monitor conversion outcomes and report pipeline performance and insights to the National Sales Manager.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant legislation (including TGA requirements), industry standards, and Montu's governance framework.
  • Interstate travel is required to support business development activities, conferences and customer engagement.
  • Demonstrated success in business development or account management.
  • Proven experience managing and growing a portfolio of existing accounts, including retention and upsell.
  • Experience within healthcare, pharmaceuticals or medicinal cannabis is highly desirable.
  • Strong commercial acumen with excellent negotiation and influencing skills.
  • Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills.
  • Proven ability to analyse market trends and translate insights into actionable growth strategies.

  • Ability to work autonomously while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
