In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. jobs.excerpt: About GigaGiga is building gigawatts of AI data centers to hasten a future of intelligence and abundance.
jobs.description:
About Giga

Giga is building gigawatts of AI data centers to hasten a future of intelligence and abundance. We build data centers fast and at scale by combining the capabilities of an equipment supplier, engineering firm, general contractor, and real estate developer under one roof. Our team moves quickly and thinks practically. If you're ready to make an impact in an industry that matters, we're looking for people like you.

Why join Giga

  • The Pace: We're building at a speed most companies talk about but never actually operate at. If you've been bored somewhere else, you won't be here.
  • The Impact: Every person at Giga touches the work that matters. No layers, no waiting for approval chains. You'll see your fingerprints on what we ship.
  • The Team: A team of operators defining the future of AI infrastructure. We recruit A-players from the most innovative companies in the world, and they choose Giga because the work here means more.
  • The Moment: AI doesn't run without power, and that's us. Giga is the picks and shovels behind the AI revolution. This industry is about to explode, and you'll be in the room where it's already happening.

What you’ll do

A data center only matters if it stays up. As Director of Operations, you own what happens after commissioning ends and the facility goes live — the day-to-day reliability, staffing, maintenance, and performance of Giga's data centers in operation. You'll build and run the operating standard across our portfolio: how facilities are staffed, how uptime is protected, how maintenance is scheduled, and how issues get resolved before they become incidents. You'll manage facility operations teams and vendor relationships across multiple sites, report on operational health to executive leadership, and be the person accountable when the question is "is it running the way it's supposed to." If you want to own the operating backbone of a fast-growing AI infrastructure company, this is your seat.

Where you’ll work

This role is remote, with roughly 20-25% travel to data center facilities to stay close to day-to-day operations in the field. While Giga is an in-office culture by default, this role is a deliberate exception given its portfolio-spanning nature — you'll need to be where the facilities are, not tied to a single hub.

Responsibilities

  • Own day-to-day operational performance across Giga's live data center facilities, including uptime, maintenance execution, and incident response
  • Build and enforce the operating standard applied across all facilities — staffing models, maintenance schedules, escalation procedures, and performance benchmarks
  • Manage facility operations teams and site leads across multiple locations, ensuring consistent execution regardless of site
  • Own vendor and service provider relationships tied to ongoing operations (maintenance contractors, equipment service providers, facility services), including contract performance and SLAs
  • Lead root cause analysis and resolution for operational incidents, ensuring issues are closed out and standards updated to prevent recurrence
  • Own the operations budget across the portfolio, making resourcing and staffing trade-off calls as facilities come online
  • Report on operational health, risk, and performance to executive leadership across the full portfolio
  • Partner with the commissioning and construction teams to ensure a clean handoff from newly commissioned facilities into steady-state operations
  • Drive continuous improvement in operating procedures as the facility portfolio scales

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in facility or data center operations, with 5+ years managing operations teams across multiple sites
  • Demonstrated experience owning uptime, maintenance, and staffing for mission-critical or large-scale industrial facilities
  • Track record building or scaling an operations function, standard, or team across a growing portfolio
  • Strong working knowledge of MEP and electrical systems relevant to facility operations (generators, UPS, switchgear, cooling infrastructure, BMS/controls)
  • Experience managing operations budgets and vendor/service contracts across multiple simultaneous sites
  • Strong track record presenting to and advising executive-level stakeholders on operational risk and performance

Bonus points

  • Direct experience running operations at a hyperscale or colocation data center company
  • Experience partnering with commissioning teams on facility turnover and handoff
  • Familiarity with CMMS or facility operations management platforms
  • Experience scaling an operations function inside a high-growth or startup environment

How We Work

We value people who take ownership, raise risks early, communicate directly, and follow through. Incomplete information is part of the job. Make the best decision you can, document it, and adjust as the facts change. Move quickly on reversible decisions and take more care when security, safety, financial, employee, or customer risk is involved.

Benefits

  • Subsidized health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Equity (options) in a rapidly growing startup
  • 401(k) with 4% employer match
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Parental leave
  • Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) or Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Commuter benefits, where applicable
  • Opportunities to collaborate in person at periodic team and company on-sites

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

Giga Energy is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. jobs.title: Lead, Product Management - Healthcare
jobs.excerpt: Our team members are at the heart of everything we do.
jobs.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Under the direction of the Director, Product Management, Provider Analytics, and in partnership with analytics leadership, stakeholders, and provider customers, the Product Manager, Provider Analytics (InfoDive) is responsible for defining, prioritizing, delivering, and continuously improving products within the Provider Analytics portfolio, with primary responsibility for the InfoDive® product line and additional Provider Analytics products as assigned.

InfoDive® is a provider-focused analytics platform that enables organizations to improve operational performance, financial outcomes, and strategic decision-making through actionable analytics and business intelligence. The platform leverages data from practice management systems, financial systems, pharmacy dispensing systems, and other healthcare data sources to provide meaningful operational, financial, and performance insights for organizations ranging from large healthcare aggregators and provider networks to independent physician practices.

This role will champion change management and help lead the transition of Provider Analytics toward an Agile Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC) framework. The Product Manager will help establish and reinforce Agile ways of working, improve planning rigor, strengthen backlog discipline, promote cross-functional alignment, and support adoption of standardized product lifecycle practices from intake through discovery, delivery, release, and post-launch measurement.

The Product Manager will translate provider needs, market opportunities, user feedback, operational impacts, and business goals into product strategies, requirements, release priorities, adoption plans, and delivery roadmaps. The Product Manager works cross-functionally with development, architecture, data operations, quality assurance, implementation, sales, marketing, client services, and support teams to ensure successful framework transition, product delivery, stakeholder readiness, adoption, and lifecycle management.

The Product Manager is responsible for maintaining product roadmaps, evaluating enhancement opportunities, facilitating backlog prioritization, coordinating release activities, developing business cases, managing cross-functional dependencies, supporting go-to-market activities, and reinforcing consistent PDLC governance. Through continuous customer engagement, market research, competitive analysis, product performance evaluation, and change adoption measurement, this role helps drive customer value, product adoption, business growth, and return on investment across the Provider Analytics portfolio.

This position requires strong product management expertise, exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, change management experience, comfort working in Agile delivery environments, and a practical understanding of healthcare provider operations. Expertise in healthcare financial systems, practice management systems, medical practice operations, pharmacy dispensing workflows, revenue cycle management, and provider-facing analytics solutions is highly preferred due to the nature of the products supported.

PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Define and maintain product roadmaps, priorities, and enhancement strategies for assigned Provider Analytics products, with primary responsibility for the InfoDive® platform.
  • Align roadmap priorities with customer needs, market opportunities, business objectives, and strategic direction established by product leadership.
  • Develop business cases, value assessments, feature rationales, and investment recommendations that support product growth and customer value creation.
  • Continuously evaluate and adjust roadmap priorities based on customer feedback, product performance, competitive intelligence, evolving business requirements, and measurable adoption outcomes.
  • Champion the transition to an Agile PDLC framework by supporting standardized intake, discovery, backlog grooming, sprint planning, release planning, launch readiness, and post-release review practices.
  • Participate actively in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily standups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and Program Increment (PI) planning activities.
  • Facilitate backlog prioritization and planning readiness activities to ensure development teams have clearly defined, prioritized, sequenced, and actionable requirements.
  • Partner with leadership and cross-functional teams to drive change management activities, including stakeholder alignment, communication planning, training needs identification, readiness tracking, adoption support, and resistance mitigation.
  • Help establish consistent product lifecycle artifacts, including intake documentation, problem statements, PRDs, epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, release notes, adoption plans, and post-launch results summaries.
  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of product enhancements and capabilities across assigned Provider Analytics products.
  • Coordinate with development, architecture, quality assurance, data operations, implementation, support teams, and other stakeholders to ensure successful delivery of product initiatives.
  • Manage cross-functional dependencies and proactively identify and mitigate delivery risks, including process adoption risks associated with the Agile PDLC transition.
  • Ensure delivered solutions meet customer needs, business objectives, technical requirements, compliance considerations, operational readiness expectations, and defined acceptance criteria.
  • Support release readiness, launch activities, user adoption efforts, stakeholder communications, training coordination, and post-release performance evaluations.
  • Analyze customer feedback, operational metrics, product usage data, industry trends, market opportunities, and adoption signals to identify product enhancement opportunities.
  • Translate stakeholder needs, user requirements, workflow impacts, and business goals into clearly defined problem statements and actionable product requirements.
  • Evaluate opportunities to enhance customer experience, improve operational efficiency, increase adoption, reduce workflow friction, and create measurable business value.
  • Engage regularly with healthcare providers, administrators, operational leaders, and executives representing organizations ranging from large healthcare aggregators and physician networks to independent medical practices.
  • Conduct customer discovery sessions, workflow reviews, user interviews, feedback sessions, change impact discussions, readiness reviews, and product demonstrations.
  • Leverage active listening, customer research, discovery techniques, and change impact assessment practices to identify, clarify, and refine customer requirements.
  • Serve as the voice of the customer throughout product planning, Agile delivery, release, adoption, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Build effective working relationships across cross-functional teams to facilitate alignment, remove ambiguity, and support successful execution.
  • Communicate product priorities, roadmap decisions, requirements, Agile process expectations, change impacts, and release plans to stakeholders at multiple organizational levels.
  • Influence decisions and build consensus among stakeholders without formal authority, especially during operating model changes and PDLC framework adoption.
  • Support and execute go-to-market strategies for new products, features, releases, and product process changes that impact customers or internal teams.
  • Partner with marketing, sales, implementation, and client services teams to define target audiences, launch readiness plans, communication strategies, enablement requirements, and training needs.
  • Develop and maintain release notes, product documentation, user guides, training materials, customer communications, and internal readiness materials.
  • Support product positioning, adoption initiatives, customer onboarding, competitive differentiation efforts, and internal enablement for the Provider Analytics portfolio.
  • Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and product benchmarking activities to understand industry trends and market opportunities.
  • Monitor healthcare technology, provider analytics, healthcare operations, Agile product management, and business intelligence markets to identify emerging capabilities and innovations.
  • Utilize competitive intelligence to support product strategy, feature prioritization, differentiation initiatives, and investment recommendations.
  • Serve as a product ambassador and subject matter expert for InfoDive® and assigned Provider Analytics products.
  • Communicate product vision, roadmap plans, enhancement opportunities, customer value propositions, change rationale, and Agile PDLC transition progress internally and externally as appropriate.
  • Support customer presentations, demonstrations, industry events, stakeholder meetings, change readiness discussions, and training activities as needed.
  • Foster enthusiasm and adoption of Provider Analytics products and standardized Agile PDLC practices among internal and external stakeholders.
  • Apply knowledge of provider operations, healthcare analytics, practice management workflows, financial management processes, pharmacy operations, and healthcare data environments to product strategy and feature development.

Experience and Educational Requirements:

  • B.S./B.A. required; M.B.A. or advanced degree strongly preferred.
  • Requires a minimum of 5+ years of experience in data analytics, preferably with a company serving the provider space.
  • Previous experience as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, Associate Product Manager, Product Manager, or similar product development role preferred.
  • Proven success managing products throughout the Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC), including discovery, planning, delivery, release, adoption, and post-launch evaluation.
  • Demonstrated experience working closely with product development teams in Agile environments, including sprint ceremonies, backlog refinement, release planning, and PI planning.
  • Experience supporting organizational change, process improvement, operating model adoption, Agile transformation, or product lifecycle framework transition preferred.
  • Demonstrated track record of leading cross-functional teams and delivering successful products within complex business environments.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps (ADO), Miro, Figma, Microsoft 365 applications, and other product lifecycle management tools preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to create Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), business cases, workflow diagrams, change impact summaries, epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, release documentation, and adoption materials.
  • Certification in Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Product Management, Project Management, Change Management, or Program Management preferred.
  • Certified Product Manager (CPM), Product School certification, Prosci certification, or equivalent product/change management credentials preferred.
  • Experience supporting healthcare providers, healthcare analytics platforms, healthcare technology solutions, medical practices, or healthcare operations strongly preferred.

Highly Preferred Domain Experience:

  • Healthcare financial systems
  • Practice Management (PM) systems
  • Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
  • Medical practice operations
  • Pharmacy dispensing systems
  • Provider performance management
  • Healthcare analytics platforms
  • Business intelligence and reporting solutions
  • Agile product delivery frameworks and product operating models
  • Change management, adoption planning, and stakeholder readiness practices

Minimum Skills, Knowledge and Ability Requirements:

  • Thorough knowledge and understanding of PDLC, product management business principles, processes and technology.
  • Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail and possesses exceptional organizational abilities.
  • Excellent analytical, conceptual, and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing, engaging with all organizational levels, including leadership, sales, client services, and data architects/engineers, as well as external customers.
  • Solid teamwork and interpersonal skills with proven ability to lead cross-functional teams without formal authority.
  • Excellent presentation skills demonstrated by the capability to explain strategies and technical information clearly, build rapport, persuade audiences, and gain support.
  • Must possess ability to write clear, concise instructional documents (requirements) and all communications regarding general product specifications (product profiles).
  • Well organized with demonstrated success in planning and managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced organization, in both direct and matrix team management structures.
  • Demonstrated skill in self-learning to enhance understanding of team technology solutions.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive alignment without formal authority.
  • Proven ability to translate customer needs and business objectives into prioritized product requirements and delivery plans.
  • Experience conducting customer research, market research, feature analysis, product analysis, and competitive analysis.
  • Technical understanding of analytics platforms, reporting tools, workflow technologies, and healthcare data environments.
  • Demonstrated business acumen with the ability to balance customer needs, technical constraints, operational considerations, and financial objectives.
  • Ability to independently learn new technologies, healthcare workflows, operational processes, and solution concepts.
  • Ability to respond effectively to changing priorities and challenging situations.

What Cencora offers

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. This encompasses support for working families, which may include backup dependent care, adoption assistance, infertility coverage, family building support, behavioral health solutions, paid parental leave, and paid caregiver leave. To encourage your personal growth, we also offer a variety of training programs, professional development resources, and opportunities to participate in mentorship programs, employee resource groups, volunteer activities, and much more. jobs.description:
“Mineralys Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone. Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor. Mineralys is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. For more information, please visit . Follow Mineralys on LinkedIn, Twitter and Bluesky”

Mineralys is a fully remote company.

Director of Tax

The Director of Tax is responsible for developing, leading, and executing the Company's global tax strategy, tax compliance, tax accounting, and tax planning activities. As Mineralys transitions from a clinical-stage biotechnology company to a commercial-stage public biopharmaceutical organization, this role will build scalable tax processes and infrastructure to support commercialization, domestic and international growth, and evolving regulatory requirements. The Director of Tax serves as the Company's internal tax expert and strategic advisor, partnering closely with Finance, Legal, Commercial, Supply Chain, Treasury, Human Resources, and external advisors.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead all aspects of the Company's worldwide tax function, including income tax compliance, tax accounting, indirect taxes, transfer pricing, tax planning, and tax risk management.
  • Own the quarterly and annual income tax provision under ASC 740, including deferred taxes, valuation allowances, uncertain tax positions, effective tax rate analysis, and financial statement disclosures.
  • Manage federal, state, local, and international tax compliance through external advisors while maintaining ownership of all tax filings and deadlines.
  • Develop the Company's commercial tax strategy supporting product launch, including indirect tax, state and local tax, inventory-related tax matters, distribution structures, and commercial contracting.
  • Partner with Commercial, Market Access, Supply Chain, Legal, Treasury, and Accounting regarding tax implications of pricing, rebates, chargebacks, royalties, distribution arrangements, licensing agreements, and other commercial transactions.
  • Lead transfer pricing strategy, documentation, and compliance supporting existing and future international operations.
  • Oversee R&D tax credits, orphan drug incentives, and other available tax incentives.
  • Support financing transactions, collaborations, licensing, business development, acquisitions, restructurings, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Serve as the primary contact for tax audits and partner with external auditors on tax accounting matters.
  • Develop scalable tax policies, SOX controls, documentation, and automation supporting a growing public company.
  • Monitor changes in tax legislation and advise executive management regarding business impacts.

Skills & Attributes:

  • Deep technical knowledge of U.S. corporate taxation and ASC 740.
  • Experience in the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or life sciences industry.
  • Experience supporting commercial product launches and related tax considerations.
  • Strong understanding of transfer pricing, state and local tax, indirect tax, and international tax concepts.
  • Strong knowledge of SOX and internal controls over tax processes.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex tax matters to non-tax stakeholders.
  • Strategic mindset balanced with hands-on execution.
  • High integrity and commitment to ethical business practices.
  • Experience with ERP systems (ideally NetSuite) and tax technology.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Taxation required.
  • CPA required.
  • Master of Taxation (MST), JD/LLM (Tax), or equivalent advanced education preferred.
  • 10–15 years of progressive corporate tax experience with increasing leadership responsibility.
  • Public company biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or life sciences experience strongly preferred.
  • Big Four or large public accounting firm tax experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience with ASC 740, SEC reporting, SOX compliance, and commercial-stage tax matters.
  • Experience supporting transfer pricing, licensing transactions, financing activities, and international operations.

Travel

  • This position requires up to 10% travel. Frequently travel is outside the local area and overnight.

This position is eligible for standard Company benefits including medical, dental, vision, time off and 401K, as well as participating in Mineralys incentive plans are contingent on achievement of personal and company performance. Actual compensation may vary from posted hiring range based on geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level.

jobs.description:
Attain Partners is an innovative consulting firm dedicated to disrupting the status quo to change the world and improve the lives of those we touch. From strategy to technology and everywhere in between, our experts use their unique skills to advance the important missions of education, nonprofit, healthcare, and state and local government clients.

People are at the center of all we do, and that’s why we empower career growth, provide industry-leading benefits packages, encourage a flexible work environment, and foster a culture of inclusion to support the needs of our team. We share a collective passion for our mission and our people. Guided by our seven core values, The Attain Way, our vision is the foundation of our culture—to be and attain the best.

Principal Consultant – Data Lead

Role Overview

The Principal Consultant – Data Lead serves as the senior data leader for Higher Education transformation engagements, with a strong requirement for experience with Ascend CRM and Advancement data.

This role combines Engagement Leadership, hands-on SQL and data development, Data Strategy, Data Governance, and Integration Advisory. The individual must be comfortable leading executive and client conversations while also working directly with technical teams to analyze data, develop SQL, define integration patterns, and drive successful delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Engagement & Client Leadership

  • Serve as the primary data and technical point of contact for client leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Build trusted client relationships and ensure strong satisfaction, retention, and value realization.
  • Provide oversight across project scope, schedule, budget, risks, quality, and deliverables.
  • Lead and mentor consultants, business analysts, developers, and other project team members.
  • Facilitate executive and working-team discussions, resolve issues proactively, and align delivery with client objectives.
  • Identify risks, dependencies, and decisions requiring client or project leadership attention.
  • Translate technical delivery activities into clear business outcomes and executive-level communication.

Higher Education / Ascend CRM Leadership

  • Bring strong knowledge of Higher Education Advancement data and CRM processes, preferably with direct Ascend CRM implementation or migration experience.
  • Understand constituent, household, organization, gift, campaign, fund/designation, prospect, portfolio, and engagement data.
  • Advise clients on data migration, conversion, reconciliation, integration, and data quality strategies associated with Ascend implementations.
  • Partner with functional Advancement teams to translate business requirements into data and technical solutions.
  • Understand the relationships between Advancement CRM, finance, identity, marketing, analytics, and other institutional systems.

SQL Development & Data Engineering

The Data Lead must remain technically hands-on and capable of directly supporting development when needed.

  • Write and troubleshoot complex SQL queries.
  • Analyze large datasets to identify data quality, transformation, mapping, and reconciliation issues.
  • Support source-to-target mapping and migration development.
  • Perform data profiling and assist with cleansing, normalization, deduplication, and transformation rules.
  • Support developers during complex migration and integration troubleshooting.

Data Strategy

  • Serve as a bridge between executive leadership, business stakeholders, functional teams, and technical engineering/analytics teams.
  • Translate organizational goals and business requirements into actionable data strategies and technical requirements.
  • Develop current-state and future-state data architectures and roadmaps.
  • Advise clients on data platforms, integration patterns, analytics architecture, master data, and enterprise data management.
  • Help clients define how operational, CRM, financial, engagement, and analytical data should work together across the organization.

Data Governance & Data Quality

  • Establish and advise on enterprise data governance frameworks.
  • Define data ownership, stewardship, accountability, and decision-making structures.
  • Develop data standards, business definitions, and data quality controls.
  • Establish processes for:
  • Data quality monitoring
  • Data remediation
  • Data ownership
  • Metadata and definitions
  • Data lifecycle management
  • Governance escalation and decision making
  • Partner with business and technical stakeholders to embed governance into operational processes rather than treating governance as a standalone initiative.

Integration Advisory

  • Strategy & Planning: Design integration architectures and blueprints, map end-to-end data flows, define integration patterns, and establish technical requirements across cloud and on-premise environments.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with business stakeholders, IT teams, application owners, architects, and external vendors to align integration requirements, priorities, dependencies, and business outcomes.
  • Execution & Delivery Oversight: Provide technical leadership across design, development, testing, deployment, and stabilization while managing risks, dependencies, timelines, and overall solution quality.
  • Support & Troubleshooting: Analyze integration failures, logs, data issues, and system errors; coordinate root-cause analysis and resolution of production incidents and interface issues.
  • Integration Advisory: Serve as a subject matter expert on integration architecture, patterns, platforms, and best practices, recommending improvements that increase scalability, reliability, maintainability, and operational efficiency.
  • Standards & Governance: Establish reusable integration standards, naming conventions, error-handling approaches, monitoring practices, security requirements, and documentation expectations.
  • Platform Guidance: Advise on the appropriate use of APIs, batch/file processing, ETL/ELT, event-driven architecture, real-time and near-real-time integrations, and middleware/iPaaS platforms.
  • Provide advisory guidance across platforms such as MuleSoft, Boomi, Informatica, Workato, Azure, AWS, and similar enterprise integration technologies.

Required Qualifications

  • Significant consulting experience leading complex enterprise data initiatives.
  • Experience within Higher Education, preferably Advancement, fundraising, alumni relations, or constituent data.
  • Experience with Ascend CRM strongly preferred.
  • Strong hands-on SQL development capabilities.
  • Experience with data migration, source-to-target mapping, transformation, data quality, integration, and reconciliation.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead client engagements and communicate effectively with executive stakeholders.
  • Experience leading cross-functional technical and functional teams.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise data architecture, data governance, integration architecture, and data management principles.
  • Experience designing or advising on APIs, ETL/ELT, batch, real-time, and event-driven integration patterns.
  • Ability to move between executive strategy discussions and detailed technical problem solving.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is not purely a project manager, architect, or developer. This person can operate across all three levels:

Executive: Build trust, communicate strategy, manage risk, and advise leadership.

Delivery: Own outcomes, coordinate teams, manage scope and priorities, and drive decisions.

Technical: Get into the data, write SQL, review mappings, design integration approaches, troubleshoot interfaces, and help solve difficult migration and data-quality problems.

The successful candidate should be viewed by the client as the overall Data Lead and trusted advisor for the engagement, while remaining technical enough to work directly alongside developers, architects, analysts, integration teams, and client data teams.

Additional Requirements:

  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted advisor relationships with clients
  • Experience supporting sales and business development
  • Position requires flexibility to travel periodically based on business and client needs

Additional Information

Attain Partners values your mental, emotional, and physical health and wellbeing. Our comprehensive benefits package starts on your first day of employment and includes benefits such as:

  • Competitive health, dental, and vision coverage, HSA and FSA accounts, life and disability insurance, fertility and family planning benefits, and employee assistance and discount programs
  • 11 paid federal holidays and flexible unlimited time off (UTO)

  • A healthy environment where we value unique experiences, and care about everything that makes you, you.

Attain Partners is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Individual compensation will be commensurate with experience, education, and skills.

Attain Partners is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The individual base salary for this position is unique to each candidate and will be commensurate with experience, education, and skills. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus.

jobs.description:
Location: Remote

Required Education: Bachelors Degree
Required Experience: 2 years

Position Description

The RMF / CSAM Analyst is responsible for ensuring the FSA IAM system maintains continuous security authorization and compliance through the Risk Management Framework (RMF) and the Cyber Security Assessment and Management (CSAM) tool. This role supports the secure operation of the new cloud-based IAM solution while meeting all federal standards for identity services.

Responsibilities

The RMF / CSAM Analyst ensures the IAM solution complies with FedRAMP requirements, OMB M-24-15 guidance, and NIST SP 800-63 Digital Identity Guidelines. They manage event logging to meet OMB M-21-31 standards and oversee proper encryption of data at rest (AES-256 with SHA-256) and data in transit (latest TLS protocols). The analyst supports Security Incident Management, maintains environment support documentation, and handles key user data encryption and protection requirements. In CSAM, they manage security controls and inheritance statements, track and remediate Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) items, support FISMA reporting and corrective action plans, address Continuous Diagnostics and Monitoring (CDM) findings, handle Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) responses, and maintain the Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) scorecard at the required level or higher. Additional responsibilities include supporting supply chain risk management, data planning, federal records and Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) handling, IT accessibility (Section 508), technology business management reporting, and project, risk, and schedule documentation needed to sustain the Authority to Operate (ATO).

Required Qualifications

  • Strong knowledge of NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF) and CSAM tool
    - Experience with FedRAMP, FISMA, POA&M management, and security control inheritance
    - Familiarity with NIST SP 800-63, OMB M-21-31, and cloud security requirements
    - Ability to analyze scan results, develop corrective action plans, and track remediation
    - Excellent documentation, organization, and attention to detail skills
    - Clear communication and collaboration with ISSOs, security teams, and stakeholders
    - Understanding of data encryption, logging, and compliance reporting
    - Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and compliance tracking systems
    - Ability to work effectively on both routine compliance tasks and urgent security issues
    - Commitment to maintaining high cybersecurity standards in a federal environment
    - Detail-oriented with excellent documentation and tracking skills

PingWind is focused on delivering outstanding services to the federal government. PingWind is an SBA certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) with offices in Northern Virginia and Huntsville AL.

Who are we?

At Blue Coding, we specialize in hiring excellent professionals and amazing people from all over Latin America and other parts of the world. Our team is highly connected, united, and culturally diverse, and our collaborators are involved in many initiatives around the world, from wildlife preservation to volunteering at local charities. We stand for honesty, fairness, respect, efficiency, hard work, and cooperation

Our client is a real estate private equity firm that manages the full development lifecycle, from land acquisition and entitlements through vertical construction, stabilization, and long-term asset management

What are we looking for?

We are looking for an experienced VP of Finance/Controller to lead the accounting, reporting, and financial operations. The firm's active development pipeline comprises six communities across the US totaling more than 706 multifamily units and over $229M in total development budget, along with a hospitality project in Tucson.

If you have deep experience in real estate development accounting, private equity fund structures, construction draws, job cost accounting, and investor financial reporting, this is a great fit for you.

What's unique about this job?

Reporting to the CFO/Managing Partner, you'll build and oversee all fund-level and project-level accounting processes, ensure GAAP compliance, support capital-raising efforts, and serve as a key partner to executive leadership on a growing real estate private equity platform focused on ground-up development, build-to-rent communities, and value-add multifamily assets.

This is a high-ownership role in a fast-growing platform, where you'll also build the FP&A function over time, including hiring and mentoring analysts and establishing a disciplined reporting cadence.

Here are some of the exciting day-to-day challenges you will face in this role:

  • Oversee all accounting for GP and LP entities, including consolidations under ASC 810; manage capital calls, distributions, waterfalls, and carried interest calculations.
  • Prepare monthly financial statements, partner capital statements, and investor reports; coordinate annual audits and tax returns with external audit and tax firms.
  • Oversee job costing, construction draw packages, and reconciliation of development budgets, including WIP schedules, soft vs. hard costs, and capitalization of costs per GAAP (ASC 360).
  • Own commitment accounting for long-term construction contracts and review and approve monthly general contractor pay applications (AIA G702/G703 or equivalent) against the schedule of values and contracted commitment.
  • Establish and enforce change order, retainage, and lien waiver controls, including approval requirements and release procedures at project closeout.
  • Manage AP, AR, payroll, cash flow forecasting, and the corporate general ledger; oversee development management fee billing and ensure intercompany billings are recorded, reconciled, and eliminated properly in consolidation.
  • Own the annual budgeting and long-range planning process across corporate, fund, and project entities, and build the firm's core forecast models, including rolling 13-week cash flow, multi-year P&L, balance sheet, and liquidity/runway projections.
  • Lead the monthly and quarterly re-forecast cycle, reconciling each update to the prior forecast and delivering budget-vs-actual variance analysis with written commentary on drivers, risks, and corrective action.
  • Develop and maintain underwriting and investment models for new acquisitions and development opportunities, stress-testing key assumptions through sensitivity and scenario analysis.
  • Model capital structure and financing decisions, including construction loan draws, refinancing, and debt sizing, and evaluate their impact on project and fund returns (IRR, equity multiple, DSCR, debt yield).
  • Define and track the KPIs and management dashboards used to measure fund, project, and corporate performance, and present financial results and strategic recommendations to the CFO, Managing Partner, and investors.
  • Assist in preparing investor reporting packages, capital account statements, and due diligence materials to support capital raises and institutional partners.
  • Implement and improve accounting systems (Intuit Enterprise Suite & bill.com), internal controls, and closing procedures; monitor covenants, reporting deadlines, and lender deliverables.

You will shine if you have:

  • Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; MBA from a top-tier institution preferred. CPA/CA nice to have.
  • 5–10+ years of progressive accounting experience in private equity, real estate development, or REIT/multifamily.
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP, particularly ASC 810, 323, 360, 970, 842, and fund accounting principles.
  • Experience with construction accounting, cost segregation concepts, and investment accounting.
  • Hands-on experience with multi-entity structures, joint ventures, waterfalls, and investor allocations.
  • Demonstrated FP&A leadership experience, including ownership of budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling for a multi-entity organization; advanced financial modeling skills required.
  • Advanced Excel skills; familiarity with Intuit Enterprise Suite a plus.
  • Advanced data analytics and database management skills required.
  • High attention to detail, strong communication skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Director of Credit Risk Management to lead the credit risk function for our payments and fintech platform. This role owns the strategy, policies, and infrastructure that manage counterparty, merchant, and transactional credit exposure across our payment products — including merchant acquiring, lending, and embedded finance offerings. The ideal candidate combines deep quantitative credit risk expertise with hands-on leadership of underwriting, portfolio monitoring, and loss mitigation teams, and partners closely with Product, Data Science, Finance, Compliance, and Operations to balance growth with prudent risk management.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end credit risk strategy for the company's payments and fintech portfolio, including merchant/counterparty underwriting, exposure limits, reserve requirements, and loss forecasting.
  • Design, implement, and continuously refine credit risk policies, scorecards, and underwriting models to balance risk appetite with revenue and conversion goals.
  • Build and lead a high-performing team of credit risk managers and analysts; set goals, coach performance, and develop talent.
  • Monitor portfolio performance (delinquency, chargebacks, default rates, loss ratios) and proactively identify emerging risk trends across merchant segments, verticals, and payment products.
  • Partner with Data Science/Analytics to develop and validate credit scoring models, machine-learning underwriting tools, and early-warning indicators.
  • Set and manage credit risk appetite, exposure limits, and reserve/collateral policies in partnership with Finance and Treasury.
  • Lead loss mitigation, collections strategy, and workout processes for delinquent or high-risk accounts.
  • Present credit risk metrics, portfolio health, and key decisions to executive leadership, Risk Committee, and the Board as needed.
  • Ensure credit risk practices comply with applicable regulatory requirements (e.g., card network rules, BSA/AML-adjacent controls, state lending regulations) in partnership with Legal and Compliance.
  • Own credit risk components of due diligence for new products, partnerships, and market expansion, including BNPL, embedded lending, and merchant cash advance offerings.
  • Drive automation and scalability of credit underwriting and monitoring processes to support rapid business growth.
  • Manage relationships with external data providers, bureaus, and risk technology vendors.

Qualifications

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in credit risk management, with at least 5–7 years in a senior leadership role; payments, fintech, card issuing/acquiring, or commercial lending background strongly preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Statistics, or related field required; MBA or advanced quantitative degree a plus.

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES

  • Proven experience building or scaling a credit risk function, including underwriting frameworks, portfolio monitoring, and loss mitigation at a high-growth or transaction-volume business.
  • Strong quantitative background: experience with credit scoring models, statistical/ML-based underwriting, and portfolio risk analytics.
  • Track record of managing exposure and losses across a merchant or borrower portfolio, including chargeback/dispute risk, fraud-adjacent losses, and counterparty default.
  • Deep understanding of payments ecosystem dynamics (card networks, ACH, merchant acquiring, or lending) and related regulatory frameworks.
  • Demonstrated people leadership: hiring, developing, and managing credit risk or underwriting teams.
  • Excellent executive communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership, Risk Committees, or Boards.
  • Experience with SQL, Python, R, or similar tools for risk analytics preferred.

The RCM Reimbursement Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the billing, collections, and reimbursement operations within the revenue cycle, ensuring compliance with HIPAA, Medicare/Medicaid, private payor, and regulatory requirements. This role supervises internal teams and external vendors, ensures prompt and accurate claim resolution, and implements best practices to optimize collections, reduce denials, and meet key performance indicators such as cash goals, aging, quality, and productivity. The Supervisor plays a key role in team training, operational improvements, and the use of technology to enhance efficiency and compliance.

Major Areas of Accountability

  • Comfort Medical employees are required to conduct business to the highest ethical and professional standards; comply with applicable laws and regulations, the Advamed Code of Ethics on Interactions with Healthcare Professionals, and company policies.

Leadership & Team Management:

  • Supervise and support billing and collections teams, including vendor liaisons, to ensure efficient workflow and timely resolution of accounts.
  • Train and onboard new team members; monitor performance and provide ongoing coaching and development.
  • Ensure adherence to departmental policies, HIPAA and PHI regulations, and corporate compliance standards.
  • Promote a positive team culture by encouraging individual growth, accountability, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Act as point of contact for internal and external stakeholders for escalations, inquiries, and operational issues. Lead and participate in operational projects, system upgrades, and departmental initiatives.
  • Facilitate best practice sharing across departments and assist leadership in implementing constructive changes.

Revenue Cycle Oversight:

  • Oversee billing, collections, and reimbursement functions, including claim submissions, payment posting, denial management, and patient responsibility determinations.
  • Review and resolve claim rejections and exceptions; ensure appropriate follow-up on aged accounts and outstanding A/R.
  • Utilize knowledge of payer policies, DME billing guidelines, and coding (ICD, CPT, HCPCS) to ensure clean claim submission and low denial rates.
  • Ensure timely processing of all account correspondence, refunds, adjustments, and re-billing as needed.
  • Manage relationships with external collection vendors, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations and alignment with performance goals.
  • Collaborate with insurance verification, medical records, payment posting, and patient pay teams as needed to support full-cycle resolution.
  • Reporting & Analysis:
  • Generate, analyze, and distribute key performance reports on production, inventory, aged accounts, denial trends, and vendor performance.
  • Monitor team productivity and identify areas for process improvement; assist with implementation of new tools and technologies.
  • Use data analysis (including Excel and Power BI) to develop actionable insights and support decision-making.

Compliance & Quality Assurance:

  • Ensure operations comply with all regulatory guidelines, including HIPAA, Medicare/Medicaid, third-party payors, OSHA, and accrediting agencies.
  • Identify and escalate non-compliant activity; participate in audits and quality assurance reviews.
  • Maintain accurate documentation in billing systems and CRM per company standards.
  • Additional Responsibilities:
  • Act as trusted advisor to our Comfort Medical management team on select projects and tasks.
  • Facilitate sharing of operational best practices across departments within the organization.
  • Travel as required for vendor meetings or departmental support.
  • Other duties as assigned. (Major job functions)

Basic Qualifications

  • High School diploma required.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in healthcare payor and/or provider settings, with strong functional knowledge in revenue cycle management.
  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in Durable Medical Equipment (DME).
  • At least 4 years’ experience in billing, collections, and payment posting.
  • Strong knowledge of governmental and commercial payors, billing codes (ICD, CPT, HCPCS), EOBs/ERNs, and payer compliance rules.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Power BI Apps.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and analytical skills.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree preferred.

At Coloplast, we believe in recognizing and rewarding the contributions of our employees. Our total rewards package is designed to support your well-being, foster your professional growth, and ensure a healthy work-life balance. Here is some of what you can expect:

  • Health and Wellness:Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance plans to keep you and your family healthy. Plus, access to company sponsored wellness programs and mental health resources, paid leave of absence for qualifying events and generous paid parental leave for both birthing and non-birthing parents.
  • Financial Security:A competitive 401(k) plan with company match that vest immediately, financial planning services to help you secure your future, and corporate discount programs for goods and services.
  • Work-Life Balance:Generous paid time off, flexible work hours, and flexible work arrangement options to help you balance your personal and professional life may be available.
  • Professional Development:Opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement through training programs, mentorship, and tuition reimbursement.
  • Recognition and Rewards:Recognition programs to celebrate achievements and contributions, including peer recognition, bonuses, awards, and special events.
  • Community and Culture:A supportive work environment where everyone feels valued and has a sense of belonging.Participate in team-building activities, volunteer opportunities, and company-sponsored events. Sustainability strategy that outlines our ambitions for how to run our company in a more sustainable way.
  • Competitive Compensation:The compensation range for this position is $81,513 - $122,269. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location. Hired candidates may be eligible to receive additional compensation in the form of bonuses and/or incentives.

Comfort Medical provides an extensive selection of name brand catheter and ostomy supplies to thousands of customers nationwide. Our attention to detail, unmatched customer service, and dedication to helping our customers live happier, healthier lives are just a few of the many reasons we are one of the fastest growing catheter and ostomy supply companies in the nation!​

Job Description:

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced senior-level Human-Centered Design (HCD) and user interface expert to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will also possess strong expertise in Information Architecture (IA), including the organization, structure, labeling, navigation, and discoverability of complex information and application functionality. This role requires a candidate who can provide detailed and useful interface design specifications to development teams, ensuring the creation of intuitive, user-friendly applications.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide subject matter expertise in UX design, offering strategic guidance grounded in Human-Centered Design and design thinking methodologies, including user research, personas, journey mapping, prototyping, mockups, and usability evaluation.
    • Provide subject matter expertise in Information Architecture, defining scalable structures, navigation models, taxonomies, labeling systems, content hierarchies, and information relationships that enable users to efficiently find, understand, and complete tasks.
    • Create and deliver a User Experience (UX) Research Plan and Outcomes for each use case, which shall include a research write-up documenting goals, anticipated outcomes, research questions, hypotheses, methodology, recruiting needs, synthesis, and next steps.
    • Facilitate discovery activities, to include generative research with users and business stakeholders, an assessment of current related features, a content review, an information architecture review, an accessibility review, a business process review; and collection of any available data and analytics and provide in a User Experience Research Checklist.
    • Partner with other Product Teams to ensure that the new tool or service fits into the existing structure.
    • Collaborate across Product Teams to establish consistent navigation, terminology, categorization, and information structures across features, applications, and services.
    • Lead the design and development of user interfaces for various applications, ensuring they are visually appealing, user-friendly, and efficient.
    • Provide clear and actionable interface design specifications to development teams.
    • Design dynamic forms and other complex UI components, including rich cards and drag & drop features.
    • Define and maintain UX frameworks and templates for developers to use during the coding process.
    • Define and maintain Information Architecture standards, patterns, and documentation to promote consistency, scalability, and usability across the product ecosystem.
    • Apply insights from user experience research studies to describe product functionality, including epics and user stories, as well as operational, business, functional, technical, data, and integration requirements.
    • Support design synthesis activities and generate insights and opportunities for improvement. Communicate research findings through a variety of formats (such as insight reports, stories, videos, storyboards, etc.) to maximize relevance and impact.
    • Perform requirements analysis based on User Experience Research, obtaining stakeholder input from internal users and external users.
    • Develop User Personas to represent user types that have wants and needs of our applications and products, and who might use our applications and products in a similar way.
    • Create Customer and User Journey Maps and capture related data.
    • Map user journeys, workflows, content, and system functionality to an overall Information Architecture to ensure individual features support a coherent end-to-end user experience.
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product owners, developers, and other designers.
    • Conduct usability testing sessions to gather feedback on designs and apply results to refine designs.
    • Write and edit plain language content for Development Teams.
    • Establish clear, consistent, and user-centered terminology and labeling conventions in collaboration with UX, content, business, and technical stakeholders.
    • Design, test, and deliver low- and high-fidelity wireframes, prototypes, and interactive web forms, updating them as needed to support stakeholder collaboration, usability testing, facilitated demos, and iterative design improvements.
    • Lead user testing sessions and conduct thorough analysis to inform design improvements.
    • Establish and uphold design standards across project components.
    • Establish and uphold Information Architecture standards across project components, ensuring consistency in navigation, hierarchy, terminology, categorization, and content organization.
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of UI/UX designs.
    • Work with ReactJS, JavaScript, CSS, HTML and Tailwind to develop and refine user interfaces.
    • Design within a micro-service architecture to create scalable and maintainable solutions.

Qualifications:

  • MA/MS plus 10+ years of general experience in information systems with 8+ years of specialized experience.
    • HS (16+ years), AA/AS (14+ years), BA/BS (12+ years), Doctorate Degree/Ph.D. (9+ years)
    • Familiarity with front-end development and specifically in ReactJS and JavaScript development.
    • Familiarity with UX, information architecture, content strategy, and best practices in user centered design.
    • Extensive experience developing Information Architecture for complex enterprise applications, including navigation structures, taxonomies, hierarchies, labeling systems, and information models.
    • Experience conducting IA research and validation methods such as card sorting, tree testing, content inventories, taxonomy evaluation, and navigation testing.
    • Experience creating and maintaining IA deliverables such as site maps, application maps, navigation models, taxonomy documentation, content hierarchies, and information architecture diagrams.
    • Experience with designing software to align to strategic business needs and goals.
    • Experience in conducting research for advanced technologies to determining how IT can support business needs leveraging software, hardware, or infrastructure.
    • Experience in Figma or other related design tool.
    • Experience in usability testing tools.
    • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically.
    • Strong communication skills, with the ability to articulate design concepts and decisions to stakeholders.
    • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
    • Proven track record of delivering scalable and reliable software solutions.
    • A portfolio demonstrating expertise in UI/UX design and relevant projects, including experience with Information Architecture deliverables and the organization of complex enterprise applications or digital products.
    • Proven experience in designing dynamic forms with a strong emphasis on intuitive user experience and efficient design.
    • Extensive experience in creating CSS cards and drag & drop functionality.
    • Experience on UX strategy, user researcher, user interviews, surveys, and usability study. Builds personas, user journey map, empathy maps.
    • Experience on UX analysis to conduct competitive analysis, market assessments and heuristic evaluations.
    • Experienced in using user feedback to inform UX improvements and guide design decisions.
    • Extensive hands-on experience in developing and testing wireframes and prototypes.
    • Detailed knowledge of Section 508 requirements, and experience designing interfaces to be 508 compliant.
    • Understanding of accessibility considerations related to Information Architecture, including accessible navigation, heading hierarchy, meaningful labels, consistent terminology, and predictable information structures.
    • Demonstrated ability to generate innovative solutions to complex design problems.
    • Solid background in defining and maintaining design standards.
    • Solid background in defining and maintaining Information Architecture standards and governance across large or complex applications.
    • Experience working with tools like Jira, Confluence extensively for work item tracking and documentation.
    • Experience working in an agile environment with a knowledge of SAFe.
    • Understanding of Agile methodologies.

Communication and Organizational

  • Excellent presentation and communication (oral and written) skills.
    • Consultant mindset with the ability to work with high level customer stakeholders and build excellent customer relationship.
    • Experience identifying and applying industry tools, solutions, methods best practices, and emerging technologies.
    • Strong analytical skills and problem-solving skills with the ability to formulate and communicate recommendations for improvement.
    • Experienced with process design and documentation methodologies, and design and production of quality deliverables, process and use case modeling, business case development.
    • Ability to facilitate Information Architecture workshops and alignment sessions with users, stakeholders, product teams, and technical teams to establish shared understanding of terminology, navigation, hierarchy, and application structure.
    • Ability to clearly communicate and document Information Architecture decisions, rationale, dependencies, and recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences.
    • Demonstrated ability to work effectively, independently, and as part of a team.
    • Strong project management, leadership & meeting facilitation skill with knowledge of Project Life Cycle

You will own and test initiatives across the full recovery lifecycle — from customer risk scoring and soft collections to hard collections and equipment repossession.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead projects aimed at improving collections and equipment recovery performance.
  • Develop, test and optimize strategies to reduce delinquency, fraud, theft and asset loss.
  • Improve customer risk scoring using customers’ data, payment history, and operational data.
  • Optimize the full recovery process: early-stage collections, payment plans, hard collections, repossession and external escalation.
  • Analyze portfolio performance and identify patterns behind default, fraud and equipment loss.
  • Design and test new workflows, policies, communication strategies and recovery approaches.
  • Define and improve KPIs across collections, fraud and repossession.
  • Use AI coding tools such as Codex and Claude Code for data analysis, prototyping, automation and internal tool development.
  • Work closely with Operations, Customer Support, Analytics, and Marketing teams to implement changes.
  • Track results and report directly to senior management and founders.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in project or product management within operationally complex businesses, with responsibility for improving processes, systems, and business performance.
  • Strong analytical and project management skills.
  • Strong understanding of operational processes and data-driven decision-making.
  • Experience with collections, delinquent customers, fraud prevention or asset recovery is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools such as Codex, Claude Code or similar is required.
  • Comfortable working with CRM/ERP systems, workflows and operational data.
  • Ability to independently identify problems, test solutions and drive implementation.
  • Fluent English (C1+).
  • Russian language proficiency is a plus.
  • Availability during US Eastern Time business hours.

Benefits

  • Join New York’s largest e-bike rental company, a fast-growing startup that has raised $20M+ in funding.

jobs.excerpt: About CogstateAt Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.
jobs.description:
About Cogstate

At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

About the Clinician Network

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.

Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

All applicants to the Clinician Network are kept in our active pipeline, and you’ll also receive our monthly Clinician Network newsletter, which shares updates and upcoming openings.

About the Role

Cogstate Clinicians are clinical psychologists or neuropsychologists responsible for delivering remote clinical interviews and cognitive assessment batteries to subjects with preclinical dementia, enrolled in a pharmaceutical clinical trial.

Cogstate provides all consultants with comprehensive, fully compensated training on general Cogstate operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing skills and virtual cognitive assessment prior to performing remote scale administrations. Regular supervision and ongoing recalibration of clinical skill set will be provided.

*These are contract position.

*They are fully remote.

*Hired employee will work on an as needed basis based on their schedule.

- VINELAND/VABS Administration Experience Required
- French Fluency Required

Key Responsibilities

Central Rating

  • Remotely administering semi-structured clinical interview assessments and cognitive battery of tests to study subjects and caregivers.
  • Remotely delivering computerized and traditional cognitive assessments via a tele-health platform.
  • Scoring completed scale administrations.
  • Participating in regular clinical skill recalibration activities.

Central Monitoring

  • Providing reviews of completed neuropsychological test batteries for central monitoring of data to ensure accuracy in administration and scoring and contribute to the overall success of a clinical trial.
  • Reviewing response forms and recordings of remote scale administrations and offering feedback to raters via email and telephone communications.

Qualifications & Expertise

  • MA/MS in Psychology or equivalent
  • ≥25 administrations of study scales or similar semi-structured clinical interviews
  • Experience working with pediatric populations with neurodevelopmental delays
    • Rare disease experience is a plus, including Angelman syndrome, Phelan-McDermid syndrome, Fragile X syndrome, or similar disorders
  • Vineland/VABS administration experience
  • Formal training in clinical interviewing and cognitive assessment, including experience working with pediatric populations and caregivers
  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience with direct clinical interviewing and psychological assessment in clinical research industry, academic or clinical settings
  • Direct experience with cognitive/behavioral/functional assessment of neurological/psychiatric populations
  • Ability to meet deadlines, being highly organized and methodical, with attention to detail to ensure delivery
  • Proficiency with MS Office, including Word and Excel, email, teleconference platforms such as Skype, Zoom or other similar applications, and cloud-based storage service.
  • French Fluency

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on the company. We collect and process your information for recruitment purposes in compliance with applicable laws, including the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs), the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), Virginia Consumer Data Protection Act (VCDPA), Colorado Privacy Act (CPA), and similar laws in other jurisdictions.

  • Excellent oral communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to prioritize.
  • Ability to identify legal issues.
  • Capable of using de-escalation skills when interacting with difficult applicants.
  • Ability to work independently and in collaboration with others.
  • Understand and adhere to strict client confidentiality rules.
  • Spanish fluency strongly preferred but not required.

Education / Experience

  • High School diploma or GED.
  • Minimum of two years legal office or call center experience. Schooling beyond the minimum requirement can be substituted of experience.

Job Factors/Physical Requirements

  • Must be or plan to be physically located in Utah.
  • This position follows a remote model, but requires occasional office travel for trainings and meetings.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Mobile
jobs.excerpt: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser, and Pocket, a service for keeping up with the best content online. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders - only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

We’re looking for a hands-on Mobile Product Manager with a primary focus on Firefox for iOS, while also contributing across mobile (including Android).

This role is about building a better browser, turning downloads into loyal users, and creating experiences that truly stand out. If you’ve shipped mobile apps, obsess over details that improve everyday use, and love turning user insights into real improvements, this is a great opportunity to drive impact at Firefox.

What you’ll do:

  • Build a fundamentally better browser experience: fix bugs, refine UI and navigation, improve downloads, menus, performance, and all the small details that make Firefox noticeably better for users who care about privacy, quality and reliability.
  • Drive strong activation and retention: focus on the new-user journey, quickly hooking people after they install the app, understanding where they drop off, and relentlessly optimizing the funnel through data, testing and iteration.
  • Deliver differentiating features and experiences that make Firefox stickier for key user groups, the kinds of things others can’t or won’t build.
  • Work closely with engineers, designers, data science and TPMs to ship high-impact improvements while balancing user needs, technical constraints, privacy and performance goals.
  • Stay deeply connected to real users: track App Store trends and discussions, test apps hands-on, analyze reviews and analytics, and turn those insights into concrete enhancements for Firefox on iOS and Android.
  • Monitor app health in App Store Connect and Google Play Console (crashes, ANRs, ratings) and support acquisition/retention efforts through ASO, store listings and growth experiments.
  • Adapt and optimize Firefox for global markets (Europe, Japan, Asia etc.), keeping cultural differences and local realities like data constraints in mind.

Back in 2019, spiderSilk was born with a bold idea: build regional, sovereign cybersecurity IP that could stand tall on the global stage.

Our mission? To shake up the way organizations protect their ever-changing digital worlds with continuous, intelligent, and autonomous security that doesn’t miss a beat.

About the Role:
As a Threat Intelligence Analyst specializing in Dark Web research, you will play a vital role in uncovering and analyzing threat actor activity across deep and dark web ecosystems. You’ll be responsible for collecting, validating, and contextualizing intelligence from hidden forums, marketplaces, and communication channels to inform spiderSilk’s clients and product teams.

This role requires investigative rigor, a strong understanding of underground communities, and the ability to convert raw intelligence into actionable insights for both internal stakeholders and enterprise clients.

  • Produce high-quality intelligence reports, alerts, and briefings tailored to both technical and executive audiences.

  • Work with product, research, and exposure teams to enrich findings with external data and client relevance.

  • Maintain strong operational security (OPSEC) protocols during intelligence gathering and engagement.

  • 2–4 years of experience in threat intelligence or cyber investigations, with a focus on dark web or underground threat monitoring.

  • Strong knowledge of dark web platforms such as TOR, I2P, and decentralized forums.

  • Familiarity with OSINT techniques, operational tooling (e.g., Maltego, Recon-ng), and data enrichment strategies.

  • Ability to recognize and interpret threat actor behavior, indicators of compromise (IOCs), and relevant geopolitical or industry trends.

  • Solid writing and analytical communication skills, with the ability to create both tactical alerts and strategic reports.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience conducting HUMINT or dark web engagement in a secure and ethical manner.

  • Foreign language skills relevant to threat actors (e.g., Russian, Arabic, Mandarin) are a significant advantage.

At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.
