Job Summary

About Elite Insurance Group
Elite Insurance Group is a multi-tier Medicare agency network supporting thousands of agents and agencies across dozens of sub-organizations nationwide. EIG combines deep Medicare distribution expertise with a growing internal technology platform (Elite Intelligence) and CRM/lead operations infrastructure to give agency partners a competitive edge in production, compliance, and growth.

Position Summary

EIG is seeking a Director of Sales Enablement & Resources to own the systems, data, training, and sales resources that help agency partners and downlines sell more effectively — CRM administration (GoHighLevel), data reporting, and process standardization across the network. This role is designed to absorb and scale the enablement work currently carried out directly by the CMO, freeing executive leadership to focus on strategy while ensuring agency partners have reliable tools, accurate data, and clear, repeatable resources to grow their business.
This is a hands-on leadership role: equal parts systems administrator, data steward, and change agent for agency partners adopting new tools and workflows.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Agency Partner & Downline Enablement

  • Act as the primary point of contact for agency partners and downlines adopting EIG's CRM, reporting, and platform tools.
    - Design and deliver training programs (live and documented) that bring new and existing agencies up to speed on standardized processes.
    - Identify inconsistent or inefficient processes across sub-agencies and drive standardization — turning tribal knowledge into repeatable, documented workflows.
    - Build feedback loops with agency partners to surface pain points and prioritize fixes or enhancements.
    - Develop and maintain a central library of sales resources — playbooks, marketing plan templates, carrier RTS/SEP guides, and targeting materials — that agency partners can self-serve.
    CRM & Platform Administration (GoHighLevel)
    - Own day-to-day administration of the GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM environment across EIG and its sub-agency accounts, including sub-account structure, permissions, pipelines, and automations.
    - Manage and troubleshoot integrations feeding into GHL (call tracking, lead sources, webhooks) and ensure data flowing in and out stays clean and reliable.
    - Reconcile CRM usage and billing against agency/sub-account activity to keep cost allocation accurate.
    - Build and maintain automated workflows that reduce manual work for agents and agency admins.
    Data Reporting & Business Intelligence
    - Own recurring reporting pipelines (weekly production, agency/agent summaries, call
    performance, SEP/DST tracking) and ensure they run on schedule with accurate, audit-ready output.
    - Serve as the primary point of accountability for reporting accuracy across the agency hierarchy — production, persistency, accretion, and compliance metrics.
    - Partner with leadership to translate raw carrier, CRM, and platform data into decision-ready reporting for agency partners and executive stakeholders.
    - Maintain and extend the Elite Intelligence platform's reporting and business intelligence modules (Reporting & Insights, Production Intelligence, Book of Business Intelligence, Carrier Performance) in coordination with development resources.
    Systems Oversight & Vendor Management
    - Oversee EIG's core technology stack, including the Elite Intelligence platform, EnrollHere account creation and training, and third-party integrations (e.g., carrier RTS feeds, Sunfire, call tracking vendors).
    - Manage relationships and technical coordination with external vendors and development resources supporting EIG's platforms.
    - Maintain data integrity standards across systems — preferring incomplete-but-accurate data over complete-but-misleading data, consistent with EIG's operating philosophy.
    - Support compliance-related data and case management needs in coordination with the compliance function.

    Qualifications
    - 5+ years in a CRM administration, business systems, data/reporting, or agency/partner training leadership role, ideally within insurance, financial services, or a multi-location/franchise-style organization.
    - Hands-on administration experience with GoHighLevel or a comparable CRM/marketing automation platform.
    - Strong data fluency — comfortable in Excel/spreadsheets at an advanced level; SQL or reporting-tool experience strongly preferred.
    - Demonstrated experience training and supporting a distributed network of partners, franchisees, or downline organizations.
    - Track record of turning ad hoc or inconsistent processes into documented, standardized, repeatable workflows.
    - Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical topics for non-technical agency partners.
    - Comfortable operating with significant autonomy and ownership in a fast-moving, builder-operator culture.
    Preferred (Nice-to-Have)
    - Medicare Advantage / health insurance industry experience, particularly within an FMO/agency hierarchy structure.
    - Familiarity with Sunfire, carrier RTS/enrollment data, or SEP/DST tracking processes.
    - Exposure to modern web application stacks (React, Node/Express, PostgreSQL) sufficient to collaborate effectively with development resources on internal platform work.
    - Experience with call tracking/call center technology (e.g., Retreaver or similar).
    - Prior experience in a role that combined data/reporting ownership with direct agency or franchisee training.
    Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)
    - Agency partners have a documented, repeatable onboarding and training path for EIG's tools and processes.
    - CRM and core reporting pipelines run reliably with minimal executive involvement.
    - Reporting accuracy and turnaround times improve measurably across production, persistency, and compliance metrics.
    - A clear backlog and prioritization process exists for platform/reporting improvements, informed directly by agency partner feedback.

Job Title: AWS Database EngineerJob Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: Public TrustEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Local* * *

The Opportunity:

CACI is seeking an experienced AWS Database Engineer to support application development, database engineering, data integration, analytics enablement, and operational database activities for the GrantSolutions platform. This position supports mission-critical Federal applications and modernization initiatives and requires hands-on expertise across Oracle, PostgreSQL, AWS database technologies, and cloud-based data solutions.

The AWS Database Engineer will work closely with application developers, architects, DevOps engineers, data engineers, Product Owners, Scrum teams, business stakeholders, and Federal partners to deliver reliable, scalable, secure, and high-performing database solutions. The ideal candidate is a self-starter with strong analytical and problem-solving skills who can quickly understand complex application data models and work effectively in an Agile environment.

This role also supports AI-enabled engineering initiatives, including the use of approved AI-assisted development and automation tools to improve engineering productivity, quality, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and software delivery.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and support Oracle database solutions, including packages, stored procedures, functions, triggers, views, materialized views, sequences, and complex SQL and PL/SQL solutions.

  • Develop, enhance, and optimize SQL, PL/SQL, and PL/pgSQL code supporting application functionality, reporting, integrations, and business operations.

  • Design, develop, administer, and optimize PostgreSQL solutions on Amazon RDS, including schemas, functions, procedures, triggers, views, extensions, indexing, partitioning, query tuning, parameter configuration, backup and recovery, high availability, and troubleshooting.

  • Create and maintain database migration scripts, schema updates, release deployment packages, and automated database deployment processes.

  • Design, build, and support ETL workflows, data transformation processes, validation frameworks, batch processing, and data integration pipelines using Matillion ETL and similar platforms.

  • Analyze complex data models, database schemas, ERDs, enterprise data flows, and data mappings to support application and business requirements.

  • Design, configure, administer, monitor, secure, and troubleshoot AWS database and data solutions using Amazon RDS for Oracle, Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL, Amazon Redshift, Amazon S3, AWS DMS, AWS SCT, Amazon CloudWatch, AWS Secrets Manager, AWS KMS, IAM, and related AWS services.

  • Implement and support AWS database migration, replication, and modernization activities, including schema assessment and conversion, endpoint configuration, full-load and change-data-capture workflows, validation, monitoring, cutover planning, and post-migration verification.

  • Implement database monitoring, logging, backup, recovery, high availability, encryption, credential management, access control, and other operational capabilities.

  • Perform database performance tuning using execution plans, indexing strategies, partitioning, optimizer statistics, and Oracle diagnostic and monitoring tools.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve database issues, data quality concerns, application integration challenges, performance bottlenecks, and production incidents across distributed environments.

  • Collaborate with software engineers, architects, DevOps engineers, data engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable and reliable data solutions.

  • Participate in Agile development activities, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily standups, code reviews, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

  • Contribute to CI/CD and DevSecOps initiatives through automated testing, deployment, monitoring, compliance, and release-management practices.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, including database designs, data mappings, interface specifications, operational procedures, and support guides.

  • Develop and support database unit testing, regression testing, data validation, migration testing, and deployment verification.

  • Support production releases, incident troubleshooting, defect triage, root-cause analysis, and post-deployment validation for mission-critical database and application components.

  • Leverage approved AI-powered development tools to support SQL and PL/SQL development, code reviews, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

  • Identify opportunities to apply AI and intelligent automation to database development, data engineering, deployment, monitoring, operational support, and engineering productivity.

  • Support data governance, security, privacy, and compliance requirements through least-privilege access, auditability, encryption-aware data handling, and applicable Federal controls, including FISMA, NIST, and FedRAMP.

  • Evaluate emerging database, cloud, AI, and data engineering technologies and identify opportunities to improve platform capabilities and team productivity.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Federal Public Trust; candidates must receive approved adjudication before onboarding. Active Public Trust or suitability determination preferred.

  • Bachelor’s degree required.

  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience in Oracle database development, database engineering, ETL development, data integration, or related software engineering roles.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Oracle SQL and PL/SQL, including packages, procedures, functions, triggers, views, materialized views, sequences, complex queries, and performance tuning.

  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and PL/pgSQL, including database administration, performance tuning, indexing, extensions, parameter configuration, backup and recovery, high availability, security, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

  • Hands-on experience designing, configuring, administering, monitoring, securing, and troubleshooting AWS database solutions using Amazon RDS for Oracle, Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL, Amazon Redshift, Amazon S3, AWS DMS, AWS SCT, Amazon CloudWatch, AWS Secrets Manager, AWS KMS, and IAM.

  • Hands-on experience implementing AWS database migration and replication solutions, including endpoint configuration, schema conversion, full-load and change-data-capture tasks, validation, monitoring, troubleshooting, and cutover support.

  • Experience with ETL, data transformation, batch processing, data integration, and cloud-native data pipeline platforms such as Matillion ETL or similar technologies.

  • Strong understanding of relational database architecture, logical and physical data modeling, ERDs, normalization, indexing, query optimization, transaction management, and referential integrity.

  • Experience supporting enterprise database deployments, production operations, database testing, CI/CD, DevSecOps, Agile development, source control, and incident/root-cause analysis.

  • Experience using source control and application lifecycle management tools such as Git, GitHub, Bitbucket, GitLab, or Azure DevOps.

  • Experience using approved AI-assisted development tools or automation practices for code generation, optimization, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, code reviews, knowledge management, and engineering productivity.

  • Understanding of Responsible AI, AI governance, cybersecurity, data privacy, and secure AI adoption within enterprise or government environments.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills with the ability to work independently and collaboratively while managing competing priorities.

Desired:

  • Experience supporting Federal Government or large-scale enterprise applications, particularly Grants Management, Financial Management, Case Management, Regulatory, or workflow-driven systems.

  • Experience with Oracle Data Pump, Oracle GoldenGate, Informatica, Talend, ODI, Liquibase, Flyway, or similar data integration and migration technologies.

  • Experience with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL-Compatible Edition, SQL Server, MySQL, or other enterprise database platforms.

  • Experience with cloud, database, or application modernization initiatives and Federal security practices aligned with FISMA, NIST, or FedRAMP.

  • Experience with data warehousing, dimensional modeling, enterprise reporting, business intelligence, and analytics platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or Amazon QuickSight.

  • Experience supporting data platforms for analytics, AI, machine learning, or enterprise reporting workloads.

  • Familiarity with AWS cloud-native application and service deployment architectures.

  • Oracle certifications, including Oracle Certified Professional (OCP), Oracle Database Administrator Certified Professional, or Oracle SQL Certified Associate.

  • Experience with modern AI data architectures, including vector databases, RAG, AI agents, knowledge management systems, and enterprise AI platforms.

  • Experience with AI-powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Amazon Q Developer, Cursor, ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms.

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$90,300-$189,600

This position plans, directs, and coordinates the activities of assigned tree clearance crews. Vegetation Inspecting & Management

jobs.description:
Panel Manager (f/m/d)

📍 Location: Remote (No Relocation)

💼 Employment Type: Contractor / Freelance ; 3 to 6 months contract

About PlaytestCloud

PlaytestCloud’s Player Insights Platform™ helps game studios improve their games through feedback from real players. Over 60% of the top-grossing game studios have tested their games with PlaytestCloud.

🏆 Premier provider for games. We help game studios worldwide make the best games they possibly can.

🏆 Built for player insight. We build technology that enables secure, high-quality remote game testing.

🏆 Independent and established. We are bootstrapped and profitable, with more than 400 paying game studios and over one million playtesters.

Our player community

PlaytestCloud runs one of the largest proprietary player panels in games: a large, growing, global community of players who take part because they care about making the games they play better.

This isn't a role where you're building a panel from scratch. You'll be advising a mature Research Operations team that's already investing in the long-term health, quality, and strategic development of that community.

Our goal is simple: help game studios make better decisions through real player insight. You'll play a central role in keeping that community trusted, representative, engaged, and ready for what game developers need next.

About the role

We're hiring an experienced, analytical Panel Manager (f/m/d) to shape the next stage of PlaytestCloud's proprietary player panel. Your job: figure out what makes a panel strong and scalable, then turn that understanding into measurable action. You'll identify the metrics that matter most, find opportunities to improve panel quality and availability, and build a practical framework that helps us serve studios better as we grow. This is a freelance contract (3–6 months) with a clear mission: build a stronger foundation for how we measure, manage, and grow our player panel.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Panel strategy and ownership. Take ownership of the health and growth of PlaytestCloud's global player panel.

  • Metrics and insight. Define and track the metrics that connect panel performance, player experience, studio needs, and business growth.

  • Opportunity identification. Analyze panel data to find the highest-impact opportunities, constraints, and risks.

  • Actionable improvements. Turn insight into practical recommendations, and work with the right teams to implement and measure them.

  • Cross-functional collaboration. Partner closely with Research Operations, Product, and GTM to make sure the panel supports great outcomes for our studios.

  • Sustainable foundations. Set up a reporting rhythm, performance framework, and roadmap the team can keep using after the contract ends.

Requirements

Your profile

Must-have:

  • Panel experience. Recent hands-on experience managing, running, growing, or optimizing a large participant panel, research-participant community, or gaming community — including participant supply, retention, quality, segmentation, and/or incentive strategy.

  • Commercial and analytical mindset. You know how to find the few metrics that actually matter, connect them to customer and business outcomes, and use data to make good calls.

  • Tool competency. Comfortable querying databases in SQL, and familiar with agentic AI tools like Claude or Codex.

  • Ownership. You're a self-starter who likes taking on an ambiguous challenge, building structure around it, and driving it forward on your own.

  • Practical problem-solving. You turn analysis into clear priorities and action, not insight for its own sake.

  • Strong communication. You can explain complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical people alike.

  • Strong English. Comfortable communicating in written and spoken English on a remote, international team.

Great to have:

  • Qualitative research experience. Experience supporting or working closely with qualitative user research, including participant recruitment, study operations, interviews, usability testing, or research synthesis.

  • Games and player research. Interest in games, player research, or the gaming industry. Direct games-recruitment experience is not required.

Troubleshooting production problems and making recommendations based on thorough analysis.

Hubbell Incorporated

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The main purpose of the Senior Ecommerce SEO & GEO Strategist is to develop, manage, and execute strategic organic search initiatives that drive sustainable revenue growth for our ecommerce clients. This includes leading SEO strategy across a portfolio of ecommerce brands while helping shape our emerging Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) services.

You will be responsible for analyzing performance, identifying growth opportunities, solving complex technical SEO challenges, and translating data into actionable strategies that improve organic visibility, conversions, and revenue. You will work closely with Account Managers, Developers, Content Writers, Designers, and other specialists to ensure recommendations are effectively implemented and aligned with each client's commercial objectives.

Alongside client work, you will contribute strategic insights and analysis to Hustler Marketing's own SEO initiatives, supporting inbound lead generation and helping evolve our agency's SEO, GEO, and AEO methodologies.

The Senior Ecommerce SEO & GEO Strategist will report directly to the Head of SEO & GEO while working collaboratively with other departments.

About the Role

Mission Statement

The primary mission of our Senior Ecommerce SEO & GEO Strategist is to maximize sustainable organic revenue growth for our ecommerce clients through strategic SEO, technical excellence, and data-driven decision-making.

You will be responsible for building long-term SEO strategies, diagnosing performance changes, identifying new growth opportunities, and ensuring that SEO efforts contribute directly to commercial success rather than simply increasing rankings or traffic.

As search continues to evolve, you will also help establish and improve our GEO and AEO services by researching emerging AI search platforms, developing new methodologies, and ensuring our clients remain visible across traditional search engines as well as AI-powered discovery platforms.

General Responsibilities

  • Developing and owning SEO strategy across an assigned portfolio of ecommerce clients
  • Building prioritized SEO roadmaps that align technical SEO, content, authority building, UX improvements, and conversion optimization with business objectives
  • Identifying high-value opportunities across product pages, category pages, collection pages, editorial content, buying guides, and comparison content
  • Conducting in-depth SEO audits covering technical SEO, information architecture, internal linking, crawlability, indexation, structured data, Core Web Vitals, rendering, duplicate content, canonicalization, pagination, faceted navigation, redirects, and site migrations
  • Analyzing performance using Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, ecommerce platform data, crawling tools, rank tracking software, and other relevant SEO platforms
  • Investigating changes in rankings, traffic, conversions, revenue, and visibility to identify the true causes behind performance changes
  • Differentiating SEO performance from seasonal trends, promotions, merchandising changes, paid advertising activity, product availability, tracking issues, and broader market changes
  • Collaborating with Developers, Content Writers, Designers, Outreach Specialists, and Account Managers to ensure SEO recommendations are implemented effectively
  • Translating technical SEO findings into clear development tickets with priorities, requirements, and expected business impact
  • Monitoring implementation quality and validating completed SEO recommendations
  • Leading client strategy meetings, performance reviews, and quarterly business reviews while clearly communicating technical and commercial findings
  • Providing clients with strategic recommendations supported by evidence, analysis, and commercial impact rather than generic SEO best practices
  • Helping develop and continuously improve Hustler Marketing's GEO and AEO methodologies, frameworks, deliverables, reporting, and measurement systems
  • Researching emerging AI search platforms including Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Microsoft Copilot, and other AI-powered search experiences
  • Performing prompt research to better understand how consumers discover, compare, and evaluate products through AI platforms
  • Evaluating client visibility across AI search platforms and identifying opportunities to improve citations, recommendations, structured data, entity consistency, product feeds, authority signals, reviews, and content extractability
  • Staying informed about developments across SEO, GEO, AI search, ecommerce, and search engine algorithms while separating meaningful trends from industry speculation
  • Contributing strategic analysis and recommendations to Hustler Marketing's own SEO initiatives
  • Continuously researching industry best practices and sharing findings with the Head of SEO & GEO and the wider team
  • Supporting other internal departments with SEO-related expertise when required
  • Directly reporting to the Head of SEO & GEO


Position Specs

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement (nullifying the possibility to work in a position of a similar nature while working for Hustler Marketing)
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the first two months (with the first two months being the trial-and-adaptation period paid at full rate)
  • Regular performance reviews every 9-12 months, with the first one being after 3-6 months
  • Re-evaluation of the role and workload after 6-12 months

Requirements

About You

Profile

The ideal candidate is an experienced ecommerce SEO professional who combines deep technical expertise with exceptional analytical thinking and commercial awareness. You understand that rankings and traffic are only meaningful when they contribute to business growth and revenue.

You have significant experience leading SEO strategy for ecommerce brands, working across technical SEO, content strategy, information architecture, and performance analysis. You are comfortable investigating complex technical issues, interpreting conflicting datasets, identifying root causes behind performance changes, and presenting strategic recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

You are naturally curious about how search is evolving and have already begun exploring AI-powered search experiences, GEO, and AEO. While you may not have mastered every aspect of these emerging disciplines, you actively test new developments, evaluate evidence critically, and enjoy building new methodologies.

The right person is highly analytical, commercially minded, proactive, accountable, and capable of independently leading strategic SEO initiatives while collaborating effectively across multiple teams in a remote environment.

Key Requirements

  • Significant hands-on experience leading SEO strategy for ecommerce websites
  • Strong experience working with Shopify or Shopify Plus and BigCommerce (experience with Magento, Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, WooCommerce, or headless commerce platforms is an advantage)
  • Advanced knowledge of technical SEO, particularly for large ecommerce websites and product catalogs
  • Strong experience using Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Semrush, Looker Studio, and other SEO analysis tools
  • Excellent understanding of keyword research, search intent, information architecture, internal linking, on-page optimization, and ecommerce content strategy
  • Proven ability to connect SEO performance with business metrics including conversions, transactions, average order value, and revenue
  • Experience diagnosing SEO performance changes across organic search while accounting for paid campaigns, promotions, merchandising, seasonality, and tracking issues
  • Strong experience translating SEO audits into prioritized implementation roadmaps and actionable development requirements
  • Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to independently prioritize high-impact opportunities instead of producing generic SEO recommendations
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills with confidence presenting strategy and performance to clients and senior stakeholders
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, responsiveness, and ability to consistently meet deadlines
  • Experience working remotely and collaborating across cross-functional teams is a major advantage
  • Working knowledge of GEO, AEO, AI search platforms, or AI-powered discovery tools is highly desirable, although practical curiosity and willingness to learn are valued more than claiming expertise
  • Familiarity with structured data, product feeds, entity optimization, AI visibility measurement, and ecommerce SEO best practices is a strong advantage
  • Experience with SQL, Python, JavaScript, APIs, log-file analysis, or advanced data visualization tools is considered a plus
  • Must be available and responsive during office hours (Mondays to Fridays between 3-6 PM BCN time)
  • Must consistently work 30-35 hours per week (approximately 140 hours per month)
  • Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or desktop computer capable of attending virtual meetings
  • Must be open to receiving constructive feedback while also providing thoughtful feedback to colleagues to help improve team performance

jobs.title: Data Strategy & Insights Lead
jobs.excerpt: Group 1001is a consumer-centric, technology-driven family of insurance companies on a mission to deliver outstanding value and operational performance by combining financial strength and stability with deep insurance expertise and a can-do culture.
jobs.description:
Group 1001is a consumer-centric, technology-driven family of insurance companies on a mission to deliver outstanding value and operational performance by combining financial strength and stability with deep insurance expertise and a can-do culture. Group1001’s culture emphasizes the importance of collaboration, communication, core business focus, risk management, and striving for outcomes. This goal extends to how we hire and onboard our most valuable assets – our employees.

Company Overview:

Gainbridge,a part of the Group 1001 enterprise, is a self-managed, innovative, digital platform providing its clients with direct access to trusted financial products to smartly grow their savings over time. Gainbridge strives to offer products through its platform that are simple, intuitive, and backed by smart technology with no complexity or hidden fees. Gainbridge empowers clients to take control of the financial future with simple solutions that are accessible to everyone no matter their budget.

Why This Role Matters:

The hardest problem in data isn't producing insight — it's the last mile: the gap between an insight existing and the business acting on it. That gap closes only when someone inside the business owns the problem and the outcome, not just the analysis. This is that person for Gainbridge, Group 1001's direct-to-consumer financial services business.

Gainbridge runs on decisions — where to acquire customers, how to price products, when to act on risk. This role exists to make sure data moves those decisions, not just informs them. You bring the business fluency, the relationships, and the judgment to translate data and AI capability into outcomes that show up in the business — while a dedicated data and engineering team handles the build.

And the accountability comes with authority. This is not an influence-only role: you hold the demand gate for the domain (nothing enters the build queue without your qualification), acceptance authority over what counts as done, and a formal escalation path when delivered insight isn't acted on. You can stop work from starting, stop work from closing, and force a conversation when work isn't used.

How You'll Contribute:

  • The portfolio. Translate Gainbridge's strategy into a prioritized set of the problems most worth solving with data, analytics, and AI. Separate structural opportunity from quick win noise and own the call on what's worth doing.
  • The interpretation. Turn data and models into a narrative that changes a specific decision. Be the point of insight Gainbridge leadership turns to — and hold your ground when the data contradicts the strategy.
  • The last mile. Drive insight into the actual workflow and the moment of decision. You own whether it gets adopted, not just whether it gets delivered, and you build the data literacy that makes insight trusted and used.
  • The AI agenda. As the domain's outputs increasingly include AI, you shape and qualify where it's worth applying — and represent Gainbridge in how those capabilities get governed.
  • The partnership. Co-own every use case with the data and engineering team that builds it. You frame the problem and own the outcome; they own production. Both names on the work — never thrown over a wall.

How Success is Measured:

On outcomes, not output.

  • Decisions changed — outcomes moved at Gainbridge; the measure is value realized, not artifacts shipped.
  • The right problems — the domain's most important problems are the ones being worked, in priority order.
  • Adoption — insight is embedded in real workflows and trusted by the people making decisions.
  • Partnership health — use cases are co-owned and land; both sides have standing.

A wall of dashboards no one acts on is failure. One decision changed for the better is the job working.

What We're Looking For:

  • Business acumen first. Deep understanding of a direct-to-consumer financial services business — its growth model, customer funnel, and the decisions that move it. This outweighs technical depth.
  • A track record of changed outcomes. Roughly a decade leading data or insight work with measurable business impact, in analytics, consulting, or a data-heavy domain role — and the credibility to influence senior decision-makers.
  • Analytical fluency. Able to interrogate data and models critically and interpret them soundly, without needing to build them yourself.
  • Communication and influence. Turns analysis into decisions, earns the trust of senior stakeholders, and is comfortable holding a point of view — including an unpopular one.
  • Applied AI fluency. Conversant in what AI and agentic capability can and can't do, and where it's worth applying.
  • Partnership instinct. Shares accountability and frames problems well; doesn't throw requirements over a wall.
  • Judgment on what matters. Tells a structural opportunity from a quick-win distraction and prioritizes accordingly.

Compensation:

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets. The base pay for this position ranges from $140,000/year in our lowest geographic market up to $180,000/year in our highest geographic market. Pay is based on factors such as market location, job-related skills, and experience.

Benefits Highlights:

Employees who meet benefit eligibility guidelines and work 30 hours or more weekly, have the ability to enroll in Group 1001’s benefits package. Employees (and their families) are eligible to participate in the Company’s comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plan options. Employees are also eligible for Basic and Supplemental Life Insurance, Short and Long-Term Disability. All employees (regardless of hours worked) have immediate access to the Company’s Employee Assistance Program and wellness programs—no enrollment is required. Employees may also participate in the Company’s 401K plan, with matching contributions by the Company.

Group 1001, and its affiliated companies, is strongly committed to providing a supportive work environment where employee differences are valued. Diversity is an essential ingredient in making Group 1001 a welcoming place to work and is fundamental in building a high-performance team. Diversity embodies all the differences that make us unique individuals. All employees share the responsibility for maintaining a workplace culture of dignity, respect, understanding and appreciation of individual and group differences.

The Manager, Customer Success (CS Manager) is a pivotal leadership role within the Customer Success organization. Your full professional capacity is invested in one outcome: building, developing, and leading a high-performing CS team that consistently delivers exceptional retention, expansion, and customer outcomes across the portfolio.

The CS Manager is not a removed administrator. You are a hands-on people leader who is deeply connected to the day-to-day work of your team — present in account reviews, coaching conversations, renewal pipelines, and at-risk escalations. You understand the team’s accounts well enough to guide strategy, spot risk early, and develop each CSM's capabilities in the context of real work; but do so as a leader and coach, not as an account owner.

The ideal candidate brings mastery of CS execution and is now ready to direct that expertise entirely toward the growth and performance of others. You are energized by developing people, committed to building scalable team systems, and commercially literate enough to hold the team accountable to the metrics that matter.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own team-level GRR, NRR, and expansion targets — accountable for aggregate performance across all direct reports' portfolios
  • Maintain a real-time view of the team's renewal pipeline, at-risk accounts, and expansion opportunities through regular account reviews and reporting
  • Identify commercial risk early across the team's portfolio and drive proactive mitigation — not just flag issues when they surface
  • Ensure every CSM on the team has a documented account strategy, active success plans, and clear renewal and expansion plans for key accounts
  • Partner with CS Leadership to set team targets, forecast performance, and report on retention and revenue outcomes at the portfolio level
  • Serve as the executive escalation point for the most critical or complex account situations within the team's portfolio
  • Own the consistent application of CS playbooks, processes, and standards across the team — identifying where gaps exist and driving improvement
  • Partner with CS Leadership to develop, refine, and operationalize playbooks, renewal frameworks, and success plan standards
  • Manage a team of CSMs across levels with direct accountability for their performance, development, and career progression
  • Conduct regular 1:1s with each direct report — structured, purposeful, and focused on both immediate performance and longer-term development
  • Deliver honest, specific, and actionable performance feedback on a consistent cadence — not just at formal review periods
  • Develop and maintain individual development plans for each direct report, aligned to their career goals, current gaps, and the needs of the team
  • Identify high-potential team members and proactively create stretch opportunities, exposure, and development experiences that accelerate their growth
  • Address underperformance early and directly, with clear expectations, documented support plans, and consistent follow-through
  • Actively contribute to hiring decisions, onboarding design, and ramp planning for new CS team members
  • Build a team environment where feedback flows in both directions — where CSMs feel safe to raise concerns, share ideas, and push back constructively

Competencies:

  • People Leadership & Talent Development – Builds and develops a high-performing CS team through structured coaching, actionable feedback, individualized development plans, and clear accountability for performance and career growth.
  • Commercial & Retention Leadership – Owns team-level GRR, NRR, retention, and expansion outcomes, ensuring CSMs understand their commercial responsibilities and have clear strategies to achieve portfolio targets.
  • Strategic Account & Risk Oversight – Maintains visibility across renewal pipelines, account health, expansion opportunities, and at-risk customers, identifying trends and driving proactive strategies before risks impact retention.
  • Performance Management & Accountability – Sets clear expectations, evaluates performance consistently, recognizes high potential, and addresses performance gaps early through direct feedback, structured support, and follow-through.
  • CS Coaching & Execution Excellence – Coaches CSMs on account strategy, success planning, renewals, expansion, and executive engagement while ensuring consistent execution of CS playbooks and standards.
  • Operational Excellence & Scalability – Builds and improves CS processes, reporting cadences, playbooks, onboarding programs, and team systems that create consistency and enable the organization to scale effectively.
  • Executive Escalation & Customer Leadership – Provides leadership in complex or high-risk customer situations, helping shape strategy and executive communication while enabling the CSM to maintain appropriate account ownership.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence – Partners effectively with Sales, Product, Finance, Operations, and CS Leadership to align customer strategy with broader retention, expansion, and business objectives.

Required Qualifications

  • 8–12 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Customer Growth in B2B SaaS
  • Demonstrated track record of excellence as an individual contributor in CS — equivalent to CSM 3 or CSM Team Lead performance — providing the commercial credibility needed to coach and develop senior CSMs
  • Prior people management experience with direct reports in a CS, account management, or related customer-facing function
  • Proven ability to develop CS talent — identifying gaps, designing development plans, and delivering feedback that produces measurable improvement
  • Strong commercial literacy: fluency in NRR, GRR, ARR, churn, and expansion mechanics and the ability to hold a team accountable to these metrics with depth and confidence
  • Experience managing team performance — setting targets, reviewing pipelines, identifying risk, and driving accountability across a group of individual contributors
  • Demonstrated cross-functional influence: working with Sales, Finance, Product, and Operations to align around customer and revenue outcomes
  • Strong operational instincts — able to design and improve team processes, reporting cadences, and playbook execution standards
  • Experience with CS and CRM platforms at both a user and team-management level
  • Exceptional communication skills — able to give difficult feedback, navigate executive conversations, and represent the team's perspective with authority

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a CS Team Lead, pod lead, or senior advisor role before moving into direct management — demonstrating a natural progression through the player-coach model
  • Background building or redesigning CS team structures, onboarding programs, or career frameworks
  • Experience managing CSMs across multiple levels simultaneously — including both early-career and senior team members
  • Strong data fluency: designing team dashboards, renewal forecasts, and health scoring systems that inform management decisions

We create intelligent connections across healthcare through advanced analytics, technology, data, and deep domain expertise—helping customers accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments that improve patient outcomes worldwide.

We are seeking a VP & Managing Director, Mid-Sized Pharma to lead one of IQVIA’s important strategic partnerships. jobs.description:
*This role is open to remote or hybrid candidates (East Coast preference), with hybrid being central to our New York, NY or Charlotte area offices. Must be able to work Eastern Standard Time hours.

Bankrate is rebuilding itself with AI at the center. The AI Transformation Office exists to make that real, not as a slide deck but as running software. We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to embed directly with our business teams and ship the AI systems that change how Bankrate operates. Your clients are internal: Human Resources, Marketing, and Commercial. Your job is to walk into their workflows, find the highest-leverage problems, and build the agents, tools, and integrations that solve them. You report to the Head of AI Transformation. This is an individual-contributor role for a builder, not a manager.

This is not a role for people who want to build software for fun. It's for people who want to solve real business problems and fundamentally change how a company operates. Demos don't count. Prototypes that die in a sandbox don't count. What counts is the workflow running on Monday morning, the business outcome it drives, and the team that can't imagine going back.

What You’ll Do:

  • Embed and ship. Sit with a business team, learn how they actually work, and build the AI system that changes it. You own the problem end to end: architecture, code, deploy, and the relationship with the people who use what you build. Nothing gets handed off. A few problems in flight to give you a sense of the work:
    • Autonomous Customer Support Agents that resolve tier-1 issues on their own and escalate to humans only where judgment is required.
    • Automated AI Training Pathways that give every Bankrate employee a personalized route to fluency, built once and scaled across the company.
    • Paid Media Optimization Agents that watch spend, test creative, and reallocate budget faster than any human team could
  • Build net-new and integrate. Some problems need software that doesn't exist yet. Others need AI wired into the systems we already run. You'll do both, and you'll know which one the moment calls for.
  • Move fast and fail faster. You prototype in hours, put things in front of real users in days, and kill what isn't working without ego. Speed is the strategy. The landscape shifts under you and you keep up.
  • Operate with the full agentic toolkit. Agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex), AI APIs, vector databases, prototyping platforms (v0, Lovable, Replit), and automation layers (Zapier, n8n). You reach for whatever gives you leverage, including tools that shipped last week.
  • Design agents that hold up in production. Reliable, auditable, and keeping humans in the loop where they belong. The work has to run when you're not in the room.
  • Compound the wins. What you learn on one engagement becomes the pattern every other engagement inherits. You make the whole office better, not just your own project

What We’re Looking For:

  • 2 to 8 years building and shipping. You've put production software in front of real users and owned the consequences. Where you trained matters less than what you've shipped.
  • AI-native to the core. You already build with agents, AI tools, and APIs as a default, not an experiment. This is how you work, not something you're curious about.
  • Problem-solver first. You're energized by a messy business problem, not a clean spec. You want to change how a company operates, and code is your means, not the point.
  • High agency, high urgency. You don't wait for permission or perfect requirements. You find the leverage, build, ship, and iterate.
  • Comfortable in ambiguity. You get productive in unfamiliar systems and domains without much hand-holding, and you bring structure where there's none.
  • A real collaborator. You work shoulder to shoulder with non-technical business teams, translate their problems into systems, and bring them along so what you build actually gets used.

Compensation:

Total Cash Compensation Range: $100,000 – $195,000 per year

Actual compensation varies based on location, experience, and qualifications.

Additionally, the following benefits are provided by Red Ventures, subject to eligibility requirements.

  • Health Insurance Coverage (medical, dental, and vision)
  • Life Insurance
  • Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Holiday Pay
  • 401(k) with match
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Paid Parental Bonding Benefit Program
  • Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO): We believe time to rest and recharge is essential. That’s why we offer a generous and flexible PTO policy. Full-time employees accrue 20 days of PTO for a full calendar year annually, with an increase to 25 days after five years of service.

Who We Are:

Bankrate is where Americans go to get the best price on life's most important financial decisions. By combining proprietary data, advanced technology, and deep market coverage, Bankrate helps consumers compare options and make confident financial choices across mortgages, credit cards, savings, and more. As a rate provider to the Federal Reserve and the benchmark relied upon by major publishers and policymakers nationwide, Bankrate's rate data is the national standard. This commitment to precision is reflected across all its products. In mortgages, proprietary auction technology puts lenders in real-time competition on price alone, consistently delivering rates in the lowest 10% in the country. For deposits, the platform features exclusively top-tier rates in the top 10% nationally, while its credit card coverage encompasses more than 90% of the market by volume. Founded by a journalist, Bankrate remains dedicated to its founding mission of transparency, honest information, and real competition — helping to make the American dream more affordable for everyone.

A day in the life:

As a Junior Software Engineer, you'll build and maintain features across our AI-centric web applications — turning designs into working UI, wiring up API integrations, and keeping the codebase clean and well-tested.

You'll work closely with senior engineers who review your code, help unblock you when you're stuck, and push you to level up fast.   • Strong written and verbal English skills for daily use — documentation, code comments, and communication with global teams and clients
  • Comfort giving and receiving feedback in code review, and asking for help when blocked
  • Eagerness to learn, take direction, and grow technical skills quickly

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager with deep cybersecurity experience to help define how our products are positioned, communicated, and brought to market. This individual will translate complex product capabilities and cybersecurity concepts into clear, differentiated narratives that resonate with customers, prospects, partners, analysts, and sales teams.

The ideal candidate combines strong cybersecurity domain knowledge with expertise in product marketing, competitive intelligence, content development, and sales enablement. This person must be comfortable working closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and the broader Marketing organization.

Key Responsibilities

Product Positioning and Messaging

  • Develop compelling positioning, messaging, and value propositions for our cybersecurity platform and solutions.
  • Translate technical features and capabilities into clear customer benefits and business outcomes.
  • Create marketing narratives tailored to security executives, security operations teams, technical practitioners, and business leaders.
  • Maintain consistency of product messaging across campaigns, presentations, web content, videos, events, and sales materials.
  • Partner with Product Management to understand the roadmap, customer use cases, product differentiation, and market opportunities.

Competitive and Market Intelligence

  • Monitor cybersecurity market trends, customer needs, emerging technologies, and changes in the competitive landscape.
  • Conduct detailed competitive analysis covering product capabilities, positioning, pricing, strengths, weaknesses, and go-to-market strategies.
  • Develop and maintain competitive battlecards, comparison guides, objection-handling materials, and win/loss insights.
  • Equip Sales and other customer-facing teams to clearly articulate our competitive advantages.
  • Share actionable market intelligence with Product, Sales, Marketing, and executive leadership.

Sales Enablement and Training

  • Develop and deliver product and cybersecurity training for sales representatives, sales engineers, channel partners, and customer-facing teams.
  • Build sales enablement materials, including pitch decks, solution briefs, talk tracks, FAQs, playbooks, battlecards, and customer presentations.
  • Ensure that sales teams have a strong understanding of the product, cybersecurity domain, target buyers, use cases, and competitive differentiation.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to identify knowledge gaps and develop ongoing enablement programs.
  • Support strategic customer meetings, field events, webinars, and partner training when needed.

Content and Storytelling

  • Develop high-impact content such as solution briefs, white papers, presentations, blogs, web copy, thought-leadership pieces, and customer-facing materials.
  • Create scripts, storyboards, and messaging for product videos, demonstrations, webinars, and multimedia campaigns.
  • Collaborate with creative, digital, communications, and demand-generation teams to turn product narratives into engaging campaigns.

Go-to-Market Strategy

  • Lead product launches and go-to-market programs in partnership with Product, Sales, Demand Generation, Communications, and Customer Success.
  • Define target audiences, buyer personas, use cases, launch plans, messaging, content requirements, and success metrics.
  • Support industry analysts, media briefings, events, conferences, and other market-facing activities.
  • Measure the effectiveness of product marketing and sales-enablement programs and recommend improvements.

Success in This Role

Success will be measured by the candidate’s ability to:

  • Create clear and differentiated product positioning.
  • Strengthen the sales team’s product and cybersecurity knowledge.
  • Improve competitive readiness and objection handling.
  • Produce compelling content and multimedia narratives.
  • Execute effective product launches and go-to-market programs.
  • Increase market awareness, sales confidence, and customer engagement.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, cybersecurity, computer science, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of product marketing experience, including significant experience in cybersecurity or enterprise security technology.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity buyers, market dynamics, enterprise sales cycles, and security operations.
  • Knowledge of areas such as SIEM, threat detection and response, security analytics, XDR, NDR, endpoint security, cloud security, SOC operations, or related technologies.
  • Demonstrated experience developing product positioning, messaging, competitive intelligence, and go-to-market strategies.

  • Excellent presentation, storytelling, writing, and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience developing video scripts, webinars, product demonstrations, and multimedia content.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both highly technical audiences and executive business stakeholders.
  • Strong project-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience working collaboratively with globally distributed Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience marketing a cybersecurity platform rather than a single-point solution.

jobs.title: Treasury Manager
jobs.excerpt: Skylight is a technology startup building the OS of the family.
jobs.description:
Skylight is a technology startup building the OS of the family. We make Skylight Calendar, the smart calendar loved by millions of families (plus Wired and the Wirecutter). Our latest product is Calendar 2, which just launched to rave reviews.

Our mission is to connect loved ones by creating the world’s simplest products and services that improve family life. Our founders are former venture capitalists and serial entrepreneurs who have scaled this business to $300M+ in annual revenue while being completely bootstrapped and profitable. We get to grow a happy, healthy company focused on making products our customers love without investors breathing down our necks.

Smart, hardworking people who care about making actually meaningful products love working here. People like you. We’re busy inventing new ways to simplify family life and help parents raise great kids – and we need your help! Come invent something new with us.

About the Job:

We are a physical goods business, which means cash management is the operational heartbeat of the company. On top of that, being bootstrapped means cash plays an even bigger role in our strategy. Our Treasury Manager will own the full cash picture: understanding when sales turn into cash, how inventory buys affect our liquidity and translating all of it into a forward-looking view that gives leadership real decision-making confidence.

This is a build role. We have almost no treasury infrastructure today, so your first 90 days will be spent creating the systems, processes, and models from scratch. If that energizes you, read on.

Responsibilities:

Cash Flow Forecasting & Modeling

  • Own and continuously refine the company's 13 week cash flow model to within 95% accuracy–this is your primary deliverable
  • Synthesize the inventory purchase calendar, PO commitment schedule, payroll cadence, tax schedule and all other inflows and outflows into a forward-looking cash needs picture
  • Translate model outputs into clear, actionable recommendations for leadership–you're not just a modeler, you're the person who explains what the numbers mean and what we should do about them
  • Maintain daily cash positioning and monitor actual vs. forecast, tightening the model over time based on variances

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Work closely with our finance and operations teams to ensure cash flow inputs are accurate and timely
  • Partner with the procurement and ops teams to stay ahead of inventory purchase cycles and PO commitments
  • Collaborate with accounting to align on tax payment timing, accruals, and reconciliations
  • Be the connective tissue between functions

Banking & Liquidity Management

  • Manage day-to-day banking relationships and ensure adequate liquidity across accounts
  • Execute and authorize wires, ACH payments, and other treasury transactions with precision and appropriate controls
  • Monitor credit facilities and report on covenant compliance
  • Optimize idle cash–know when to sweep, when to hold, and when to draw

Controls, Process & Documentation

  • Design and implement treasury policies, procedures, and internal controls from the ground up
  • Maintain meticulous documentation for all treasury transactions, approvals, and decisions
  • Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, tax payment requirements, and audit standards
  • Proactively Identify process gaps and close them

Risk Management

  • Identify and flag cash flow risks proactively
  • Manage basic FX exposure relevant to our business through a practical hedging strategy
  • Support insurance and counterparty risk monitoring

Requirements

You Have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field
  • 5-8 years of treasury or finance experience, with meaningful time inside a physical-goods or inventory-driven business (retail, CPG, manufacturing, distribution, or similar)
  • Advanced Excel / Google Sheets modeling skills; experience with NetSuite a plus
  • Hands-on experience owning or co-owning a cash flow model. You've run it under pressure, explained it to a CFO, and improved it based on real outcomes
  • Demonstrated ability to work across functions (ops, procurement, accounting) to pull the inputs you need
  • Deep comfort with banking operations: wires, ACH, account management, online banking platforms
  • Experience building or significantly improving financial processes, not just operating inside established ones

You Are:

  • A strong communicator: able to translate a complex cash model into a clear two-minute update for a busy executive
  • Trustworthy and discreet: you will have access to sensitive financial information and you understand what that means
  • Process-oriented and detail-obsessed: reconciliation and documentation are not overhead for you, they are how you operate
  • Comfortable owning a decision and defending your analysis: you don't hedge everything
  • Energized by ambiguity and blank-sheet-of-paper problems: you see building as an opportunity, not a burden

Benefits

Our competitive compensation package includes:

  • Competitive Salary + Equity Package
  • 401K matching
  • Wellness, learning, and home-office budgets
  • Health, Dental & Vision Medical Plans
  • Tremendous autonomy to set the direction of your work
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Company holidays on the first Friday of every month (Except November & December)

Equal opportunity employer

Skylight is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. If you’re the best person for the job, we want you on board!

We hire across the U.S., but for legal reasons, we have to list NY and CO separately.

For Colorado-based candidates, the range being offered for this role is $150-$175K based on experience and for California-based candidates, the range being offered for this role is $150-$175K based on experience. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of this law.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Who we are

At OpenUp, our mission is to make mental well-being accessible to everyone. We support companies, their employees, and their families with proactive and practical mental health services. Through our platform, clients can access 1:1 check-ins, online courses, articles, videos, group sessions, mindfulness practices, and a team of committed experts. We believe that mental and physical well-being are deeply connected. With Lifestyle Experts focusing on nutrition, exercise, and sleep, we offer a truly holistic approach that helps people take ownership of their health. We’re proud to work with forward-thinking organizations and are committed to raising the bar on accessible care.

OpenUp is ranked in the Top 3 on LinkedIn’s Top Startups list for 2023, 2024 & 2025. We are expanding our international teams and we are searching for like-minded talent. We are already helping over 2000+ (international) companies and 550K+ employees, e.g. Rituals, Deloitte, Decathlon, KPMG, and McDonalds.

About the assignment

To fuel our growth, we are looking for entrepreneurial, purpose-driven experts who share our vision of making mental well-being direct, approachable, and impactful.

At OpenUp, we focus on prevention. We don’t diagnose; we provide guidance for life’s everyday challenges - whether it’s work-related stress, self-confidence, relationship dynamics, or finding direction in uncertain times.

We offer planned and on-demand video consults seven days a week, ensuring people can access support when they need it most - no long waits, no barriers. In each session (usually 25 minutes), you’ll help clients set clear, actionable goals and guide them toward meaningful first steps.

Our mission is to help people build skills and autonomy, so they feel confident to continue their journey independently. Many clients find they gain what they need in just a few focused conversations - thanks to your structured, goal-oriented support.

You’ll engage with a wide variety of people, from diverse cultural backgrounds and industries, and you’ll have opportunities to grow through weekly intervision sessions and ongoing development. We work together to make mental well-being accessible, practical, and empowering for everyone.

About you

You’re a psychologist (MSc) who’s passionate about making a difference- both locally and internationally. You enjoy working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment and are eager to contribute to a meaningful mission.

We welcome experts who meet the following criteria:

  • You have native-level fluency in Dutch.
  • Strong English communication skills (written and spoken) and confident in delivering consultations in English.
  • Master's degree in Psychology.
  • Minimum of 4 years’ experience providing 1:1 consultations after obtaining a Master’s degree in Psychology.
  • Solid knowledge of solution-focused therapy, ACT, and/or CBT.
  • Tech-savvy, with a self-reliant approach to digital platforms and systems.
  • You have a laptop/computer with Windows 11, OR MacOS Sonoma 14, AND an antivirus turned on in your device.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and open to continuous learning.
  • A team player who thrives independently and takes ownership of personal and professional growth.
  • A natural connector: you create a safe, supportive space for clients and act decisively to help them move forward.
  • You live the "practice what you preach" mindset, showing integrity and reflection in how you approach both clients and colleagues.

Freelance experience is a plus, as we value self-starters who are confident in managing their own practice.

What you can expect

Join us at a time of exciting growth, where your expertise and ideas are valued. Here’s what you can expect:

  • A freelance contract for 10-15 hours per week.
  • A diverse and international team with expertise in work and organizational psychology, health psychology, lifestyle medicine, and more.
  • A culture of reflection, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Weekly check-ins, intervision sessions, and skill-building opportunities.
  • Two dedicated training half-days each year to reflect on your practice and develop your skills further.

Next steps

Inspired to be part of OpenUp? We’d love to hear your story. Apply via our website and we’ll get in touch soon.

If you have questions, please visit our FAQ page or reach out directly.

At OpenUp, everyone is welcome to apply regardless of age, gender, background, nationality, or any other characteristic. What matters to us is high performance, a real drive to make an impact and the ambition to become the European market leader. If you're ready to OpenUp, join us!

jobs.description:
Analytics Manager, Commercialization

Atari, Inc.

Remote

About Us

Atari has been a bright spot in the struggling games industry: quietly but quickly growing year-over-year. The Commercial team has played a critical part in making that possible. We are looking for someone to lead analysis on a large, complex, quickly growing dataset and help us make better commercial decisions every day.

  • This is a deliberately unusual analytics job. Over the past year we’ve built an internal AI system called the “Commercial Brain” that scopes, runs, and self-checks commercial analyses. It is very powerful but also often makes mistakes in ways that are easy to miss and expensive to ship. Operating the Commercial Brain, catching its mistakes, and improving it is the central function of this role.
  • This is a high-autonomy role for someone who is energized by ambiguous problems, rigorous by instinct, and excited about using AI to do more with less. Atari, and especially the Commercial team, runs much closer to a startup than to a big company. You’ll get real ownership, fast decisions, and thin process; if you need mature structure around you to do your best work, this role will frustrate you. In this role, you’ll spend most of your time deep in analysis; not building data pipelines, dashboards, or production systems. Your output is judgment, insight, and commercial recommendations that directly shape revenue.
  • You’ll sit at the intersection of AI, data analysis, commercial strategy, and financial modeling. You’ll work closely with our Business Operations Manager and report directly to our Director of Commercial.

What you’ll do

Operate the Commercial Brain

  • Scope analyses with the Commercial Brain, interrogate its reasoning, and find its errors and unstated assumptions before they reach a decision.
  • Act as the second reviewer of record on analyses that today have only one. Verification is a primary deliverable of this role.
  • Own the empirical loop: every significant decision records an expected outcome, and you measure actuals against it. For example, outcome backfills, hypothesis tests, and calling out falsifications as wins.
  • Own data trust: reconcile our sales data against platform ground truth, adjudicate defects with our data providers, and refuse to let analyses run on numbers that haven’t cleared.
  • Build automations that remove manual analytical work and free capacity for higher-order problems.

Commercial analysis & decision support

  • Own recurring per-game analysis like pricing, discounting, regional performance, and lifecycle dynamics across hundreds of games. For some types of analysis, you’ll inherit a documented method that you will challenge and extend. For other types, you’ll create the methods then turn them into repeatable AI skills.
  • Take ambiguous commercial questions and independently define the approach, structure, and output. Then turn your approach into AI context and repeatable AI skills and scripts.

Financial modelling and business cases

  • Build business cases for commercial decisions including game forecasting, platform deals, bundle strategies, and portfolio opportunities (ports, streaming, cloud gaming, physical partnerships, etc.)
  • Develop metrics to measure the holistic performance of our commercialization system at every level.

Collaboration

  • Partner closely with our Business Operations Manager. The line between you will not be tidy: there is more process to define than one person can carry, so both of you will need to be comfortable stepping across it.
  • Keep a written record of the judgment calls behind your work, reviewed weekly, so the reasoning is inspectable rather than in someone’s head.
  • Present findings and recommendations to the Director of Commercial and, where relevant, to executive leadership.

What We're Looking For

  • 3–5 years in analytics, commercial strategy, or a related field.
  • A genuine passion for games
  • High autonomy. You receive a problem, you figure out the approach, and you come back with a proposal. This role is remote and your manager will give you direction and context, not in-the-weeds supervision.
  • Startup pace and ownership. You’ve worked where priorities move weekly, process is thin, and you own outcomes end to end.
  • Intellectual honesty. You would rather tell someone their hypothesis is wrong than confirm it with a flawed analysis. The most valuable thing you can do here is to notice that a confident, well-formatted answer is wrong, including one you produced, and address it before anyone else does.
  • You verify before you ship. You treat “confident and well-formatted” as a reason for more scrutiny, not less, and you keep the reasoning written down.
  • Familiarity with AI tools and real opinions about where they fail. You do not need to be an engineer, but you should be able to build and iterate upon AI-assisted workflows.
  • Strong statistical foundations. You know where analyses break down, you hunt for confounded variables and aggregation errors before anyone asks, and you can explain your methodology under scrutiny.
  • Basic financial modeling, including building a business case from first principles without guidance.
  • Advanced Excel, and demonstrated ability to turn large, messy datasets into clean, credible output.
  • Ability to read and catch errors in Python and SQL.
  • Clear writing. You write clearly enough that we, or an AI agent, can tell exactly what you meant.

Bonus points

  • Games industry experience

Our values

We use these to hire, evaluate performance, and make decisions.

  • Long-term thinking — Grounded in an iconic history spanning over 50 years, we prioritize long-term value creation over short-term gains. We’re building something that lasts.
  • Convergence of passion and excellence — Extraordinary outcomes emerge when passion meets disciplined execution. Operating at that intersection is what sets us apart.
  • Growth mindset — We’re inherently teachable, relentlessly curious, and we thrive on challenges. Successes and failures are both opportunities to learn.
  • Drive — We’re self-starters who finish what we start. We find satisfaction in the hard work required to achieve extraordinary results.

Target Salary: $85,000 – $110,000
