  • Identify deliverability problems before they significantly impact campaign performance
  • Troubleshoot common sending and inbox-placement issues
  • Understand the fundamentals of SPF, DKIM, and DMARC

Campaign Optimization & A/B Testing

  • A/B test:
    • Subject lines
    • Email copy
    • CTAs
    • Personalization
    • Send times
  • Track campaign performance including:
    • Open rates
    • Reply rates
    • Positive reply rates
    • Bounce rates
    • Qualified conversations
  • Identify underperforming campaigns and diagnose potential causes
  • Continuously improve targeting, messaging, and campaign structure based on data
  • Maintain organized reporting dashboards and campaign documentation

Lead Qualification & CRM Management

  • Monitor campaign replies and categorize responses accurately
  • Identify interested and qualified prospects
  • Route qualified opportunities to SDRs, Account Executives, or sales leadership
  • Provide clear notes and context during lead handoffs
  • Maintain accurate CRM records using:
    • HubSpot
    • Salesforce
    • Zoho
    • Similar CRM platforms
  • Ensure outreach and engagement data remains clean and up to date

Compliance & Outreach Best Practices

  • Follow applicable outbound email requirements, including CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and CCPA
  • Maintain suppression and opt-out lists
  • Ensure unsubscribe requests are handled correctly
  • Follow responsible sending practices designed to protect domain and sender reputation

Must-Have Experience & Skills

  • 1–2+ years of experience in cold email outreach, outbound lead generation, SDR, or outbound marketing
  • Hands-on experience managing cold email campaigns
  • Experience with platforms such as:
    • Apollo
    • Instantly
    • Smartlead
    • Lemlist
    • Woodpecker
  • Strong cold email copywriting skills
  • Experience building prospect lists and segmenting audiences
  • Understanding of cold email deliverability fundamentals
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills
  • Excellent written English communication
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Comfortable working independently during U.S. client business hours

Preferred Experience

  • Experience managing inbox health and deliverability at scale
  • Familiarity with DNS, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC
  • Experience generating outbound pipeline for:
    • B2B SaaS
    • Agencies
    • Professional services
    • High-ticket service businesses
  • Experience working alongside SDRs and Account Executives
  • Familiarity with CRM and outbound automation workflows
  • Experience troubleshooting low reply rates, high bounce rates, or deliverability issues

Tools & Tech

Apollo | Instantly | Smartlead | Lemlist | Woodpecker | LinkedIn Sales Navigator | ZoomInfo | Crunchbase | NeverBounce | ZeroBounce | HubSpot | Salesforce | Zoho | Google Sheets

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You understand that successful cold email is about more than sending volume
  • You can balance deliverability, targeting, copy, and personalization
  • You write concise and persuasive outbound messaging

You may start your day reviewing campaign performance, bounce rates, reply rates, and inbox health before checking replies and routing qualified prospects to sales.

Throughout the day, you’ll monitor deliverability, optimize underperforming campaigns, update CRM records, and ensure outbound systems remain organized and healthy.

If you understand cold email outreach, B2B lead generation, deliverability, prospecting, and campaign optimization and enjoy turning targeted outreach into qualified sales opportunities, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and help build a consistent, scalable outbound pipeline.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.

The Role

We are seeking a Product Marketing Manager to join our growing Product Marketing team. In this role, you will own product marketing for the single-family office (SFO) segment and help shape how Addepar goes to market with clients and prospects across EMEA, LATAM and APAC. You will develop a deep understanding of the needs, market dynamics and buying journeys of SFOs, while also becoming a trusted expert on the regional nuances, product availability and audience needs that influence our go-to-market approach in each geography.

You’ll work closely with regional Sales, Relationship Management, Demand Generation, Product and other go-to-market partners to translate insight about target buyers, prospects and existing clients into differentiated positioning, acquisition campaigns, sales enablement, client engagement programs and launch strategies. We are looking for a curious, collaborative and hands-on product marketer who can connect a consistent global platform narrative to the distinct needs of each client audience and market. You are resourceful, adaptable and motivated by the opportunity to help grow Addepar’s presence with sophisticated investment firms around the world.

Addepar takes a market-based approach to pay. A successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on the role, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target base salary for roles in Colorado, California, and New York.

The current range for this role is $106,000 - $166,000 (base salary) + bonus + equity + benefits.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Additionally, these ranges reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and execute a product marketing strategy for the single-family office segment and for clients and prospects across EMEA, LATAM and APAC, aligned with company and platform goals.
  • Become the expert on the SFO market by continuously deepening your understanding of target buyers, prospects and clients; their operating models; buyer personas and committees; and the full journey from awareness and evaluation through adoption and expansion.
  • Develop market expertise across EMEA, LATAM and APAC, identifying the regional trends, client and prospect needs, competitive dynamics and cultural nuances that should inform our go-to-market approach.
  • Build strong working relationships with regional Sales, Relationship Management and Demand Generation teams to identify priorities and turn local market insight into coordinated go-to-market programs.
  • Define segment and regional positioning and craft compelling messaging that connects Addepar’s global value proposition to the distinct needs of prospective buyers and existing clients.
  • Partner on broader product launches to tailor positioning and activation plans to regional audiences and product availability across EMEA, LATAM and APAC, supporting both prospect education and client adoption.
  • Develop and execute SFO and region-specific campaigns in partnership with Demand Generation and regional GTM teams, building programs that generate awareness and demand among prospects while supporting engagement, adoption and expansion among clients.
  • Create scalable core materials and thoughtfully adapt them for regional use, including prospect-facing campaign content, sales enablement, client education, thought leadership and co-branded resources.
  • Research and monitor SFO and regional markets, industry developments and the competitive landscape; measure program effectiveness and use feedback from GTM teams and clients to continually strengthen our approach.

Who You Are

  • 3–6 years of product marketing or related go-to-market experience. Experience with B2B SaaS, financial services, fintech, wealth management or investment management preferred.
  • Full-stack product marketer with experience developing market and audience insights, value propositions, messaging, go-to-market strategies, enablement and content.
  • Excellent storyteller, writer and communicator who can translate sophisticated and technical capabilities into clear customer value for different audiences.
  • A globally minded and curious marketer who is eager to build expertise across markets and can recognize when a global narrative should be adapted to reflect meaningful regional differences.
  • Experience partnering with Sales, Demand Generation, Relationship Management, Product or other GTM teams to develop and execute coordinated programs.
  • Demonstrated ability to move thoughtfully between strategy and hands-on execution across multiple projects in a fast-paced, continuously evolving and collaborative environment.
  • Strong relationship-building and influencing skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across regions, functions and time zones.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize efficiently, navigate ambiguity, anticipate roadblocks and escalate when needed.

Our Values

  • Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
  • Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
  • Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
  • Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
  • Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

jobs.description:
The Enterprise Wellbeing Strategist is a cross-functional commercial role sitting at the intersection of GTM strategy, enterprise solutioning, strategic deal enablement, and project management.

The role will support strategic enterprise opportunities globally, with a major focus on APAC and ANZ, working closely with the respective Revenue Leaders in each region to strengthen deal strategy, develop differentiated client solutions, and drive complex opportunities forward.

This person will work across Revenue, Product, Operations, Clinical, Marketing and Leadership to turn complex client needs into compelling solutions, build scalable commercial frameworks, and drive high-priority initiatives from strategy through execution.

Key Responsibilities

1. GTM Strategy

  • Co-develop go-to-market strategies with regional Revenue Leaders, translating strategy into clear rollout plans, playbooks, tools and training.
  • Develop scalable pricing frameworks, market-specific messaging, commercial propositions and competitor positioning across priority markets.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen Intellect’s enterprise proposition based on market dynamics, client needs and competitive insights.
  • Support the development and execution of consultative sales strategies to drive enterprise client acquisition and revenue growth.
  • Build repeatable GTM frameworks that can be adapted across markets while accounting for regional differences.

2. Enterprise Solutioning & Strategic Deals

  • Partner closely with Revenue Leaders and Sales teams globally, with particular focus on APAC and ANZ, on Intellect’s most strategic and complex enterprise opportunities.
  • Engage directly with enterprise clients to understand their organisational challenges, objectives, workforce needs and wellbeing priorities.
  • Translate client requirements into differentiated solutions by bringing together Intellect’s suite of wellbeing services, technology and clinical capabilities.
  • Lead or support deal strategy across discovery, solution design, commercial structuring, proposals and presentations.
  • Strengthen the overall deal narrative by clearly articulating the client problem, proposed solution, differentiation and measurable value.
  • Lead selected strategic deal pursuits end-to-end and support high-priority enterprise implementations where strong cross-functional orchestration is required.

3. Deal Enablement & Commercial Infrastructure

  • Build and continuously improve sales enablement assets including solution frameworks, pitch materials, talk tracks, ROI calculators, pricing tools and proposal templates.
  • Lead strategic deal reviews with Revenue and Leadership to improve proposal quality, competitive positioning and win themes.
  • Develop and maintain competitor and market intelligence that can be practically applied to active opportunities.
  • Support complex RFPs, bids and commercial proposals, particularly where significant customisation or cross-functional coordination is required.
  • Identify recurring themes across enterprise opportunities and convert them into scalable commercial propositions and playbooks.
  • Improve the quality, consistency and efficiency of enterprise solutioning and deal execution across regions.

4. Strategic Project Management

  • Lead selected cross-functional commercial and GTM initiatives from problem definition through execution and measurable outcome.
  • Coordinate stakeholders across Revenue, Product, Operations, Clinical, Marketing and other teams to drive high-priority initiatives forward.
  • Establish clear workplans, owners, milestones and decision points for complex projects.
  • Proactively identify blockers, resolve dependencies and ensure initiatives maintain pace through execution.
  • Support selected strategic enterprise implementations where complexity, commercial importance or cross-functional coordination requires additional ownership.

5. Continuous Improvement & Market Intelligence

  • Stay informed on enterprise wellbeing, mental health, employee benefits, technology and broader industry trends to strengthen Intellect’s value proposition.
  • Bring client and market insights back into Product, Operations and Clinical teams to help inform future propositions and capabilities.
  • Identify and drive improvements across sales, solution development, pricing, client handovers and other commercial processes.
  • Develop feedback loops between Revenue teams and the wider organisation so that learnings from enterprise deals translate into stronger products, processes and GTM approaches.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will mean:

  • Intellect’s largest and most complex opportunities have stronger deal strategies, solution design and commercial narratives.
  • Regional Revenue Leaders have a strong strategic partner who can help move complicated opportunities from ambiguity to action.
  • Enterprise proposals increasingly demonstrate clear differentiation, measurable value and strong commercial thinking.
  • Pricing, ROI, solutioning and proposal frameworks become increasingly repeatable rather than being built from scratch for every opportunity.
  • Strategic cross-functional initiatives have clear ownership and move from discussion to execution.
  • Learnings from client conversations and strategic deals consistently improve Intellect’s broader enterprise GTM approach.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Psychology, HR or a related field; MBA or equivalent experience is a plus.
  • 5+ years of experience across enterprise sales strategy, consulting, bid management, commercial strategy, solutions consulting or project management.
  • Proven track record supporting or winning complex enterprise deals, ideally >$100K in value.
  • Strong consultative and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose client needs and translate them into compelling solutions.
  • Strong commercial judgement and comfort working across pricing, ROI modelling, proposals and deal strategy.
  • Exceptional project management and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive work across multiple functions without direct authority.
  • Highly structured, analytical and execution-oriented, with the ability to move comfortably between strategic thinking and getting into the details.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas and influence senior internal and external stakeholders.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, evolving environment with ambiguity and competing priorities.
  • Familiarity with mental health, employee benefits, HR technology or wellbeing consulting is preferred but not required.
  • Open to candidates in Malaysia (hyrbid) and the Philippines (remote).

Benefits

  • Global company – work in a diverse environment with people from nearly 20 countries
  • Generous leave policy – time off to rest and recharge
  • Christmas week off – company-wide break during Christmas, separate from annual leave
  • Birthday leave – enjoy a day off on your birthday

★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★
Financial Controller (Contract)
Location: Remote

About the Role
We're looking for an experienced, hands-on Financial Controller to take ownership of accounting operations and financial reporting while helping transition the company's finance function from outsourced accounting to a fully in-house operation.
Reporting directly to the CFO, you'll own the General Ledger, month-end close, reconciliations, financial reporting, and accounting controls, while supervising bookkeeping, Accounts Payable, and Accounts Receivable activities.
Deep, hands-on QuickBooks experience is essential for this position. We're specifically looking for someone who has used QuickBooks Online and/or Desktop as their primary day-to-day accounting system for at least 2–3 years, including maintaining the General Ledger, performing reconciliations, running monthly close, and generating financial reports directly from the system.
This is a high-ownership role within a small, collaborative team. In addition to accounting responsibilities, you'll interact directly with clients on accounting-related requests, oversee team standards, and be comfortable supporting operational needs when necessary.


Why This Opportunity?

  • Take ownership of the company's core accounting operations.
  • Work directly with the CFO and executive leadership.
  • Lead the transition from outsourced accounting to an internal finance function.
  • Build and improve accounting processes, controls, and reporting.
  • Have meaningful client-facing and team leadership responsibilities.
  • Work fully remotely from Colombia.
  • Potential for a long-term engagement following the initial contractor period.
What You'll Do
Accounting Operations & QuickBooks
  • Own and maintain the General Ledger (GL), ensuring accuracy and integrity.
  • Use QuickBooks Online and/or Desktop as a primary accounting system for day-to-day financial operations.
  • Maintain the Chart of Accounts and accounting structure.
  • Lead the monthly close directly within QuickBooks.
  • Perform bank and account reconciliations and resolve discrepancies.
  • Generate financial statements and management reports from QuickBooks.
  • Support the transition from outsourced accounting to an internal accounting function.
  • Establish scalable accounting processes and financial controls.
Financial Reporting & Cash Management
  • Prepare accurate monthly financial statements and management reports.
  • Review Profit & Loss statements and performance across business units.
  • Monitor cash flow and financial activity.
  • Provide timely financial information to the CFO and executive leadership.
  • Identify discrepancies and resolve accounting issues proactively.
Client, Team & Operational Support
  • Interface directly with clients regarding accounting-related questions, requests, and financial information.
  • Communicate financial matters clearly and professionally to both accounting and non-accounting stakeholders.
  • Supervise Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and bookkeeping activities.
  • Ensure the accounting team consistently follows established standards and procedures.
  • Review invoices, payroll, expense reports, and vendor payments.
  • Support operational and administrative responsibilities outside traditional accounting functions when business needs require it.
  • Work collaboratively across functions rather than operating exclusively within the accounting department.
Compliance & Controls
  • Coordinate payroll tax, sales tax, and year-end tax reporting activities.
  • Ensure accounting practices follow company policies and financial controls.
  • Handle sensitive financial and client information with the highest level of confidentiality and discretion.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
  • 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, including experience as a Financial Controller, Senior Accountant, Accounting Manager, or similar role.
  • At least 2–3 years of professional, day-to-day QuickBooks experience.
  • Experience using QuickBooks Online and/or QuickBooks Desktop as a primary accounting system, not simply basic familiarity or occasional exposure.
  • Proven ability to maintain the General Ledger directly in QuickBooks.
  • Hands-on experience performing reconciliations and month-end close in QuickBooks.
  • Experience generating financial statements and reports directly from QuickBooks.
  • Proven experience with full ownership of the General Ledger.
  • Strong experience managing month-end close, reconciliations, and financial reporting.
  • Experience supervising accounting, AP/AR, or bookkeeping functions.
  • Ability to communicate directly and professionally with clients regarding accounting-related matters.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial controls.
  • Willingness to support operational responsibilities outside the traditional accounting function when needed.
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • High level of integrity and discretion when handling confidential financial information.
  • Advanced English proficiency (C1/C2) with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently during U.S. business hours.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience transitioning an accounting function in-house or improving accounting processes.
  • Experience with project accounting software such as BigTime or similar platforms.
  • Experience within professional services, construction, architecture, engineering, or design firms.
  • Experience in Luxury Architecture, Interior Design, or High-End Residential Design firms is highly desirable.
  • CPA or equivalent accounting certification is a plus.
How Success Is Measured
Success in this role will be measured by your ability to:
  • Independently manage accounting operations using QuickBooks.
  • Maintain an accurate, reliable, and well-controlled General Ledger.
  • Complete reconciliations and month-end close accurately and on schedule.
  • Deliver reliable financial statements and management reporting.
  • Successfully support the transition to an internal accounting function.
  • Maintain high accounting standards across the team.
  • Communicate confidently and professionally with clients.
  • Contribute proactively to operational needs beyond accounting when required.
  • Provide leadership with timely and reliable financial information for decision-making.
Why Join Us?
  • Fully remote opportunity.
  • Competitive compensation of $2,000 – $4,000 USD/month.
  • High-impact role reporting directly to the CFO.
  • Significant ownership over accounting operations and process improvement.
  • Direct exposure to clients and executive leadership.
  • Opportunity to help build an internal finance function.
  • Three-month contractor trial period with potential for a long-term engagement.
Important Notes
Please apply only if you meet the core QuickBooks requirements of this position.
Candidates must have at least 2–3 years of professional experience using QuickBooks Online and/or Desktop as a primary day-to-day accounting system.
Candidates should be prepared to explain during the selection process:
  • How many years they have professionally used QuickBooks.
  • Whether they have used QuickBooks Online, Desktop, or both.
  • How they used QuickBooks in their day-to-day accounting responsibilities.
  • Whether they maintained the General Ledger directly in QuickBooks.
  • Whether they performed bank/account reconciliations in QuickBooks.
  • Whether they independently managed the monthly close in QuickBooks.
  • What financial reports they generated directly from the system.

Basic exposure, self-learning, or listing QuickBooks as a skill without substantial professional hands-on experience will not meet the requirement for this position.
Candidates must also be comfortable interacting directly with clients, overseeing accounting team standards, and supporting operational responsibilities outside their core accounting duties when needed.
The engagement begins with a three-month contractor trial period, with the opportunity to transition into a longer-term role based on performance and business needs.
This is a remote/telecommute position

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Rust Developer to design, build, and optimize high-performance distributed systems, low-latency backend services, and cloud-native infrastructure components powering mission-critical enterprise platforms. This role focuses on developing highly concurrent, memory-safe applications using Rust while integrating with modern cloud environments, container orchestration platforms, and event-driven architectures.
You will work closely with platform engineers, distributed systems architects, DevOps teams, and product engineering groups to build scalable APIs, asynchronous processing pipelines, networking services, and infrastructure automation tools. The ideal candidate has strong systems programming expertise, deep knowledge of concurrent application development, and experience building production software where performance, reliability, and security are critical.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop high-performance backend services using Rust for large-scale distributed systems.
  • Build low-latency APIs, asynchronous processing services, and event-driven microservices.
  • Develop networking applications utilizing TCP, UDP, HTTP/2, gRPC, WebSockets, and QUIC protocols.
  • Build highly concurrent applications using Rust's async ecosystem including Tokio and async/await.
  • Design resilient services capable of processing millions of transactions with high availability and fault tolerance.
  • Optimize CPU utilization, memory management, thread scheduling, and application performance.
  • Integrate services with Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis Streams, or other enterprise messaging platforms.
  • Develop secure APIs and authentication services supporting OAuth2, JWT, OpenID Connect, and mTLS.
  • Build observability capabilities including structured logging, distributed tracing, and performance monitoring.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, system design discussions, and production support.
  • Collaborate with DevOps engineers to automate deployments using CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Investigate complex production issues involving networking, concurrency, memory utilization, and distributed systems.

Required Skills
  • Six or more years of professional software engineering experience building enterprise applications.
  • Three or more years of hands-on Rust development experience in production environments.
  • Strong proficiency in Rust programming language, ownership model, borrowing, lifetimes, traits, generics, and macros.
  • Extensive experience with asynchronous Rust development using Tokio, async/await, Futures, and Actix or Axum.
  • Strong understanding of concurrent programming, multithreading, synchronization primitives, and lock-free programming concepts.
  • Experience building RESTful APIs, gRPC services, and high-performance backend applications.
  • Strong understanding of operating system fundamentals including memory management, process scheduling, file systems, and networking.
  • Experience working with Linux production environments and command-line tooling.
  • Experience developing cloud-native applications on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Strong SQL skills with PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server.
  • Experience working with NoSQL databases such as Redis, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or MongoDB.
  • Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Experience integrating distributed messaging systems including Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS, or Pulsar.
  • Strong debugging, profiling, benchmarking, and performance optimization skills.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience building distributed systems supporting high-throughput financial, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, or telecommunications platforms.
  • Familiarity with Rust web frameworks including Axum, Warp, Rocket, or Actix Web.
  • Experience developing Kubernetes Operators or cloud-native infrastructure tooling.
  • Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or Pulumi.
  • Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and distributed tracing platforms.
  • Knowledge of cryptographic libraries, TLS, secure communications, and certificate management.
  • Experience building command-line tools and systems utilities using Rust.
  • Familiarity with C/C++ interoperability through Foreign Function Interface (FFI).
  • Contributions to open-source Rust projects or participation in the Rust community are highly desirable.

Project Environment
You will be joining a platform engineering team responsible for building next-generation distributed infrastructure supporting enterprise-scale applications across cloud environments. Current initiatives include:

  • Real-time event streaming and data processing pipelines
  • Distributed job scheduling and workflow orchestration services

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Hiring Globally)
jobs.excerpt: About the role: We run a distributed, camera-based video monitoring and AI alerting platform.
jobs.description:
About the role:

We run a distributed, camera-based video monitoring and AI alerting platform. The system spans the full spectrum of modern and legacy infrastructure: an AWS-hosted fleet of Java microservices and workers, a GPU-backed computer-vision inference pipeline, a real-time streaming and presence layer, and thousands of on-premise edge "media boxes" deployed in the field that ingest camera feeds, serve HLS video, and stream events back to the cloud.

This is a reliability-first role. Your primary job is to keep a large, mixed operational estate healthy at scale: meaningful service objectives, trustworthy alerting, sound capacity, tested disaster recovery, and fast, calm incident response. Delivery pipelines matter, but here they exist in service of reliability, not the other way around. We are not hiring a pipeline-and-self-service DevOps engineer who treats operations as a side concern. We are hiring an SRE who owns uptime and operational quality, and who can write the software to make that uptime measurable and automatic.

If you think in SLOs, error budgets, and blameless postmortems, and you are happiest when a noisy, fragile system becomes quiet and predictable on your watch, this is your role.

What you'll keep reliableYou will own the operational health of all of the following:
  • Computer-vision / AI models: frame-based inference services running on GPU EC2 (g4dn-class, AWS Deep Learning AMIs), fed by camera frames from S3 and a Kafka (Amazon MSK) event bus, with Redis (ElastiCache) for state. Outputs flow through an alerts pipeline (OutgoingInferenceMessage to SNS/IoT to notification workers).
  • Python services: the AI/alerts inference tier and supporting tooling.
  • Legacy Java services: ~140 Java 8 services and libraries (REST APIs, SQS/SNS workers, Lambda functions) running on Jetty 9.4, deployed to Elastic Beanstalk, ECS, and Lambda.
  • Edge appliances ("media boxes"): Ubuntu 22.04 / Docker Compose appliances managed remotely over AWS IoT Core secure tunnelling, with Cloudflare tunnels for egress. Includes an active CentOS 7 to containerized-stack migration effort.
  • Data and messaging backbone: PostgreSQL (RDS) across many schemas, TimescaleDB for analytics, Redis, DynamoDB, Amazon MSK (Kafka), SQS/SNS, and Kinesis.

What you'll do Reliability and operations (the core of the role)
  • Own service objectives. Define SLIs and SLOs for the services that matter, manage error budgets, and use them to drive prioritization and change-rate decisions. Make reliability a measured number, not a feeling.
  • Make observability trustworthy. Own alert quality end-to-end: high signal-to-noise, alarms that reliably catch the incidents they are meant to catch, and the discipline to turn off a misleading alarm until it is fixed properly. Build the dashboards and the custom metrics, exporters, and instrumentation (CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry) needed to see the system clearly.
  • Lead incident response. Run incidents calmly, drive mean-time-to-recovery down, and produce blameless postmortems with action items that actually get closed. Improve and own the on-call rotation and its health.
  • Plan capacity and performance. Forecast and right-size compute (especially GPU), Kafka/MSK throughput and partitioning, RDS/TimescaleDB load, and Redis. Catch saturation before customers do.
  • Own business continuity and disaster recovery. Backups, replication, failover, and recovery for RDS, MSK, Redis, and the edge fleet. Define RPO/RTO and prove them with regular, tested game days, not assumptions.
  • Keep the edge fleet healthy. Remote diagnosis and recovery over AWS IoT, container auto-update over systemd timers, and the ongoing CentOS 7 migration to the containerized media stack (Ubuntu 22.04).
  • Engineer away toil. Write real software (Python, Golang, Bash) to automate operational work, self-heal common failures, and make reliability repeatable instead of heroic.
  • Govern production change safely. Enforce collaborative, reviewed change management; protect the system from risky, unilateral changes (topology, instance-count, scaling, and config).

Delivery and platform (in support of reliability)
  • Keep CI/CD healthy and safe: CircleCI with Bazel/Gradle builds, OIDC-based AWS auth, container builds to ECR, and EB/ECS/Lambda deploys, tuned so that releases are safe, observable, and reversible.
  • Maintain Terraform for the AWS estate (compute, networking, IAM, databases, messaging, monitoring), following our module-based conventions and S3-backed state.
  • Harden security and compliance: IAM least-privilege, Secrets Manager/KMS, TLS and certificate management (including IoT device certificates), CloudTrail, and AWS Config.


Requirements


  • AWS certification is mandatory. A current AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional is strongly preferred.
  • 10+ years in Site Reliability Engineering or production operations at scale. We do not expect mastery of every area below on day one. We expect real depth in several and the ability to ramp quickly on the rest.
  • Demonstrated SLO/error-budget practice. You have defined SLIs and SLOs, run against an error budget, and used it to make real decisions.
  • Strong production observability skills. Deep with metrics, logs, alarming, and dashboards (CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, and/or Prometheus/Grafana/Datadog), and able to build the instrumentation when it does not exist.
  • Proven incident command. You have led incidents, owned an on-call rotation, and written postmortems that changed how a system behaved.
  • Capacity planning and performance experience across compute, databases, and a messaging or streaming system (Kafka/MSK ideal).
  • Disaster recovery ownership: backups, replication, failover, and tested RPO/RTO.
  • Software engineering ability for automation. Comfortable writing Python, Golang, and Bash to build reliability tooling, not just configure off-the-shelf tools.
  • Expert with Terraform (or equivalent IaC) and strong Linux administration (shell plus Linux GNU utils), comfortable from cloud to bare-metal/edge.
  • Database operations experience with PostgreSQL (time-series a plus).
  • A reliability mindset: you instrument before you guess, and you write the runbook.
Nice to have
  • Operating GPU workloads and serving computer-vision or ML models in production (CUDA, Deep Learning AMIs, inference scaling).
  • Apache MSK / Kafka and streaming-data operations (Kinesis, Kinesis Video Streams).
  • AWS IoT Core at scale: device provisioning, certificates, secure tunnelling.
  • Managing a fleet of edge / on-premise devices (golden images, remote update, systemd).
  • Operating and modernizing legacy systems (Java 8, Jetty, CentOS).
  • Chaos engineering / game-day practice, and capacity modeling.
  • Familiarity with Bazel in a monorepo; Cloudflare, Cognito/Auth0, API Gateway.

How we work, and what we expect from this hire:

These principles reflect lessons we take seriously. The right candidate already operates this way:
  • Observability must be trustworthy. Alarms that cry wolf are worse than no alarms. You own alert quality end-to-end: high signal-to-noise, alarms that reliably catch the incidents they are meant to catch, and the judgment to turn off a misleading alarm until it is fixed properly rather than leave a noisy one firing. We have felt the cost of unreliable alerting and want someone who closes that gap and keeps it closed.
  • Change management is collaborative, never unilateral. Any infrastructure change that affects a service is made together with the engineer who owns and understands that service. Scaling, instance-count, topology, and config changes are reviewed with that owner before they ship. Single-instance vs. multi-instance assumptions, in particular, are never changed on a guess.
  • Follow-through over activity. We measure outcomes, not effort or hours. When something is asked for, we expect it driven to a correct, durable resolution on a reasonable timeline, not left half-solved for months. Find what is actually needed, focus on it, and finish it.
  • Prefer the right fix to a quick patch. Solve the root cause. Do not paper over it and move on.

jobs.excerpt: IntegriChain's Product Management team is adding a Product Analyst for Prism.
jobs.description:
IntegriChain's Product Management team is adding a Product Analyst for Prism. Prism is our conversational analytics platform. It lets the people who work in market access at life sciences companies ask questions about their data in plain English and get answers back in seconds, instead of handing the request to an analyst and waiting. Behind the scenes, Prism runs on semantic layers we build from our raw SQL data, and those layers are what let it take a business question and map it to the right numbers. The Product Analyst is the person who makes sure the questions people ask actually line up with the answers Prism gives back. You'll work day to day with Product Management, Data Science, and Engineering to keep those answers accurate and worth trusting.

This isn't a development role, and it isn't about building reports or dashboards. It's an analysis role for someone who is technical but isn't a software engineer. You'll use Snowflake Cortex along with tools like Claude and Codex to review and improve the prompts business users type into Prism and the answers it sends back. A lot of the work is finding the spots where the data is set up in a way that leads Prism to misread a question or return the wrong answer. Roughly half the job is digging into the data itself. The other half is talking to the business owners, certifying that queries return the right results, and writing up what needs to change.

What This Role Entails

  • Prompt review: Go through the prompts business users type into Prism and improve them, using Snowflake Cortex and tools like Claude and Codex, so their questions get read correctly against the semantic layer.
  • Query certification: Check user queries and the answers Prism gives back, confirm they hold up against the source data, and sign off so the business can trust the results.
  • Quality ownership: Keep an eye on the questions users ask and the answers they get, and watch for repeat errors, gaps, or misreads so they get fixed.
  • Semantic layer work: Work with Data Science and Engineering to improve the semantic layers built from the raw SQL tables, including the taxonomies, metadata, and labeling, so Prism understands the data better.
  • Data analysis: Dig into how data connects across pricing, rebates, chargebacks, and other areas, and use what you find to shape how that data is represented in Prism.
  • Working with the business: Talk to business owners about the questions they need answered, and turn those conversations into better prompts, queries, and data structure.
  • Writing requirements: Write clear technical requirements for tuning the model, changing how data is structured, or improving the product, based on what your reviews turn up.
  • Documentation: Document where the data comes from, the business logic behind it, and how things relate, so people can understand and trust Prism's answers.
  • Roadmap input: Be the voice for data quality in planning and prioritization for Prism, so decisions are based on what the data actually says.
  • QA and communication: Work with QA to set up test cases for answer accuracy each sprint, and help with internal and customer updates (release notes, briefings, presentations) that explain how Prism works.

What You'll Bring to the Table

  • At least 3 years in data analysis, data correlation, or similar analytical work.
  • Strong technical skills without being a software engineer. You're comfortable with SQL, semantic layers, and data structures, and you can dig into a problem on your own.
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools like Snowflake Cortex, Claude, or Codex, and a good sense of how they read structured data and prompts.
  • A working knowledge of semantic data modeling (ontologies, taxonomies, knowledge graphs, or similar) and how it supports AI querying.
  • A knack for spotting when an AI answer doesn't match the source data, and the patience to figure out why.
  • A track record of turning messy data relationships into clear requirements, working alongside Product Management, Data Science, and Engineering.
  • Strong writing and speaking skills. You can talk to business owners and explain complicated data and AI ideas in a way people can act on.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar Agile tools.
  • Familiarity with pharma, or with contracts and pricing, is a plus. A 4-year degree in a related field is preferred.

What does IntegriChain have to offer?

  • Shape how a market-leading platform's AI understands and responds to life sciences data.
  • Work at the intersection of data science, semantic modeling, and product innovation, with visibility to senior product and company leadership.
  • Join a collaborative, growing o
  • Mission driven: Work with the purpose of helping to improve patients' lives!
  • Excellent and affordable medical benefits + non-medical perks including Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Robust Learning & Development opportunities including over 700+ development courses free to all employees

IntegriChain is committed to equal treatment and opportunity in all aspects of recruitment, selection, and employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ethnicity, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other category protected under the law. IntegriChain is an equal opportunity employer; committed to creating a community of inclusion, and an environment free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

Our policy on visa sponsorship for US based positions: Applicants for employment in the US must have valid work authorization that does not now and/or will not in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the US by IntegriChain.

We deliver the data, the applications, and the business process infrastructure for patient access and therapy commercialization. More than 250 manufacturers rely on our ICyte Platform to orchestrate their commercial and government payer contracting, patient services, and distribution channels. ICyte is the first and only platform that unites the financial, operational, and commercial data sets required to support therapy access in the era of specialty and precision medicine. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators can digitalize their market access operations, freeing up resources to focus on more data-driven decision support. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators are digitalizing labor-intensive processes – freeing up their best talent to identify and resolve coverage and availability hurdles and to manage pricing and forecasting complexity.

Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.

Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

Mission

As a Creative Developer, you will sit at the intersection of game development, creative production, and performance marketing. Your mission is to use Unity and C# to rapidly modify existing games, prototype new gameplay ideas, and build tools that help the Creative team produce and test high-performing ads faster.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Modify and prototype gameplay in Unity: new mechanics, visuals, features, UI, cameras, and gameplay variations
  • Build tools for Creative teams: create flexible Unity apps and internal tools for video and playable-ad production
  • Produce rapid iterations: create multiple game variations to test hooks, mechanics, visuals, and player experiences
  • Own technical quality: debug, fix issues, optimize performance, and ensure features work reliably
  • Iterate from performance data: use ad results and learnings to improve creative concepts and gameplay
  • Contribute to ideation: participate in brainstorming and propose new gameplay, creative, and technical ideas
  • Explore new technologies: leverage AI, and emerging tools to increase production speed and creativity

Contract setup: This is a full-time freelance opportunity, structured around project needs, with flexible duration depending on the scope and evolution of the projects.

Requirements

We are looking for someone with years of experience as a Creative Developer or Unity Developer in mobile games.

You're a great fit if you have:

  • Strong Unity + C# expertise, confidently modifying existing games, gameplay, mechanics, visuals, and features while debugging and optimizing your work
  • Creative + technical mindset, able to turn creative ideas into engaging gameplay variations, prototypes, and high-performing ad concepts quickly
  • Strong mobile gaming and creative understanding, with a player-centric approach and knowledge of performance creatives, playable ads, and social/mobile ad trends
  • Fast prototyping and iteration skills, balancing speed and quality in a high-volume, test-and-learn creative environment
  • Autonomous and collaborative approach, working closely with Creative, Game Dev, and UA teams and using performance data to iterate on concepts
  • Bonus: experience with AI-assisted creative/development workflows, Blender, Photoshop, shaders, VFX, or building Unity tools for Creative teams

Benefits

At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, act with pragmatism, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

  • Humility: We recognise that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow - we stay grounded in a clear view of ourselves.
  • Curiosity: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what” - we explore with purpose and practicality.
  • Focus: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we obsess over the details and let pragmatism guide our attention.
  • Ambition: We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough,” - we use common sense to reach higher.

Where We Hire

Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we’ve designed a space people genuinely enjoy - all within a cozy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).

We have incredible team members across Europe - from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you’re working from a sunny WeWork in Barcelona or your home setup in Warsaw, you’re fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we primarily hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC+3). If you're based there - or planning to be - we’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Native Infrastructure
jobs.excerpt: Hey, g'day, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte! Thanks for stopping by.
jobs.description:
Hey, g'day, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

What you'd be doing in this role:

Every native app Canva ships runs on a build and release system someone has to own, and right now that system sits on the critical path for the biggest client-side re-architecture in Canva's history. You'd be the engineer who takes that on: the Bazel rules, the monorepo, the release pipeline, the whole native foundation that hundreds of engineers build against every day.

Canva's mobile apps are moving off a browser-wrapped shell and onto a native-grade Portable Platform, and the build, release and CI foundations underneath that shift currently sit with a handful of people stitching together fragmented tooling. This role exists to give that foundation a single, deliberate owner, someone who can set the technical direction for iOS and Android build systems, the monorepo migration, and the React Native build pipeline that the Portable Platform depends on.

Bazel at mobile scale is still rare in this industry, which means most of the standards you'd set here don't exist yet anywhere else. You'd be defining what "good" looks like for build reliability, release safety and monorepo strategy across both platforms, and you'd be doing it with the benefit of a 12-month horizon rather than the current quarter, the difference between a senior engineer solving a defined problem and a staff engineer defining the problem worth solving.

At the moment, this role is focused on:

  • Build architecture: own the roadmap for Bazel build rules, React Native bundling and codegen, making trade-offs between short-term fixes and long-term foundations.

  • Release infrastructure: mature Canva's mobile release and deployment tooling, including OTA and staged rollout, so shipping mobile is predictable rather than fragile.

  • Monorepo migration: lead the staged migration of mobile repos into Canva's monorepo, owning build, test and release continuity throughout.

  • CI/CD strategy: set the quality gating strategy across the build pipeline, surfacing reliability and speed problems before they're handed to you.

  • Cross-platform foundations: evolve the React Native build pipeline into a shared foundation that serves both web and mobile, not just mobile in isolation.

  • Stakeholder alignment: work across Mobile Workflows, Cross Platform, Build Platform and DevX to pull fragmented tooling into one coherent system.

  • Team leverage: build monitoring and health signals for builds and releases, and mentor engineers so the standards you set outlast any one project.

Success here looks like build and release infrastructure that other teams stop noticing because it just works, and a mobile monorepo strategy that product teams build against without having to think about the plumbing underneath it.

You’re probably a match:

We'd love to hear from you if you fit one or more of these. You don't need to meet all of them, but the more the better and if you join the team, we're invested in helping you grow.

Experience:

  • Build systems: deep, hands-on expertise with Bazel, Gradle, or Xcode build systems at production scale.

  • Cross-team delivery: a track record of scoping and delivering complex projects that span multiple teams — migrations, monorepo consolidation, or build infrastructure at scale.

  • Mobile depth: strong native engineering background in iOS, Android, or both, with a real point of view on where cross-platform tooling helps and where it doesn't.

  • Release engineering: experience owning CI/CD or release pipelines that other teams depend on, not just contributing to them.

  • Strategic judgement: you balance short-term delivery against long-term architecture, and you can connect an external shift in tooling to a change in technical direction.

  • Standards setting: your documentation and technical practices have become the reference other engineers build on, not just something you wrote once.

Technical knowledge:

  • Bazel depth: build rules, custom rule sets, and monorepo build configuration at meaningful scale.

  • CI/CD pipelines: designing quality gates and pipeline stages that hold up as more teams depend on them.

  • React Native builds: bundling, codegen, and native module integration inside a production RN pipeline.

  • iOS build tooling: Xcode build system depth, including native iOS release configuration.

  • Android build tooling: Gradle depth, including native Android release configuration.

  • Release management: OTA updates, staged rollout, and deployment infrastructure for mobile apps.

  • Monorepo systems: experience migrating or operating within a large-scale monorepo.

Nice to have:

  • Cross-language interop: native bridging or codegen automation experience across JS and native runtimes.

  • Mobile performance: profiling and optimisation work on native or hybrid mobile apps.

  • Platform advocacy: experience getting engineering standards adopted beyond your own team.

  • Scale exposure: prior work on mobile products with a large, established user base.

About the Group and Team:

Join the Product Platform supergroup at Canva, where our mission is to build the pathways that empower Canva to deliver delightful experiences for billions of users.

Mobile Platform is the subgroup that provides optimal platform support for mobile development, from ideation to deployment, so that Canva's native apps feel delightful on every device. It sits within Product Platform alongside Client Platform, User Platform, API Platform and PIE, and currently spans the teams working on cross-platform product engineering and native mobile foundations.

Native Infra owns the native foundations underneath Canva's mobile apps: iOS and Android build systems, the migration of mobile repos into Canva's monorepo, release and deployment infrastructure, and the React Native build pipeline underpinning the Portable Platform. Every team shipping a mobile feature at Canva builds on top of what this team maintains, when Native Infra gets the foundation right, that reliability compounds across every product team that ships mobile.

What’s in it for you?

Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard — and we do — but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for success both in and outside of work.

Here's a taste of what's on offer:

  • Equity packages — we want our success to be yours too

  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers

  • An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more

  • Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally

Other stuff to know?

We see AI as a powerful amplifier of creativity and technology at Canva. We're evolving how we assess AI skills in our Technology hiring experience — you'll tackle interactive, real-time challenges that reflect the kind of work we do. In some interviews, you may also be asked to solve a problem using an AI tool to show how you approach challenges with tech by your side.

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture.

When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva, so even if you don't feel like your skills quite match what's listed above — we still want to hear from you!

Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

About the Role

You own the company's identity provider: who signs in, from where, with which factors, into which applications — and how that access is granted, reviewed, and revoked.

Microsoft Entra ID is the primary identity plane and the center of gravity for the role. Google Workspace, Cloud Identity, and Google Cloud IAM form a second substantial domain, and you own the federation and provisioning path between them. Microsoft 365 is in scope for tenant, licensing, and access administration.

You are the escalation point for identity incidents from operations, security, service desk, and application teams — expected to resolve them, not route them onward.

What You'll Own

Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft 365

  • Users, dynamic and assigned groups, administrative units, directory roles, service principals, workload identities.
  • Conditional Access design and rollout: named locations, client app and platform conditions, session controls, sign-in frequency, break-glass exclusions, report-only staging.
  • Authentication methods policy and phishing-resistant factors.
  • Application onboarding over SAML 2.0 (NameID, claims mapping, signing certificate rollover, encrypted assertions) and OIDC / OAuth 2.0 (authorization code with PKCE, client credentials, device code).
  • App registrations: redirect URIs, permissions, admin consent workflow, secret and certificate lifecycle. – SCIM 2.0 provisioning: attribute mappings, scoping filters, expression transformations, quarantined jobs, drift reconciliation.
  • Tenant consent settings, OAuth grant review, remediation of over-permissioned and stale applications; defensible controls for SaaS without SSO or SCIM support.
  • Joiner-mover-leaver as an automated pipeline: provisioning, group-based licensing, revocation with session and refresh token invalidation.
  • Least privilege for admin access: scoped role assignments, RBAC, PIM, access reviews, entitlement management access packages.
  • Service account and workload identity governance: ownership, credential rotation, permission scoping, decommissioning.
  • Microsoft 365 tenant settings, licensing, admin roles; access and permission issues in Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Power Platform.
  • Diagnostics from sign-in, audit, and provisioning logs, with diagnostic settings routed to Log Analytics and KQL queries.
  • Cross-tenant access settings and B2B external collaboration.

Google Workspace, Cloud Identity, and Google Cloud

  • Google Workspace and Cloud Identity: users, groups, organizational units, admin roles and privileges, licensing, 2-Step Verification enforcement, session controls.
  • Third-party SSO profiles with Microsoft Entra ID as SAML IdP, automated provisioning into Cloud Identity, OU- and group-scoped SSO exclusions.
  • Context-Aware Access policies, third-party OAuth app access control, domain-wide delegation, Drive sharing and external access controls. 2
  • Google Cloud IAM: project and folder membership, predefined and custom roles, allow policies, service accounts and key hygiene, workload identity federation, API enablement, OAuth clients.

Automation

  • PowerShell tooling on the Microsoft Graph PowerShell SDK and Graph REST API: lifecycle, licensing, access reporting, recertification.
  • Google-side automation through the Admin SDK Directory API, Cloud Identity API, and gcloud.
  • Scheduled and event-driven workflows in Azure Automation Runbooks, Azure Logic Apps, or Power Automate.
  • Unattended execution on managed identities and narrowly scoped app registrations, with credential rotation, structured logging, error handling, and retries.
  • Automation treated as production code: version control, peer review, documented rollback.

What You'll Bring

We care about what you can do, not which products appear on your CV. Concretely, you can:

  • Decode a SAML assertion or JWT and pinpoint the failure — audience mismatch, NameID format, expired signing certificate, missing claim — without escalating to the vendor.
  • Diagnose a failing SCIM job and tell scoping from attribute mapping, transformation expressions, or target schema.
  • Replace a manual lifecycle process with automation that logs, retries, and can be handed to someone else to run.

Experience We Expect

  • 3+ years administering Microsoft Entra ID in production as a primary responsibility.
  • Enterprise applications, app registrations, consent and permission models, automated provisioning.
  • Microsoft 365 administration: tenant settings, licensing, admin roles, and access troubleshooting across Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, and Power Platform.
  • Google Workspace and Cloud Identity administration: organizational units, groups, admin roles, SSO profiles, access settings.
  • Google Cloud IAM: projects, roles and policies, service accounts, API access, OAuth credentials.
  • Strong PowerShell with the Microsoft Graph PowerShell SDK and direct REST API work.
  • Azure Automation Runbooks, Azure Logic Apps, Power Automate, or comparable platforms.
  • Least privilege, secure administration, change management, and the discipline to leave configurations documented.
  • Written and spoken English at B2 or higher

Nice to Have

  • SC-300, MS-102, or SC-401 — or equivalent demonstrable expertise.
  • Microsoft Entra ID Governance: entitlement management, lifecycle workflows, Privileged Identity Management.
  • Microsoft Purview (DLP, retention, eDiscovery), Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, or Microsoft Sentinel.
  • Google Cloud workload identity federation, custom roles, organization policy constraints.
  • Git, CI/CD practices, Pester, Bicep, or Terraform.
  • Access evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, or comparable audit cycles.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

jobs.excerpt: Qui sommes-nous chez Pretto ?  💚 Acheter un bien immobilier, c'est toute une aventure : jargon complexe, délais interminables, stress d’obtenir son crédit… pas facile de s'y retrouver.
jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous chez Pretto ? 💚

Acheter un bien immobilier, c'est toute une aventure : jargon complexe, délais interminables, stress d’obtenir son crédit… pas facile de s'y retrouver.

Pretto, c'est la scale-up fintech qui dépoussière ce parcours. On a repensé de A à Z la recherche de crédit immo - de la première estimation de sa capacité d'emprunt jusqu'à la signature chez le notaire. Concrètement : chaque client a un expert crédit dédié qui l'accompagne de bout en bout, lui explique tout et le déleste de la charge mentale et admin que ça implique. Et tout ça avec des outils tech qui révolutionnent le métier de courtier !

Depuis 2017, Pretto c'est :

  • 150 000+ clients accompagnés
  • 2 milliards d'euros financés chaque année
  • 4,9/5 sur Trustpilot
  • Une série C de 40M+€
  • 200 personnes à Paris, Nantes et en full remote

Notre engagement : offrir à tous nos clients une expérience unique qui simplifie l'accès à la propriété.

Ce qui t’attend ici :

  • Un impact concret sur le quotidien des gens dès ton premier jour
  • Une culture du feedback où chacun peut apprendre et évoluer
  • Une vraie école de formation aux métiers du courtage et de la vente

Et pour aller plus loin, on vous présente sur notre site Inside Pretto !

🎯 Nous rejoindre en tant que courtier en prêts immobiliers chez Pretto

On recrute des courtiers en prêts immobiliers partout en France pour rejoindre notre équipe 100% télétravail, en CDI.

Ce poste peut t'intéresser si tu es déjà commercial et que tu as envie d'apprendre un nouveau métier, de te former rapidement et de développer une vraie expertise sur les sujets du financement immobilier.

Le courtage immobilier est un métier exigeant : réglementation, financement, échanges aussi bien avec des clients particuliers qu'avec des partenaires bancaires... Il faut être capable d'apprendre vite et d'absorber beaucoup d'informations dans les premiers mois.

Et le faire en 100% télétravail ajoute un défi supplémentaire.

Tu ne seras pas seul : tu suivras une formation dans nos locaux parisiens à ton arrivée, tu seras accompagné par ton manager et tu rejoindras une équipe qui travaille elle aussi en 100% télétravail partout en France.

Tu te reconnaîtras peut-être si :

  • Tu aimes les environnements où ça va vite et où il y a beaucoup à apprendre.
  • Le 100% remote, c'est plus qu'une préférence pour toi : c'est ce qui te permet de donner le meilleur de toi-même. Tu sais rester organisé, autonome et discipliné sans avoir besoin d'un bureau autour de toi.
  • Tu aimes la performance commerciale : atteindre des objectifs et te challenger te stimule plus que ça ne t'inquiète.
  • Tu aimes le volume : multiplier les échanges, gérer beaucoup de clients en parallèle et enchaîner les rendez-vous te donne de l'énergie plutôt que l'inverse.
  • Tu as envie d'apprendre un métier technique qui te permettra de développer une véritable expertise.

Chez Pretto, pas de prospection ni de réseau d'apporteurs à développer : les clients viennent à toi via notre simulateur. Ton énergie, tu la consacres à ce qui compte vraiment : comprendre leurs projets, les accompagner et trouver la meilleure solution de financement.

⚠️ En revanche, ce poste n'est pas fait pour tout le monde.

Le volume est important, la cadence est soutenue et la montée en compétences est exigeante.

Le télétravail ne rend pas le métier plus facile : il demande davantage d'autonomie, de rigueur et d'organisation. Si tu as besoin d'être entouré physiquement pour apprendre un nouveau métier ou garder ton rythme, ce poste risque d'être difficile.

Enfin, le 100% télétravail ne veut pas dire indépendance. Tu travailles depuis chez toi, mais tu gardes le cadre d'un CDI classique : des horaires, un manager de proximité, des objectifs, des réunions et des attentes claires.

🌟 Tes missions

Concrètement, tu accompagnes des particuliers qui ont un projet immobilier à trouver le financement le plus adapté à leur situation.

Ton quotidien, c'est :

  • Rappeler les clients qui ont réalisé une simulation sur notre site pour comprendre leur projet et leurs besoins. (100% des leads viennent de là)
  • Les accompagner tout au long de leur recherche de financement, du premier échange jusqu'à l'obtention de leur prêt
  • Gérer plusieurs dizaines de dossiers en parallèle tout en maintenant un haut niveau de qualité d'accompagnement
  • Créer une relation de confiance avec tes clients pour qu'ils te recommandent autour d'eux : le parrainage doit représenter au moins 25% de ton chiffre d'affaires.
  • Négocier avec plus de 125 partenaires bancaires pour construire la meilleure solution de financement
  • T'appuyer sur des outils développés en interne (IA, automatisation) pour être meilleur au quotidien et te concentrer sur les sujets à forte valeur ajoutée
  • Participer à l'amélioration de nos outils et de nos process grâce à tes retours terrain

Si tu aimes les journées qui passent vite, gérer plusieurs dossiers en parallèle et te challenger commercialement, le poste devrait te plaire !

👫 Ton profil

On pense que tu t'épanouiras chez Pretto si :

  • Tu as déjà une expérience commerciale significative avec des objectifs chiffrés et un vrai rythme d'activité
  • Tu es habitué au remote, tu aimes ça et c’est ce qui te permet d’être très efficace et très organisé
  • Tu es à l'aise avec le volume : beaucoup d'appels, beaucoup de clients, beaucoup de sujets à gérer en parallèle
  • Tu apprends vite et tu apprécies les environnements exigeants
  • Tu as une vraie aisance relationnelle et tu sais créer rapidement une relation de confiance au téléphone
  • Tu es ambitieux commercialement et motivé par la performance
  • Tu es humble et coachable : tu acceptes les feedbacks, tu remets régulièrement tes pratiques en question et tu cherches constamment à progresser

🔥 Pourquoi rejoindre la team sales ?

On te propose un CDI avec un package qui débloque les plafonds de verre de revenus dans notre métier. Tu démarres ta première année avec un fixe à 27K€ mais SURTOUT ton variable est 100% déplafonné.

Ton fixe pourra évoluer assez significativement au fur et à mesure de ta progression, basé sur une grille interne. Avec ce système, nos meilleurs courtiers dépassent les 130k€ annuels.

Ce n'est pas un modèle fait pour tout le monde, on le sait très bien. Mais avec le bon état d'esprit et le bon niveau d'ambition, il permet de faire des étincelles 🔥

🎯 Mais surtout, on met tout en place pour t'aider à performer :

  • Un manager de proximité qui t'accompagne avec des coachings réguliers.
  • Des formateurs issus du terrain et un buddy pour t'aider à monter rapidement en compétences.
  • Une vraie culture de l'entraide : même à distance, les commerciaux partagent leurs bonnes pratiques et s'entraident au quotidien.

Côté conditions de travail :

  • Tu travailles en 100% télétravail, partout en France (+ Corse), tout en gardant le cadre et les horaires d'un CDI classique
  • Un samedi travaillé sur quatre, avec un jour de récup dans la semaine (lundi)
  • Un vrai plan de carrière pour évoluer selon tes résultats, et pas seulement ton ancienneté
  • Une culture du feedback : chacun peut donner son avis et proposer des idées, et c’est même encouragé

🎁 Les avantages à travailler chez Pretto

💰 Un package salarial avantageux : carte ticket restaurant Swile, mutuelle prise en charge à 50% et une indemnité télétravail de 2€ par jour.

🌟 Des primes attractives : vacances, cooptation pouvant aller jusqu'à 2000€, intéressement, naissance

🏡 Une charte de télétravail te permettant de bénéficier d’une indemnité de 2€ par jour

🍻 Des moments partagés entre collègues : onboarding avec ta promo, rituels d’équipe, séances de sport, tournois de Smash Bros, organisation de Happylunch, offsite

💚 Prise en charge de 4 séances/an sur

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Un parrain ou marraine référent(e) pour te permettre de t’intégrer et de t’épanouir chez Pretto

🚀 Parce que rien ne vaut les mots d'un Sales on vous propose de découvrir la Vidéo de Flavien

🤝 Notre processus de recrutement

  • Un entretien d'une heure en visio avec Charles ou Lorane - Team Talent Acquisition
  • Puis un entretien en physique avecHélène, Head of Sales Pôle Full Remote qui inclut une mise en situation commerciale. À la suite de cet échange, nous te demanderons de nous communiquer une prise de référence.
  • Un dernier échange en visio avec Olivier, Head of Sales de Pretto
  • Félicitations, nous te rappelons pour te faire une offre, te présenter les avantages à nous rejoindre et les modalités d'onboarding. Bienvenue chez nous ! 🎉
Nous nous engageons pour l'égalité d'accès à l'emploi, l'inclusion et la diversité au sein des équipes.
