jobs.description:
​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Export Sales Development

Compensation range:$1750 AUD - $3500 AUD / Monthly

Work Schedule:Full-time, with core AEST overlap for head office coordination plus availability to reach distributors in assigned export markets

Who We Are:

At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be formally employed through an Employer of Record (EOR) arrangement. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote, so you’ll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is:

This role owns export sales growth through the client’s international distributor and reseller network. You’ll find and sign new distributors, run the day-to-day relationship with existing ones, push open opportunities toward close, and pull in the internal support each deal needs across pricing, product, regulatory and shipping.

You’ll report to the Business Manager and work closely with Marketing, Customer Service, Supply Chain and Regulatory. This is a self-directed role. You decide how the territory gets worked, within the agreed targets, pricing authority and response standards.

Role Overview:

This role exists to give the client's MENA distributor network the attention it hasn't had since their consultant left. You'll be the day-to-day point of contact for existing distributors across the Middle East and North Africa, working in Arabic, with the goal of deepening those accounts and lifting order volume. A secondary part of the role covers support for the ASEAN network and light groundwork in a small number of undeveloped territories.

This is an account growth role first, not a cold-outbound role. Most of the network already exists. The client needs someone who can service it well, spot where accounts are underperforming, and act on it.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Research, prospect and assess new distributors and resellers in assigned markets, then move the right ones through the client’s approval and distribution agreement process and onboard them.
  • Act as the primary contact for assigned distributors. Hold a regular call and review cadence, know their business and their market, and track their performance against the distribution agreement so underperformance and unmet demand both get surfaced early.
  • Keep visibility of every open opportunity your distributors are working and follow it up. Provide quotes, reference pricing, product information and tender support to move deals forward. Any pricing or discount outside the approved price list must be signed off in writing by the Business Manager before you quote it.
  • Deliver product and sales training to distributors, and build monthly sales and product campaigns plus a quarterly distributor newsletter alongside Marketing.
  • Support distributors with local product registration, import and regulatory requirements, and pull the product, quality and regulatory documentation together with the internal owners. Feed back what you learn about competitor moves, pricing pressure and market access.
  • Track open orders, coordinate with Supply Chain on preparation and shipping, and resolve documentation or fulfillment issues while keeping the distributor informed.
  • Keep the CRM accurate and current. Distributors, contacts, opportunities and activity logged within agreed timeframes, with regular territory and pipeline updates to the Business Manager.

Requirements

  • Proven B2B sales experience taking opportunities from prospecting through quotation to close. Export, distributor or channel sales, or international account management, is strongly preferred.
  • Working proficiency in written and spoken Arabic is strongly preferred for distributor and customer engagement in key export markets.
  • Exceptional written and spoken English, strong enough to run commercial discussions and correspondence with international distributors and Australian head office stakeholders.
  • Commercial judgment around pricing and margin, and the attention to detail that quoting demands.
  • Comfortable picking up technical products quickly and explaining them clearly. Medical device, healthcare or medical imaging background is a plus, not a requirement.
  • Confident in CRM and ERP platforms, or able to learn them fast.
  • Able to run a territory independently, prioritize across multiple markets and deliver against targets with limited day-to-day direction.
  • Tertiary qualification in business, sales or marketing preferred, but not essential.

Benefits

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Be available for meetings and collaboration during core AEST business hours, and arrange enough overlap with assigned export markets to meet agreed response standards.
  • Acknowledge distributor enquiries and support requests within one business day.
  • Be willing and able to travel internationally when required, including industry conferences, distributor visits and periodic travel to the Australian head office.
  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work.
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”).

If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Senior Engineer position requires a high degree of technical and coding competencies while providing support to various Lumen organizations. This position assumes ownership and accountability in areas of recognized coding expertise and provides leadership, guidance, and assistance across different segments. Principle work includes identifying ways to improve Network Reliability and Customer Satisfaction with knowledge of Voice & Transport networks. This position will also mentor engineer peers.

Location

  • Provide data support for the Lumen Managed Services contracts. Includes data design, installation and maintenance for new and current installations.

  • Evaluate new technical requirements for compatibility with deployed system design as well as new products for compatibility and applicability to the Managed Services solutions
  • Maintain current knowledge base regarding complex routing, switching
  • Monitor and analyze performance across customer networks and underlying MS Tools deployments as required for Managed Services.
  • Provide high-level technical & engineering support for network performance management configurations, troubleshooting, and service restoration along with an understanding of switching, routing as it would affect performance management.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues
  • Provide high-level off-hours support on a rotating basis with other engineers
  • Develop and oversee subordinate level technical methods, procedures, and assist with complex technical solution designs. Develop & document process flows.
  • Identify capacity and performance issues for network traffic to ensure continued, uninterrupted operation of systems.

  • Create and maintain network documentation and reports as required
  • Act as liaison between Managed Services, other Lumen departments and other vendors (e.g. Cisco & Solarwinds) on high-level support issues.

AffirmedRx is on a mission to improve health care outcomes by bringing clarity, integrity, and trust to pharmacy benefit management. We accomplish this by bringing total clarity to business practices, leading with clinical approaches, and utilizing state-of-the-art technology.

Join us in improving health care outcomes for all! We promise to do what’s right, always.

Position Summary:

The Director, Pharmacy Trend & Pipeline Strategy serves as AffirmedRx's lead strategist for emerging pharmacy trends, pipeline intelligence, and cost-of-care optimization. The role proactively identifies, evaluates, and recommends strategies related to evolving market dynamics, specialty drug trends, biosimilars, generic launches, utilization patterns, and other emerging cost drivers. Through cross-functional collaboration, this position drives strategic interventions that improve affordability, support formulary and clinical decision-making, and position AffirmedRx and its clients ahead of market change.

What you will do:

Pharmacy Trend and Pipeline Strategy:

  • Own enterprise pharmacy trend forecasting and market surveillance to identify emerging cost drivers and utilization patterns
  • Maintain oversight of the drug development pipeline, assessing clinical, financial, operational, and formulary impacts of new therapies
  • Evaluate therapeutic category shifts and recommend proactive strategies before they materially impact client spend
  • Monitor market trends, access strategies, and industry developments to identify opportunities for intervention and differentiation

Trend Mitigation and Clinical Strategy Development:

  • Develop and maintain a multi-year pharmacy trend mitigation roadmap aligned with organizational goals
  • Recommend formulary, utilization management, biosimilar, generic, and channel management strategies to address emerging cost pressures
  • Evaluate new-to-market and high-impact pipeline therapies and provide clinical recommendations prior to launch
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to prioritize and implement initiatives that improve trend performance and cost management

Biosimilar and Formulary Optimization:

  • Lead the development of AffirmedRx’s biosimilar strategy in collaboration with Formulary Strategy and Utilization Management
  • Recommend formulary positioning, utilization management approaches, and conversion strategies to support biosimilar adoption
  • Support provider education and adoption monitoring efforts to ensure successful implementation
  • Assess formulary and benefit design opportunities that optimize outcomes while managing pharmacy spend

Clinical Intelligence and Financial Analysis:

  • Serve as a key contributor to the Clinical Intelligence Council by evaluating trend drivers and prioritizing intervention opportunities
  • Partner with Clinical Modeling to develop financial impact assessments and pharmacoeconomic analyses
  • Quantify projected trend drivers, savings opportunities, and return on investment for proposed strategies
  • Support enterprise decision-making through data-driven clinical and financial insights

Clinical Leadership and Stakeholder Communication:

  • Serve as the clinical lead for pipeline, trend, biosimilar, and pharmacoeconomic evaluations presented to the Pharmacy & Therapeutics Committee
  • Develop strategic recommendations and clinical content for enterprise and client-facing trend reporting
  • Collaborate with Specialty, Trade Relations, Population Health, and other stakeholders on channel management opportunities
  • Communicate complex clinical and market insights to executive leadership, clients, and internal business partners

What you need:

  • Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) degree from an accredited institution
  • Active, unrestricted pharmacist license in the United States
  • 10+ years of experience in managed care, PBM, or health plan pharmacy, with direct experience in pharmacy trend analysis, trend forecasting, pipeline evaluation, or cost-of-care management
  • Demonstrated experience identifying, evaluating, and developing strategies to address pharmacy trend drivers, including specialty drug spend, biosimilars, generic launches, pipeline therapies, and utilization management opportunities
  • Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting pharmacy utilization, trend, and financial data to identify actionable opportunities
  • Experience developing business cases, financial impact assessments, or pharmacoeconomic analyses used to support formulary, utilization management, biosimilar, or trend mitigation decisions
  • Knowledge of formulary management, utilization management strategies, pharmacoeconomics, and specialty pharmacy market dynamics
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with proficiency presenting trend data to clients or executive audiences
  • Experience with PBM trend reporting tools and client-facing communication
  • Familiarity with net-cost formulary architecture and rebate-aware formulary strategy
  • Experience developing pharmacy trend forecasts, market impact models, or cost-of-care projections used to inform business or formulary strategy
  • Experience monitoring FDA pipeline developments and translating clinical, regulatory, and market events into formulary, utilization management, and operational readiness strategies

What you get:

  • To impact industry change in the pharmacy benefits management space, while delivering the highest quality patient outcomes
  • To work in a culture where people thrive because when OUR team thrives, OUR business thrives
  • Competitive compensation, including health, dental, vision and other benefits

About our Venture Model

Build your own company together with a venture fund

We are a venture fund and venture builder, co-creating new companies together with experienced founders.

This is not a traditional job application. This is an open call for founders who:

  • already have a strong idea,

  • are shaping a clear thesis,

  • or are looking for the right partner to build a company from zero.

Our model is simple:

Opportunity to co-found a new company together with a venture fund that becomes a strategic shareholder and long-term partner, providing initial funding in exchange for founder equity, venture building support, and reduced early-stage risk.

What co-creating a company with us really means

By building a company together with our venture fund, you gain:

Initial funding in exchange for equity

We provide pre-seed capital from day one to:

  • validate your idea,

  • build the MVP,

  • reach early Product–Market Fit,

  • start sales

  • and prepare the company for further investment rounds.

You do not need to raise capital before you can start building.

A strategic shareholder, not a passive investor

We do not only invest capital. We become an active co-founder and long-term shareholder, supporting you in:

  • company strategy and positioning,

  • product and technology decisions,

  • hiring the first team,

  • fundraising preparation and investor communication,

  • governance and company structure.

You build the company with full founder responsibility, with an experienced institutional partner at your side.

Lower personal financial risk at the earliest stage

Unlike classic bootstrapping or pure equity-only founding:

  • you receive stable remuneration while building the company,

  • you keep significant equity,

  • you can focus on building rather than surviving.

This allows you to take bold risks without personal financial instability.

Access to a full venture building platform

From the first week, you get access to:

  • legal setup and incorporation,

  • finance, accounting, and reporting,

  • HR and hiring support,

  • product, design, and engineering resources,

  • fundraising and investor network.

You focus on building the company - we remove the operational friction.

Faster path from idea to real company

We help you:

  • validate your idea with real customers,

  • incorporate quickly and correctly, with proper corporate governance

  • move from idea to functioning startup in weeks/months, not years.

Speed matters in early-stage ventures. We optimise for it.

Credibility for future fundraising

Being backed by an established venture fund gives you:

  • higher credibility with angels and VCs,

  • easier access to follow-on funding,

  • better documentation and materials,

  • stronger signalling in competitive markets.

We actively prepare you for the next funding rounds.

Founder autonomy with strong institutional support

You remain a true founder:

  • you define the vision,

  • you lead the company,

  • you build the team,

  • you own significant equity.

At the same time, you are not alone. You build with a partner who has already built and funded multiple ventures.

Who this model is for

This open call is for people who:

  • Have a strong startup idea or thesis they want to build a company around.

  • Have a proven track record in startups or early-stage ventures.

  • Have already built product PMF, 0→1 technology, or 0→1 revenue.

  • Want to be a true founder, not an employee.

  • Are ready to take full responsibility for building a company.

Typical profiles:

  • CEO / CPO with a product-driven idea,

  • CTO / VP Engineering with a strong technical vision,

  • CRO / Business founder with a market thesis and sales edge.

What happens next

Our process is designed to evaluate both:

  • the founder,

  • and the idea.

Typical steps:

  1. Intro conversation (founder + venture partner)

  2. Deep dive into your idea/thesis

  3. Joint validation plan

  4. Agreement on venture scope, equity, and funding

  5. Company creation and build phase

Apply as a Founder.

Bring your idea.

Let’s build a company together.

jobs.excerpt: CloudLinux is a global remote-first company.  We are driven by our principles: do the right thing, employees first, we are remote first, and we deliver high-volume, low-cost Linux infrastructure and security products that help companies to increase the efficiency of their operations.
jobs.description:
CloudLinux is a global remote-first company. We are driven by our principles: do the right thing, employees first, we are remote first, and we deliver high-volume, low-cost Linux infrastructure and security products that help companies to increase the efficiency of their operations. Every person on our team supports each other and does what we can to ensure we all are successful.

Check out our website for more information

Imunify360 Security Suite is a product of CloudLinux Inc., the maker of the #1 OS in security and stability for hosting providers. Imunify is an innovative security solution designed specifically for shared and VPS/Dedicated servers. The automated, easy-to-use solution with the six-layer approach to security delivers comprehensive and complete attack prevention.

We are looking for an experienced engineer to own the automated pipelines that turn threat intelligence into shipped protection for tens of millions of websites.

When a new vulnerability appears, a chain of automated systems has to notice it, obtain the vulnerable source, produce WAF rules, generate tests, prove the rules work and don't break legitimate traffic, and roll it out across tens of millions of websites — then watch production hard enough to pull it back automatically if it misbehaves. Today that chain exists and runs 24/7, and a single unreliable link could cost customers their protection. We are looking for a strong Engineer to expand it rapidly while keeping it reliable and transparent. This involves solving hard engineering problems, working with data at scale, in a world with many surprises.

This is not an analyst role and not a research role, but additional experience in this domain is welcome. What we need is someone who builds systems that keep working: complex logic underneath, boring and reliable on the outside.

The position is fully remote with flexible hours, allowing you to plan your day and work from anywhere in the world.

What you would own

Systems that are in production today and need to grow considerably:

  • The automated protection pipeline — the chain from threat intelligence to a validated, deployed rule. Multi-stage, largely autonomous, and required to finish inside a fixed time window every day.
  • Progressive release automation — rolling protection out across the fleet in controlled stages, with automated guardrails that hold or roll back a stage without a human in the loop.
  • Quality gates — deciding, from live production signal, whether something we shipped is doing harm, and acting on that before it reaches the next stage. Errors are costly in both directions: miss a problem and customer sites break; over-correct and protection is silently removed.
  • CI at scale — validation that stands up real, disposable environments across a large matrix of software versions and configurations, and returns a trustworthy verdict fast enough to stay inside the release window.
  • LLM orchestration and cost control — several subsystems are driven by AI agents inside purpose-built harnesses, with evaluation, budgets and spend accounting as load-bearing components.
  • Observability and alerting across all of it — the pipelines are expected to report their own condition, prove they are healthy, and escalate on their own.

This runs on top of a petabyte-scale threat-intelligence store and live telemetry from more than 60 million websites, under strict end-to-end latency budgets measured in hours. The failure mode we care most about eliminating is a budget missed silently.

We will go into the specifics during the interview process.

Key responsibilities

  • Designing, building and operating the automated pipelines described above, end to end;
  • Turning fragile multi-stage batch jobs into resumable, idempotent, observable systems with explicit state machines and recovery paths;
  • Defining and enforcing latency budgets and SLOs per stage, and making violations visible and actionable rather than silent;
  • Building the observability layer — metrics, dashboards, alerting and health gates — so the pipeline reports its own condition instead of needing someone to go and look;
  • Designing and implementing guardrails: automatic hold and rollback, blast-radius limits, kill switches, and safe-by-default behaviour when an upstream dependency is unavailable;
  • Making the systems low-maintenance: eliminating manual steps, removing standing human babysitting, and reducing the operational surface rather than adding to it;
  • Writing and maintaining unit and integration tests for logic that is genuinely hard to test — concurrency, partial failure, external API flakiness, multi-stage state;
  • Investigating and resolving complex issues across ClickHouse, GitLab CI, S3/object storage, Prometheus/Grafana and third-party APIs;
  • Collaborating with the security analysts and the Server team on architecture, and pushing back when a proposed design will not survive contact with production.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional backend / platform / infrastructure engineering experience;
  • Demonstrable experience building and operating multi-stage data or automation pipelines — CI/CD systems, ETL/ELT, build and release automation, job orchestration, ML/data platforms, or similar. This is the single most important requirement. We will ask you to walk us through one in detail;
  • Real depth in at least one of Python, Go or Rust. We use all three, and we are not hiring a language specialist — which one you bring genuinely does not matter. Depth is simply how we verify the experience behind it is real, so expect specific questions about systems you have designed and shipped: why they are shaped the way they are, how they behave under failure, and what you would build differently today;
  • Systems design judgement, more than raw coding throughput. The difficult part of this role is deciding what to build, working out where it will break, and making it prove its own correctness — not volume of code produced;
  • Practical experience with workflow orchestration and job scheduling (Airflow, Temporal, Prefect, Dagster, Argo, custom schedulers — whatever you have actually run in production);
  • A working instinct for reliability engineering: idempotency, retries with backoff, exactly-once vs at-least-once, checkpointing and resumability, graceful degradation, backpressure, and safe handling of partial failure;
  • Hands-on observability experience — Prometheus/Grafana, LGTM stack, or equivalent — including designing metrics rather than only consuming dashboards someone else built;
  • Deep CI/CD experience, ideally GitLab CI including dynamic/child pipelines and self-hosted runners; comfort with Docker and container-based test environments;
  • Experience with object storage (S3/Ceph or equivalent) and with large-scale analytical stores — ClickHouse or another columnar database;
  • Comfort designing state machines and long-running processes that survive restarts, and reasoning about concurrency across multiple in-flight rollouts;
  • Excellent debugging skills across system, network and data layers;
  • Strong communication skills and comfort working in a distributed team;
  • Proficiency in spoken and written English.

Nice to have

  • Experience with progressive delivery — canary and percentage-based rollouts, feature flags, automated rollback, blast-radius control;
  • Experience running AI/LLM systems in production, particularly cost control, token accounting, evaluation harnesses, and dealing with non-deterministic components inside a deterministic pipeline;
  • Experience with fleet-scale telemetry and with building quality gates on top of noisy production signal;
  • Familiarity with WordPress, PHP, or WAF/ModSecurity concepts;
  • Experience with configuration management (Ansible, Puppet, Salt) and with Linux service operations.

You do not need a cybersecurity background. Most of the hard problems here are orchestration, reliability, correctness under concurrency and observability. Domain knowledge is learnable and we have specialists to learn it from — pipeline engineering judgement is what we cannot substitute.

We value engineers who are

  • Curious and fearless problem solvers — not afraid to dig into existing systems, investigate root causes, and propose improvements;
  • Sceptical by default — who ask what would falsify a conclusion before acting on it, and who trust measurements over plausible reasoning;
  • Pragmatic and detail-oriented — focused on building reliable, maintainable systems, and allergic to solutions that require a human to remember something;
  • Owners — comfortable being the person accountable for whether a pipeline ran correctly last night;
  • Effective communicators — able to articulate ideas clearly, exchange feedback constructively, and foster collaboration across teams;
  • Engaging and proactive — contributing energy, initiative, and a positive presence that strengthens team culture.

Benefits

What's in it for you?

  • A focus on professional development.
  • Interesting and challenging projects.
  • Fully remote work with flexible working hours, that allows you to schedule your day and work from any location worldwide.
  • Paid 24 days of vacation per year, 10 days of national holidays, and unlimited sick leaves.
  • Compensation for private medical insurance.
  • Co-working and gym/sports reimbursement.
  • Budget for education.
  • The opportunity to receive a reward for the most innovative idea that the company can patent.

By applying for this position, you consent to the processing of your personal data as described in our Privacy Policy (), which provides detailed information on how we maintain and handle your data.

Location: Bremen / Remote in Germany · Full-time

About Synera

Synera builds the AI agent platform that lets hardware engineers connect their tools and automate their workflows. We sell to the world's leading engineering organizations and we run our own company the same way we build our product: automated, data-driven, and AI-first.

About the role

Our GTM engine runs on data: Salesforce as the CRM backbone, HubSpot for Marketing, wired into enrichment and outbound tooling, and a growing layer of AI agents on top. You are the admin of record for that stack: you design it, build in it, ship changes to it, and keep every system connected to it in sync.

Sales Dev, AEs, Marketing and CS all work in the systems you own, and how well they run depends on the UI/UX, data model, automations, and processes you put there. Everything we automate on top of the CRM, from reporting to integrations to AI agents, only works if the records underneath are correct.

We believe in creating outcomes. Your work does not stop once you've implemented a new process, layout, or field. It ends, when features have adopted and retained usage, data quality is high, or correctness is 100%. Bonus if you can actually get a high CSAT by CRM users. We know the pain.

Who you are:

  • Hands-on experience administering Salesforce in a B2B sales organization (certification a plus, real flows and technical logic a must); working knowledge of HubSpot or a comparable marketing-automation platform.

  • Comfortable in the data layer: SQL is second nature; you have built ETL/data pipelines (Airflow or similar) and data models, and can debug a sync gone wrong across three tools.

  • You have built reporting and forecasting people actually use and know the difference between a dashboard and an answer.

  • An automator by instinct: scripts, APIs, workflow tools, and AI agents are how you scale yourself. You use LLMs as a daily working tool, not a novelty and the idea of building the data brain behind a company-wide AI agent excites you.

  • You work in English confidently; German is a plus. You communicate clearly with non-technical colleagues, sales reps, marketers, and executives alike.

  • Ownership mentality: you document what you build, you notice what nobody asked about, and you would rather fix the system than the symptom.

Why this role

You own the system the entire revenue organization runs on, with the mandate to shape it rather than maintain it, a modern stack, and the automation tooling to build leverage instead of backlog. You report into Business Operations with a direct line to how the company is run.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Administer Salesforce: You are the admin of record who implements, maintains, improves. Objects, fields, flows, validation rules, permission sets, lead routing, ...

  • Administer HubSpot: marketing automation, channel integrations, performance & pipeline attribution, workflows, ...

  • Ship changes like an engineer: test in sandbox, deploy in production, and enable the team

  • Own the interfaces: the Salesforce <> HubSpot sync, enrichment and outbound tooling (Clay, Instantly), the source side of the feeds that leave the CRM for the data warehouse, and AI integrations.

  • Manage users, permissions, and licenses across the GTM stack and help evaluate new tools and consolidate overlapping ones.

  • Design the data model. You decide what deserves a new field, what belongs in a picklist and what gets retired, you implement it, and you enable the team to use it.

  • Support the whole customer journey: unblock, train, & enable Sales Dev, AEs, Marketing, and CS in the CRM day to day. Then turn recurring questions into processes & self-serve dashboards, documentation, automations, and agents.

⚡ In 6 months:

  • 3 months: you are the admin of record for Salesforce and HubSpot, own the integration landscape around them, and run day-to-day CRM operations.

  • 6 months: the CRM, its data model and automations are documented, monitored and trusted, and the GTM teams self-serve the changes and answers they used to queue up with you

⚡ In 12 months:

  • 12 months: your data foundation becomes the knowledge layer of Synera's superagent. AI agents across the company answer questions and execute work on data you made trustworthy.

We believe in transparent conversations about compensation from the start. For this role.

We determine the level we hire you for based on your experience, the scope of responsibilities you'll take on, and the impact you can drive. While we typically hire within these bands, we're open to some flexibility for candidates who bring exceptional value to the role.

  • Prefer two wheels over four? 🚲 We’ve got you covered with JobRad.

Regular team events, virtual coffee breaks, and spontaneous afterworks. We also get together as a whole company for 2-3 day off-sites twice a year! 🌈

Our recruitment process

  3. Data Engineering Tech Interview

  4. Bar Raiser Interview (with the Founder)

Requirements

Even if you don't meet these criteria perfectly but believe you have lots to bring to the role, we encourage you to apply. We know it's tough, but please keep in mind that you don't have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.

  • You resonate with Synera's Core Values - they're central to how we work, and we'll explore them together in your first interview.

P.S. Synera is a place where everyone can grow. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come to work every day, and be prepared to share with us how your perspective will bring something unique and valuable to our Engineering team.

jobs.description:
Marketing Growth & Communications Intern

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Marketing Growth Communications Intern who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Marketing Growth Communications Intern, you will play a critical support role with responsibility for preparing and executing the campaigns behind our consumer programs — subscriptions, giveaways, surveys, and lifecycle communications — that reach millions of shoppers. A core focus will be managing our CRM platform (Braze) across email, push, SMS, and in-app, building and QAing assets, managing compliance approvals, and reporting on performance. In addition to execution, you will help build content to support channel optimization, segmentation, and analytics across all channels. To achieve these goals, you will engage with varying members across the marketing department, as well as Design, Product and Compliance.

The primary aim for this role is to help create relevant, customized and personalized content for our Sezzle consumers, to maximize revenue and engagement. Over time you will move from executing campaigns to shaping them — proposing the audience, the timing, and the message.

What You'll Do:

Build and launch campaigns

  • Build marketing communications in our CRM platform (Braze) across email, push, SMS, and in-app
  • Build and QA landing pages and campaign assets, making sure everything renders correctly before it reaches a single shopper
  • Own the day-to-day asset production flow: build, quality assurance, approvals, deployment, and communication with internal and external stakeholders
  • Manage the compliance and legal approval of assets.

Keep the operation running

  • Support day-to-day operations, keeping every marketing initiative up to date and on schedule
  • Maintain and organize campaign documentation — briefs, schedules, reports, and final assets
  • Identify potential risks early and come with a recommendation for how to mitigate them
  • Support the client and sales teams with in-app promotional setup and reporting

Measure and improve

  • Pull campaign performance data and report back on what actually happened
  • Recommend how to optimize the next campaign based on what the last one showed
  • Test copy, creative, and timing, and help work out which version earns its place
  • Use AI tools (Claude and similar) to speed up research, first drafts, and reporting

What We Look For:

Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Attention to detail is a must. There are plenty of moving parts within this role
  • Experience copywriting short and engaging messages
  • Comfortable with numbers — you can look at a table of campaign results and say something useful about it
  • Basic creative design skills and knowledge of Figma
  • You get the most out of AI. Claude, ChatGPT, or similar are already part of how you work — research, copy, summaries — and you're constantly exploring what else they can handle
  • Comfort working in agile, matrixed teams with multiple inputs and quick turnarounds
  • A strong bias for action

Educational & Professional Experience

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in marketing, communications, advertising, business, or a related field
  • Basic project management skills
  • Prior experience with Braze or another CRM/marketing automation platform is a plus
  • Experience building email templates or landing pages is a plus
  • Any experience with email, push notifications, in-app messaging, eCommerce, or digital marketing is a plus
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation: The salary for the Marketing and Communications Intern is $800 USD monthly gross.

Within Finance, the Treasury function ensures that ALU maintains strong cash control, executes payments reliably, and operates within a disciplined compliance framework across multiple entities and jurisdictions. The team works closely with Accounts Payable, FP&A, and operational teams to ensure accuracy, timeliness, and control.

You will collaborate with different teams across the organisation, at different levels of seniority. You will be working in a mission-driven environment, with passionate and interesting people. You will have opportunities for both personal and professional growth - ALU team members work hard but have a lot of flexibility and a great working environment.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Treasury & Compliance Coordinator supports the day-to-day execution of ALU’s treasury operations and statutory compliance activities across all ALU jurisdictions. This includes daily cash positioning, executing banking transactions, and ensuring timely and accurate cash flow reporting. The role also involves preparing monthly cash flow reports for each ALU entity and consolidated reporting for ALU Foundation.

This role is responsible for ensuring timely and accurate payment processing, maintaining visibility over cash positions, supporting bank operations, and coordinating compliance activities (WHT, VAT, and other statutory obligations).

The role reports directly to the Accountant and ultimately to the Finance Operations Director, ensuring strong alignment between accounting records, cash movements, and compliance obligations.

The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, disciplined, and comfortable operating in a structured, control-driven environment

RESPONSIBILITIES

Treasury Operations & Payment Processing

  • Initiate and execute domestic and international payments, including vendor payments and payroll disbursements based on approved instructions from Accounts Payable and Payroll team.
  • Monitor and manage daily cash balances across all ALU entities and bank accounts.
  • Support preparation and execution of bi-monthly payment runs (15th and month-end).
  • Review payment documentation to ensure completeness, accuracy, and proper approvals.
  • Assist in initiating payments across multiple banking platforms (local and international).
  • Track payment status from initiation through to bank release and confirmation.
  • Maintain an up-to-date payment tracker with full visibility of all transactions.
  • Intercompany transfers/funding between ALU entities.

Cash Positioning & Monitoring

  • Maintain daily visibility of cash balances across all bank accounts and entities.
  • Track inflows and outflows, including student receipts, donor funds, and operational payments.
  • Support preparation and updating of short & medium-term cash flow forecasts.
  • Consolidate and report actual vs forecast cash flows at the group level, including variance analysis.
  • Flag any liquidity risks, delays, or anomalies to the Accountant.
  • Highlight funding gaps and proactively escalate any risks.
  • Monitoring bank charges, transaction fees and other banking costs, and flagging any unusual items.

Banking Operations

  • Support management of bank accounts, including:
    • Account setup and maintenance
    • Signatory updates
    • Online banking access controls
  • Liaise with banking partners to resolve payment issues and operational queries.
  • Support execution of urgent or off-cycle payments where required.

Compliance & Tax Coordination

  • Support preparation and tracking of statutory obligations, including but not limited to:
    • Withholding Tax (WHT)
    • VAT filings
    • Other regulatory submissions
  • Maintain a compliance calendar to ensure deadlines are met.
  • Coordinate with Accounts Payable and Finance teams to ensure completeness of compliance data.
  • Support engagement with tax authorities and external advisors.
  • Primary point of contact for coordinating tax regulators.

External Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the key point of contact for ALU’s banking partners.
  • Coordinate with tax authorities, auditors, and other financial service providers.
  • Support external and internal audits by preparing documentation and responding to queries.

Reconciliations & Controls

  • Perform weekly bank reconciliations and resolving discrepancies.
  • Ensure all payments align with approved payment runs and supporting documentation.
  • Maintain proper documentation and audit trails for all treasury transactions.
  • Support internal and external audits by preparing required schedules and audit-ready documentation.
  • Support to the Accountant with treasury-related month-end and audit duties.

Internal Controls & Process Management

  • Assist in building treasury processes that scale with ALU’s growth and maintain audit readiness
  • Enforce adherence to treasury processes, approval matrices, timelines and internal controls over cash management, payment approvals, and banking access.
  • Identify inefficiencies in payment workflows and banking processes.
  • Support implementation of improved controls, systems, and treasury procedures.
  • Contribute to building scalable and standardized treasury operations.
  • Regularly review and improve treasury-related SOPs and workflows to increase efficiency and reduce risk.

Cross-Functional Support

  • Work closely with Accounts Payable, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), People & Culture(P&C), and Operations on treasury-related matters.
  • Support payroll disbursements, vendor payments, and statutory payments.
  • Assist with treasury-related analysis and ad hoc finance projects.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 2–4 years of experience in treasury, accounting, fund accounting or finance operations.
  • Exposure to payment processing, bank reconciliations, or cash management.
  • Working knowledge of tax compliance (WHT, VAT) is an advantage.
  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial regulations.
  • Proficiency in accounting software (e.g., NetSuite or similar ERP systems).
  • High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and strong analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

REQUIRED COMPETENCIES

  • High attention to detail: Ability to process transactions with accuracy and consistency.
  • Integrity and accountability: Trusted to operate in a cash-sensitive environment.
  • Process discipline: Ability to follow and enforce structured workflows.
  • Strong organizational skills: Able to manage multiple transactions and deadlines.
  • Responsiveness: Operates effectively in time-sensitive treasury processes.
  • Analytical thinking: Able to identify discrepancies and flag risks early.
  • Stakeholder collaboration: Works effectively across teams and functions.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

jobs.excerpt: About the TeamAt DoorDash we’re building the industry’s most scalable and reliable delivery network to support our three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and Dashers.
jobs.description:
About the Team

At DoorDash we’re building the industry’s most scalable and reliable delivery network to support our three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and Dashers. Security Engineering is paramount to the success of our business, and DoorDash Security aspires to be one the world’s most admired Security Engineering team. We are committed to building the world's most trusted on-demand, logistics engine for delivery! We're expanding our team of great minds to help us secure and maintain a 24x7, no downtime, global infrastructure system that powers DoorDash’s multi-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and drivers.

About the Role

Our Proactive Security Engineering team is looking for a Staff Security Engineer, Proactive Security to execute on AI Security Product Engineering following a forward deployed engineering Pod model.

You will be a part of our inclusive, collaborative forward deployed engineering team responsible for building “paved road” Security Product controls directly into our AI surfaces for our Customer, Merchant and Dasher products to ensure a safe, secure and resilient delivery network. This is not a classic Product Security role performing reviews and operating platform products, this is a forward deployed model where we operate in Pods that focus on domain code bases to build and ship AI Security Products including Hardened Product Agents, AI Guardrails, MCP Gateways and many upcoming AI Hardening initiatives.

This is a US remote position reporting directly to the Manager of our Proactive Security Engineering team.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Co-lead the technical direction and roadmap for secure and responsible building of AI Security Products at DoorDash.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product Engineering, Legal, Security Engineering Platform, Data teams and XFN partners to build “paved road” proactive security controls that enable secure by design AI products into DoorDash eco-system. Examples of AI Security Products this team has built include Hardened Product Agents, AI Guardrails, MCP Gateways and many upcoming AI Hardening initiatives.
  • Execute rigorous cross-brand AI enabled vulnerability discovery, multi-level harnesses and automated remediation to protect the company against Mythos-era equipped adversaries.
  • Mentor and coach earlier career engineers, setting and enforcing exceptional standards for Operational Excellence and Software Engineering.

We’re excited about you because…

  • 10+ years of experience as a Security Product Engineer at an Internet scale organization of demonstrated technical leadership building outcomes at global scale.
  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Security Engineering, a related field or equivalent work experience.
  • Embed with product teams to design, build, and deploy security controls for consumer, merchant, and Dasher products.
  • Develop reusable “paved road” solutions that help teams build secure AI products by default.
  • Partner with Product Engineering, Legal, Data, Security Platform, and other teams to translate security and regulatory requirements into practical engineering controls.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership in designing scalable, AI enabled and ergonomic Security Review threat modeling.
  • Hands-on experience securing LLM or agentic systems, or demonstrated ability to move quickly into the space from adjacent depth in authorization, sandboxing, or untrusted input handling.
  • Demonstrated builder in one or more object oriented languages (e.g. Go, Java) designing technical Security Engineering controls and processes to meet business and regulatory requirements.
  • Exceptional problem solving of complex, systemic issues that require audacious thinking, rigor and creativity.
  • Exceptional analytical and investigative abilities with hands-on experience leading root cause analysis for security incidents and driving long term roadmaps to remediate.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills - you will confidently shape and lead the Security Product Engineering within your assigned AI Security domain across core engineering and product teams to security preserving control outcomes.

Why You’ll Love Working at DoorDash

  • We are leaders - Leadership is not limited to our management team. It’s something everyone at DoorDash embraces and embodies.
  • We are doers - We believe the only way to predict the future is to build it. Creating solutions that will lead our company and our industry is what we do -- on every project, every day.
  • We are learners - We’re not afraid to dig in and uncover the truth, even if it’s scary or inconvenient. Everyone here is continually learning on the job, no matter if we’ve been in a role for one year or one minute.
  • We are customer-obsessed - Our mission is to grow and empower local economies. We are committed to our customers, merchants, and dashers and believe in connecting people with possibility.
  • We are all DoorDash - The magic of DoorDash is our people, together making our inspiring goals attainable and driving us to greater heights.
  • We offer exceptional compensation packages and comprehensive health benefits.

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

  • For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.
  • For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. jobs.excerpt: LO0341 Remote - USA, OH0713 NW Bancshares HQJob Description The SBA (Small Business Administration) Closing Manager serves as the driving force behind the successful transition of SBA loans from approval to funding, ensuring every transaction moves forward with precision, efficiency, and confidence.
jobs.description:
LO0341 Remote - USA, OH0713 NW Bancshares HQ

Job Description

The SBA (Small Business Administration) Closing Manager serves as the driving force behind the successful transition of SBA loans from approval to funding, ensuring every transaction moves forward with precision, efficiency, and confidence. This role oversees the full loan closing lifecycle, guiding origination fulfillment while maintaining operational excellence and strict adherence to SBA Standard Operating Procedures. Working closely with internal teams and external legal counsel, the Closing Manager orchestrates complex transactions and ensures documentation is accurate, complete, and structured for success. A deep understanding of SBA lending and sophisticated financing arrangements is essential, as is the ability to build strong relationships with customers, lending partners, and legal professionals. Through expertise, collaboration, and attention to detail, this position plays a critical role in delivering a seamless closing experience and supporting the growth of small businesses.

Essential Functions

  • Conduct, or participate in, the hiring, coaching, developing and supervising of team members; conducting one-on-one progress and coaching sessions as needed, and identifying and training team members that demonstrate high potential to ensure appropriate succession planning

  • Provides oversight and expertise for items related to credit, loan, and SBA documentation policies, closing due diligence, regulatory requirements (including BSA, Beneficial Ownership, Flood Regulations, etc.) and systems used

  • Develops strategies and recommendations for improving efficiency, productivity, quality, and risk management within the SBA segment and collaborates with business partners to communicate ideas and recommendations to management

  • Acts as the SBA closing/processing subject matter expert by having extensive knowledge of SBA Standard Operating Procedures

  • Exercises independent decisions regarding compliance with bank and SBA documentation requirements

  • Serves as the primary escalation contact for business partners regarding questions, issues or concerns with team performance or transactional issues

  • Document and complete annual performance appraisals and performance management duties including, but not limited to, providing appropriate feedback and goal setting

  • Daily management of SBA Closing Desk team members to ensure timely completion of all tasks/workflows. Including review of all loan documentation (originated and broadly syndicated loans)

  • Manage and ensure all SBA, legal, credit, collateral, and regulatory requirements are included in documentation

  • Ensure team has complete review of all SBA Guaranty requirements, approved terms and conditions and appropriately documented in accordance with established procedures

  • Ensure staff is managing title company process on originated loans and communicating with borrowers to see that all title requirements are met at closing

  • Perform SOX testing as needed

  • Ensure total document and data integrity attributes to comply with CECL data points

  • Meet performance metrics for headcount, Service Level Agreements and efficiency; Manage, research and remediate inquiries and complaints from internal and external customers within established Service Level Agreements (SLAs)

  • Monitor and resolve issues and establish appropriate controls over the use of the core and ancillary systems to comply with audit requirements

  • Act as department's technical liaison to develop, manage, and implement the ongoing design of documentation procedures, methods and work systems; accountable for updates to department procedures according to the Northwest's established guidelines

  • Lead and oversee activities related to documentation, and monitoring tasks

  • Train new hires to ensure consistency and standardization in the closing process

  • Engage with Credit Managers, Portfolio Managers, and Underwriters to collaboratively support customer's request

  • Administrate appropriate third-party vendors

  • Ensure compliance with Northwest’s policies and procedures, and Federal/State regulations

  • Navigate Microsoft Office Software, computer applications, and software specific to the department in order to maximize technology tools and gain efficiency

  • Work as part of a team

  • Work with on-site equipment

What You Bring to the Team

PR Specialist

Seeking.com | Full-Time, Exempt, Remote (US) | Reports to: PR Manager

About the Role

Seeking.com is the world's largest premium dating platform, and we are in the middle of the most important chapter of our brand transformation. You will not be coordinating from the sidelines. You will be pitching journalists, drafting press releases, and running the day-to-day operations of our member casting book.

This is the right role for an ambitious specialist who wants to be promoted to PR Manager in two to three years, and who knows that the way to get there is by doing the work.

Core Responsibilities

Writing, Pitching & Media Relations

  • Draft press releases, media alerts, pitch emails, op-eds, Q&As, fact sheets, executive bios, and briefing books for review
  • Pitch journalists, editors, podcast bookers, producers, bloggers, and influencers directly on the beats you own
  • Build and grow personal media relationships across dating, lifestyle, business, consumer tech, and culture beats
  • Maintain personal media-readiness: keep talking points current and be comfortable on camera and in audio
  • Respond to inbound media requests with speed and route information across the company • Identify and act on PR opportunities through Qwoted, HARO, and similar platforms daily • Help trend-hijack: bring at least two news-cycle insertion opportunities to the Senior PR Manager every week with a draft pitch attached
  • Edit and proofread your own work and your peers' work to AP-style standard before it goes to management
  • Complete media training as the company offers it

Member Casting & Storyteller Book

  • Run the day-to-day operations of the member casting book under management’s direction • Recruit members into the book continuously
  • Vet members for media-readiness, brief them on outlet, journalist, angle, and message tracks before every press interaction
  • Match the right member to the right journalist request and coordinate availability inside hours • Manage all NDAs, consent forms, and post-interview follow-ups for member interviewees • Keep the casting book tagged, searchable, and current

•

Co-CEO & Executive Visibility Support

  • Help build the pipeline of podcast, interview, and speaking opportunities for our Co-CEOs • Draft briefing materials, narrative arcs, and message tracks for executive appearances • Research awards relevant to the brand and prepare submissions for the manager's review • Coordinate stage and panel opportunities at relevant conferences

Trend-Mining & Cultural Listening

  • Monitor news, newsletters, X, and competitor PR daily across dating, relationships, lifestyle, business, and tech
  • Maintain a running calendar of recurring cultural moments and pre-build pitches around them • Track competitor PR activity and flag where they are taking share of conversation we should be contesting

Operations, Reporting & Asset Management

  • Maintain media lists, pitch calendars, journalist contact databases, and CRM tracking • Maintain the PR asset library: approved imagery, boilerplates, key messaging, executive bios, and media kits
  • Monitor daily media coverage using Muck Rack, Cision, Meltwater, Google Alerts, and similar tools
  • Compile weekly coverage summaries and contribute to monthly PR reports • Maintain SOPs and process documentation for recurring workflows

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in PR (agency or in-house), journalism, or communications • Bachelor's degree in Public Relations, Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or related field, or equivalent professional track record
  • Demonstrated track record contributing to or personally securing media coverage (regional, trade, or national outlets)
  • Strong writing and editing skills with a portfolio of work you can point to
  • Working knowledge of Muck Rack, Cision, Meltwater, or equivalent, plus Qwoted/HARO, plus AP style

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience at a top consumer or lifestyle PR agency
  • AI fluency. You already use ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, or similar tools to research, draft first passes, build media lists, and analyze coverage
  • Newsroom experience as a reporter or junior editor
  • Existing relationships with dating, relationships, lifestyle, business, or consumer tech beat reporters
  • Experience with member, customer, or talent casting for media stories
  • Comfort with reputation work for brands that carry public-perception baggage Compensation & Benefits
  • Base salary: $80,000 to $100,000, commensurate with experience
  • Full-time, exempt, fully remote within the US
  • Health, dental, vision, 401(k), and standard benefits package
  • A manager who will actively coach you and a real path to Senior PR Manager

You will set the vision for operational readiness, ensuring that people, processes, and enablement systems evolve in lockstep with Affirm’s servicing strategy. jobs.description:
Anteris® Technologies is a global structural heart company dedicated to revolutionizing cardiac care. With offices in Minneapolis, MN, US; Geneva, Switzerland; and Brisbane and Perth, Australia, we have a growing and inclusive team.

Our mission is to forge new frontiers in cardiac care by pioneering science-driven and measurable advancements to restore heart valve patients to healthy function. Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVR) technologies were originally designed for older, high-risk patients. Today, younger, more active patients need a better solution that will not just open and close but restore healthy heart function. We seek to restore healthy blood flow patterns by creating the world’s first biomimetic TAVR valve, DurAVR® THV. This cutting-edge valve, incorporating our proprietary ADAPT® anti-calcification technology, is designed to mimic the natural function of a healthy heart valve.

The Clinical Imaging Specialist plays a critical role in supporting patient screening and procedural planning activities for Anteris global clinical studies. This individual performs detailed review and analysis of cardiac CT imaging, supports patient eligibility assessments, and collaborates closely with physicians, Clinical Science, Clinical Operations, Therapy Development, and Field Clinical teams to facilitate enrollment and procedural planning across multinational clinical trial sites.

Reporting to the Director of Therapy and Technology Advancement, this role requires deep knowledge of structural heart anatomy, cardiac CT imaging, and TAVR patient evaluation. The Clinical Imaging Specialist serves as a key clinical resource by delivering consistent, high-quality imaging assessments while supporting efficient patient screening and case planning throughout Anteris' global clinical programs.

This is a remote position based within Europe. Preference will be given to candidates located in or near Geneva, CH, or those near a major international airport to support occasional travel (approximately 10%) for investigator meetings, physician training, internal meetings, and clinical site visits throughout Europe and other global locations. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in their country of residence.

At Anteris Technologies, you'll join a mission-driven team dedicated to improving the lives of patients with aortic stenosis through breakthrough structural heart technologies while helping shape the future of structural heart care.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

Imaging Review & Patient Screening

  • Perform detailed review and analysis of cardiac CT scans for patients being considered for enrollment in global clinical studies.
  • Evaluate imaging data to support patient eligibility and screening decisions.
  • Assess anatomical characteristics relevant to TAVR procedural planning, including aortic annulus sizing, vascular access, calcium distribution, coronary heights, valve morphology, and other structural heart considerations.
  • Utilize advanced imaging platforms, including 3Mensio or equivalent software, to perform measurements and generate screening reports.
  • Identify and escalate imaging findings that may impact patient eligibility, procedural planning, or study participation.

Manager of Support Services

Harris Recording Solutions

View All Locations
Time Type: Full Time

Harris Recording Solutions (HRS), a leading provider of software solutions for county government and official records organizations, is seeking a Manager of Support Services to lead the day-to-day operations of our Support Services team and ensure we consistently deliver exceptional service to our customers.

The Manager of Support Services will be responsible for managing support operations, developing employees, monitoring performance, improving processes, and ensuring customer issues are addressed efficiently and professionally.

This role will work closely with Client Services leadership, Product, Development, Professional Services, Sales, and other internal teams to advocate for customers, identify recurring issues, improve support processes, and strengthen the overall customer experience.

The ideal candidate is an experienced support leader who is organized, accountable, customer-focused, and comfortable managing a team in a fast-paced software environment. This individual should have a strong understanding of support operations, performance management, customer communication, escalation management, and continuous improvement.

AI & Innovation Mindset

Harris Recording Solutions is committed to using emerging technologies to improve how we work and serve our customers.

The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to adopt and leverage AI, automation, knowledge management, and other technology solutions to improve support workflows, increase efficiency, and enhance the customer experience.

The Manager of Support Services will help identify opportunities to automate repetitive work, improve knowledge resources, leverage AI-assisted support tools, and reduce unnecessary manual effort while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and customer service standards.

What Your Impact Will Be

Support Team Leadership

  • Manage the day-to-day activities of the Support Services team.
  • Provide leadership, coaching, mentoring, and ongoing development to support employees.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and hold employees accountable for results.
  • Monitor individual and team performance and address performance issues promptly.
  • Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance discussions, and team meetings.
  • Identify employee strengths, development opportunities, and career growth paths.
  • Help develop future leaders within the Support organization.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, teamwork, and customer advocacy.
  • Ensure team members have the training, tools, documentation, and resources needed to perform their roles effectively.

Operational Excellence

  • Monitor daily support operations to ensure customers receive timely and effective assistance.
  • Manage ticket queues, assignments, priorities, escalations, and workload distribution.
  • Monitor key support metrics, including:
    • Response times
    • Resolution times
    • SLA performance
    • Ticket backlog
    • Customer satisfaction
    • Ticket quality
    • Productivity
    • Escalations
    • Aging tickets
  • Identify trends and operational issues and implement corrective actions.
  • Ensure support processes are consistently followed and documented.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, eliminate unnecessary steps, and increase team efficiency.
  • Maintain appropriate coverage and resource allocation based on customer demand.
  • Help establish and maintain support standards across HRS product lines.
  • Ensure aging and stagnant tickets are actively managed and appropriately escalated.
  • Monitor critical incidents and ensure appropriate communication and follow-up.

Customer Experience & Escalations

  • Serve as an escalation point for complex or sensitive customer issues.
  • Work directly with customers when additional management involvement is required.
  • Ensure customer concerns are communicated clearly and professionally.
  • Monitor escalated issues through resolution and ensure appropriate follow-up occurs.
  • Identify recurring customer issues and work with internal teams to address root causes.
  • Advocate for customers while balancing customer needs with company policies and business objectives.
  • Help strengthen customer relationships through consistent, proactive, and professional support.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Product and Development to communicate recurring customer issues and product feedback.
  • Identify trends in support tickets that may indicate product defects, training opportunities, or documentation gaps.
  • Work with Product and Development teams to improve product quality and reduce recurring support issues.
  • Collaborate with Professional Services and Client Services to ensure smooth customer handoffs and issue resolution.
  • Partner with internal teams during product releases, upgrades, implementations, and major customer initiatives.
  • Provide leadership with regular updates regarding support trends, customer concerns, staffing, and operational performance.

Knowledge Management & Process Improvement

  • Help develop and maintain a strong knowledge management program for internal employees and customers.
  • Identify opportunities to convert recurring support issues into knowledge articles, documentation, training materials, and self-service resources.
  • Ensure support documentation is accurate, current, and easy for employees to use.
  • Promote the use of knowledge articles and self-service tools to improve resolution times and reduce unnecessary tickets.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize processes across Support Services.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives designed to improve customer service and team efficiency.

AI & Automation

  • Promote the effective use of AI and automation within Support Services.
  • Identify repetitive support activities that can be automated or assisted through technology.
  • Encourage adoption of AI-assisted ticket management, knowledge search, ticket summarization, response assistance, and other support tools.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of AI-enabled support tools and provide feedback for improvement.
  • Help ensure AI-generated information and responses are reviewed appropriately and maintain HRS standards for accuracy and customer service.
  • Partner with leadership to identify opportunities to increase ticket deflection and reduce manual workload through automation and self-service.

Reporting & Performance Management

  • Maintain visibility into Support Services performance through regular reporting and analysis.
  • Review team metrics and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare regular updates for Client Services leadership regarding:
    • Ticket volume
    • Backlog
    • SLA performance
    • Customer satisfaction
    • Escalations
    • Staffing
    • Productivity
    • Major customer issues
    • Operational trends
  • Use data to identify risks and make recommendations for improving support performance.
  • Establish team goals and track progress against those goals.

Travel Requirements

Limited travel may be required, typically not to exceed 10–20%, primarily for customer engagements, conferences, team meetings, training, or business planning sessions.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in software support, technical support, customer service, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience managing or supervising a support or customer-facing team.
  • Experience supporting enterprise software or SaaS products.
  • Experience managing ticket queues, support metrics, escalations, and service levels.
  • Strong understanding of customer support operations and best practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and hold employees accountable for performance.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with Product, Development, Client Services, Professional Services, and other internal teams.
  • Experience with ticketing systems, knowledge management platforms, reporting tools, and customer support technologies.
  • Experience with AI, automation, or other emerging technologies is preferred.
  • Experience working with county government, public sector software, land records, or government technology is a plus.
  • Ability to effectively manage customer escalations and difficult customer situations.
  • Demonstrated commitment to providing exceptional customer service.
  • Ability to work independently while also functioning effectively as part of a distributed team.
  • Ability to travel as needed for customer and business engagements.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means the Support Services team is organized, accountable, responsive, and customer-focused.

The Manager of Support Services will ensure that:

  • Customers receive timely and professional support.
  • Tickets are actively managed and resolved within established expectations.
  • Backlogs and aging tickets are proactively addressed.
  • Employees understand their responsibilities and performance expectations.
  • Support metrics are consistently monitored and improved.
  • Recurring customer issues are identified and communicated to the appropriate teams.
  • Knowledge and self-service resources continue to improve.
  • AI and automation are used to increase efficiency and reduce manual workload.
  • The Support Services team operates as a strong partner to customers and the broader HRS organization.

Salary Range: $75,000 - $85,000 USD per year.

As we expand our scalable, affordable PACE model to meet the growing and complex needs of aging populations, our mission‑driven care teams continue to help participants live well on their own terms.

Habitat Health is supported by leading healthcare organizations and investors including New Enterprise Associates, Kaiser Permanente, and Town Hall Ventures. We are looking for a detail oriented, results driven individual who will drive assigned program outcomes from initiation to close-out in a defined timeframe. The Health Plan Associate – Program Management plays a central role in coordinating and monitoring cross-functional projects that span claims, authorizations, pharmacy (Part D), provider network, eligibility/census management, member services, and other Health Plan program management.

This role focuses on project execution, risk identification, and operational readiness, helping the Health Plan leadership team ensure key initiatives, regulatory deliverables, and performance improvements stay on track across all areas for both current and future Health Plan products.

  • Drive projects and initiatives that cut across multiple domains (e.g., new vendor implementations, regulatory audits, process standardization, data integrity efforts) and maintain the end-to-end work plan for Health Plan operations — enrollment, authorizations, claims, pharmacy, and network performance — identifying risks, dependencies, and inefficiencies along the way.
  • Develop and maintain project schedules, milestones, and resource/timeline estimates; partner with subject-matter experts (e.g., Claims, Compliance, Provider Network, Data & Analytics) to document processes and design improvements aligned to regulatory and organizational goals.

  • Follow up with responsible parties to ensure timely completion of open items, correcting course when work goes beyond scope or off-target, and escalate barriers to Health Plan leadership as needed.
  • Own Health Plan regulatory processes and filings, ensuring strict adherence to critical timelines
  • Serve as the primary point of accountability for assigned regulatory filings, reporting submissions, and compliance deliverables, ensuring accuracy and on-time completion.
  • Maintain a master regulatory calendar of response windows, due dates, and filing deadlines, proactively flagging upcoming items well in advance of when they are due.

  • Represent the Health Plan function in go-live planning and readiness activities, ensuring Health Plan requirements, systems, and processes are in place ahead of each new center launch.
